content.title: Part 5 Practice: Revised Schedules and Everyday Business Grammar
content.scenario_summary: Thirty stand-alone Part 5 sentences set in a different small-business context for each item. The settings include an architecture studio adjusting drawings for a client, a bicycle shop staggering pickups, a bookshop waiving fees and delaying a signing, a packaging team weighing costs, a returns desk, a software subscription service, an accountants' association, a caterer's deadline, a theater premiere and rehearsal, a conference moving a panel, a translation agency, a warehouse scheduling forklift maintenance and backlog packing, forklift recertification, a gym-fee benefit, a museum protecting manuscripts, landscape projects, an equipment rental depot and a recruiter extending a deadline. One community garden item shows volunteers finding a revised watering schedule easier than the old weekly rotation.

questions.prompt: In the revised drawings, the architects at Linwell Studio {{q1}} the client's concerns about limited natural light by widening the north-facing windows.

options.label: A
options.text: responded

options.label: B
options.text: attended

options.label: C
options.text: addressed

options.label: D
options.text: replied

explanation.summary_zh: 空格後直接接名詞片語 the client's concerns。address 可直接以 concerns 為受詞，意為「處理、因應（疑慮）」，與後面「加寬北向窗戶」的解決方法相符。
explanation.reasoning_zh: 空格後緊接受詞 the client's concerns，by widening the north-facing windows 說明處理方式。因此，空格要填能直接接 concerns、表示「處理疑慮」的動詞。addressed the client's concerns 符合這個要求。若用 respond 或 reply 表示回應這些疑慮，要說 responded to 或 replied to the client's concerns；用 attend 表示處理疑慮時，要說 attended to the client's concerns。本句空格後沒有 to，所以只有 addressed 能直接接上。

option_analysis.label: A
option_analysis.reason_zh: 用 respond 回應 the client's concerns 這類名詞片語時，要說 responded to the client's concerns。本句空格後沒有 to，responded the client's concerns 不成立。

option_analysis.label: B
option_analysis.reason_zh: attend 表示「處理（問題、需求）」時要用 attend to（attended to the client's concerns）。attend 直接接受詞的常見用法是「出席」，例如 attend a meeting；attended the client's concerns 無法表達「處理客戶的疑慮」。

option_analysis.label: C
option_analysis.reason_zh: 正確。addressed the client's concerns 意為「處理了客戶的疑慮」，by widening... 說明處理方法，語意連貫。

option_analysis.label: D
option_analysis.reason_zh: 用 reply 回覆 the client's concerns 這類內容時，要說 replied to the client's concerns。本句空格後沒有 to，replied the client's concerns 不成立。

explanation.takeaway_zh: 表示處理或回應某項疑慮時要注意句型：address concerns 直接接受詞；respond to concerns、reply to concerns 表示回應，attend to concerns 表示處理，這三者在本題的用法中都需要 to。

questions.prompt: Ms. Ferreira's bicycle was ready on Monday, but Mr. Holt was asked to pick up {{q2}} on Wednesday, after the replacement gears arrived.

options.label: A
options.text: his

options.label: B
options.text: him

options.label: C
options.text: himself

options.label: D
options.text: he

explanation.summary_zh: his 在此是所有格代名詞，等於 his bicycle，當 pick up 的受詞，與前半句的 Ms. Ferreira's bicycle 形成對照。
explanation.reasoning_zh: 前半句談 Ms. Ferreira 的腳踏車，後半句 Mr. Holt 要領回的是「他的腳踏車」。空格要能單獨當受詞，並代替前面提過的 bicycle。his 可作所有格限定詞，也可作所有格代名詞；此處單獨使用，意思是 his bicycle。

option_analysis.label: A
option_analysis.reason_zh: 正確。pick up his = pick up his bicycle，與前半句的 Ms. Ferreira's bicycle 對照。

option_analysis.label: B
option_analysis.reason_zh: him 指人。Mr. Holt 要領的是車，句中也沒有另一位男性可讓 him 指涉。此外，代名詞受詞與 pick up 連用時，一般放在中間（pick him up）。

option_analysis.label: C
option_analysis.reason_zh: himself 表示主詞對自己做動作，「Mr. Holt 把自己領走」不合理；句意需要的是他的腳踏車。

option_analysis.label: D
option_analysis.reason_zh: he 是主格，不能當動詞片語 pick up 的受詞。

explanation.takeaway_zh: 看到「A's + 名詞..., but B...」的對照結構時，留意空格是否要用 mine、his、hers 等所有格代名詞代替前面的名詞。

questions.prompt: To thank its loyal members, Marlow Street Books will {{q3}} the usual shipping fee on any special orders placed during the first week of December.

options.label: A
options.text: exempt

options.label: B
options.text: relieve

options.label: C
options.text: absolve

options.label: D
options.text: waive

explanation.summary_zh: waive the usual shipping fee 意為「免收平常的運費」。本句是指書店對十二月第一週下的特別訂單不收這筆運費，符合回饋忠實會員的情境。
explanation.reasoning_zh: 空格後的受詞是費用本身 the usual shipping fee，句意是書店對十二月第一週下的特別訂單不收平常的運費。waive 以費用為受詞時，表示不收取該費用。其他三個動詞雖然都和「免除、減輕」有關，但意思與句型各不相同。exempt 是讓某人、機構或物品免於某項義務，例如 exempt members from a fee。relieve 直接接負擔或狀況時表示減輕、緩解，例如 relieve pressure；relieve someone of a burden 則是另一種句型。absolve 通常表示解除人或機構的過錯或責任，例如 absolve the company of liability。在本句中，這三個字直接接 the usual shipping fee，都無法表達「不收這筆運費」。

option_analysis.label: A
option_analysis.reason_zh: exempt 的受詞是被免除義務的一方，可以是人、機構或物品（exempt members from the fee）。若要用 exempt，需改寫成 exempt members from the usual shipping fee。直接說 exempt the usual shipping fee，會把運費當成被免除義務的對象，無法表達「不收這筆運費」。

option_analysis.label: B
option_analysis.reason_zh: relieve 直接接負擔或狀況時表示減輕、緩解（relieve pressure、relieve pain）；relieve someone of a burden 則表示解除某人的負擔。relieve the usual shipping fee 並不表示免收運費。

option_analysis.label: C
option_analysis.reason_zh: absolve 通常用於解除人或機構的過錯或責任（absolve the company of liability），不表示免收費用。absolve the usual shipping fee 不符合本句語意。

option_analysis.label: D
option_analysis.reason_zh: 正確。waive the usual shipping fee 意為「免收平常的運費」，即書店對這段期間的特別訂單選擇不收取這筆費用。

explanation.takeaway_zh: 表示「免除」的動詞要看各自的意思與受詞：waive a fee 是不收某項費用；exempt 是讓人、機構或物品免於某項義務；relieve 是減輕負擔，或用 relieve someone of 表示解除某人的負擔；absolve 多指解除過錯或責任。

questions.prompt: The new compostable packaging costs slightly more to produce; {{q4}}, it should reduce our shipping expenses because each box weighs much less.

options.label: A
options.text: therefore

options.label: B
options.text: however

options.label: C
options.text: similarly

options.label: D
options.text: for instance

explanation.summary_zh: 前句是缺點（生產成本稍高），後句是優點（可降低運費），兩者形成對比，用 however。
explanation.reasoning_zh: 分號後的連接副詞要表達兩個獨立子句的邏輯關係。costs slightly more to produce 是不利之處，reduce our shipping expenses 是有利之處。運費降低的原因由 because each box weighs much less 另外說明，與成本較高無關，因此兩句是轉折關係。

option_analysis.label: A
option_analysis.reason_zh: therefore 表示因果。但運費降低的原因是箱子較輕（because each box weighs much less），不是生產成本較高，因果不成立。

option_analysis.label: B
option_analysis.reason_zh: 正確。however 連接「成本稍高」與「運費降低」的對比。

option_analysis.label: C
option_analysis.reason_zh: similarly 用於兩件相似的事。成本上升與費用下降方向相反，並不相似。

option_analysis.label: D
option_analysis.reason_zh: for instance 用來舉例，但降低運費並不是生產成本較高的例子。

explanation.takeaway_zh: 選連接副詞前，先判斷前後是因果、對比、相似還是舉例；句中若已有 because 說明原因，可用它檢驗 therefore 是否成立。

questions.prompt: Customers {{q5}} purchases were paid for with a gift card will receive any refund as store credit rather than as cash.

options.label: A
options.text: who

options.label: B
options.text: whose

options.label: C
options.text: whom

options.label: D
options.text: which

explanation.summary_zh: 空格後緊接名詞 purchases，指「顧客的購買」，需要表示所屬關係的 whose。
explanation.reasoning_zh: 在關係子句 ___ purchases were paid for with a gift card 中，purchases 已經是子句的主詞，were paid for 是動詞。空格的作用是修飾 purchases，並表示它屬於先行詞 customers，所以要用 whose + 名詞。

option_analysis.label: A
option_analysis.reason_zh: who 在子句中當主詞或受詞，但此子句已有主詞 purchases，who purchases were... 的結構不成立。

option_analysis.label: B
option_analysis.reason_zh: 正確。whose purchases = the customers' purchases，表示用禮物卡付款的是這些顧客的購買。

option_analysis.label: C
option_analysis.reason_zh: whom 在子句中當受詞，但此子句並未缺受詞，而且 whom 不能放在名詞前修飾它。

option_analysis.label: D
option_analysis.reason_zh: 先行詞 customers 是人，這裡又需要表示「顧客的」所屬關係，which 不符合此結構。

explanation.takeaway_zh: 關係詞後若緊接一個名詞，且該名詞屬於先行詞，優先考慮 whose + 名詞。

questions.prompt: Subscribers may cancel within 14 days for a full refund if they are not satisfied with the {{q6}} of the upgraded platform.

options.label: A
options.text: reliability

options.label: B
options.text: reliable

options.label: C
options.text: reliably

options.label: D
options.text: rely

explanation.summary_zh: the 與 of 之間需要名詞作中心詞，reliability（可靠性）語意也正確。
explanation.reasoning_zh: be satisfied with 後接名詞片語。在 the ___ of the upgraded platform 中，空格是名詞片語的中心詞，必須是名詞。「對升級後平台的可靠性不滿意」語意合理。

option_analysis.label: A
option_analysis.reason_zh: 正確。reliability 是名詞，the reliability of the upgraded platform 意為「升級平台的可靠性」。

option_analysis.label: B
option_analysis.reason_zh: reliable 是形容詞，後面沒有可修飾的名詞，the reliable of... 不成立。

option_analysis.label: C
option_analysis.reason_zh: reliably 是副詞，不能當 the 後面的名詞中心詞。

option_analysis.label: D
option_analysis.reason_zh: rely 是動詞，不能放在 the ... of 結構中當名詞。

explanation.takeaway_zh: the ___ of 這類空格通常需要名詞作中心詞；再依語意從同字根的名詞中選擇。

questions.prompt: Online membership renewals at the Coastal Accountants Association rose {{q7}} quickly this spring than the board had predicted in January.

options.label: A
options.text: most

options.label: B
options.text: very

options.label: C
options.text: more

options.label: D
options.text: so

explanation.summary_zh: 句中有 than，需要比較級；quickly 的比較級是 more quickly。
explanation.reasoning_zh: than the board had predicted in January 是比較對象，比較的是實際成長速度與理事會的預測。副詞 quickly 的比較級用 more quickly，才能與 than 搭配。

option_analysis.label: A
option_analysis.reason_zh: most 構成最高級，不與 than 搭配；本句是兩者比較，不是在一個範圍中選「最」。

option_analysis.label: B
option_analysis.reason_zh: very 只表示程度，不能構成比較，very quickly than 不成立。

option_analysis.label: C
option_analysis.reason_zh: 正確。rose more quickly than... 表示「成長得比預測更快」。

option_analysis.label: D
option_analysis.reason_zh: so quickly 常與 that 子句連用（so quickly that...），不接 than。

explanation.takeaway_zh: 看到 than 時，先找比較級；quickly 這類 -ly 副詞的比較級通常是 more quickly。

questions.prompt: Final guest numbers for any Harlow Bistro catering package must be confirmed {{q8}} noon on Thursday so that the kitchen can order ingredients.

options.label: A
options.text: until

options.label: B
options.text: within

options.label: C
options.text: during

options.label: D
options.text: by

explanation.summary_zh: by + 時間點表示「最遲在…之前」，符合確認人數的截止期限。
explanation.reasoning_zh: must be confirmed ___ noon on Thursday 是期限，目的是讓廚房能訂食材。確認人數是在期限前完成一次的動作，用 by noon on Thursday 表示「不遲於週四中午」。

option_analysis.label: A
option_analysis.reason_zh: until 表示狀態或動作持續到某時間點（The offer is valid until noon）。確認人數是一次完成的動作，不是持續到中午的狀態，不符合截止期限的意思。

option_analysis.label: B
option_analysis.reason_zh: within 後接一段期間（within two days），noon on Thursday 是時間點，不搭配。

option_analysis.label: C
option_analysis.reason_zh: during 接一段期間或活動（during lunch），不能用來表示「在某時間點前完成」的期限。

option_analysis.label: D
option_analysis.reason_zh: 正確。confirmed by noon on Thursday 表示最遲週四中午前要確認。

explanation.takeaway_zh: 表示在期限前完成某個動作用 by + 時間點；until 則用於持續到某時間的情況。

questions.prompt: Despite Friday's snowstorm, {{q9}} at the premiere of 'The Lantern Keeper' was higher than the producers had predicted.

options.label: A
options.text: attendance

options.label: B
options.text: attendees

options.label: C
options.text: attendants

options.label: D
options.text: attend

explanation.summary_zh: 空格是主詞，後接單數動詞 was 和 higher than predicted，需要表示「出席人數」的名詞 attendance。
explanation.reasoning_zh: 在 ___ at the premiere ... was higher 中，動詞 was 是單數，「比預期高」描述的是數量。attendance 指出席情形或出席人數，與 was higher 搭配合理。同字根的 attendees、attendants 都指人，而且是複數，與 was 不一致，語意也不對。

option_analysis.label: A
option_analysis.reason_zh: 正確。attendance was higher than predicted 意為「出席人數高於預期」。

option_analysis.label: B
option_analysis.reason_zh: attendees（出席者）是複數，與單數動詞 was 不一致；而且「出席者比較高」並不是在描述人數。

option_analysis.label: C
option_analysis.reason_zh: attendants 指服務人員或隨行人員（如 flight attendants），不是觀眾人數，也與 was 的單複數不一致。

option_analysis.label: D
option_analysis.reason_zh: attend 是動詞，不能當句子主詞。

explanation.takeaway_zh: 分辨同字根名詞：attendance 指出席（人數），attendee 指出席者，attendant 指服務人員；同時可用動詞單複數來檢查。

questions.prompt: Under the revised conference schedule, the closing panel discussion will {{q10}} place in Hall B instead of the main auditorium.

options.label: A
options.text: have

options.label: B
options.text: hold

options.label: C
options.text: take

options.label: D
options.text: make

explanation.summary_zh: 題目的固定框架是 will ___ place，應填 take，組成 take place，表示活動「舉行」。the closing panel discussion will take place in Hall B 意為閉幕座談將改在 B 廳舉行。
explanation.reasoning_zh: 空格後已經有 place，主詞是活動 the closing panel discussion。描述活動舉行時可說 the event takes place 或 the event is held；由主辦者主動辦理時，則說 organizers hold the event。The panel discussion will be held in Hall B 也是正確英文，但必須改成被動語態並刪去 place，等於改變了題目給的句型。在 will ___ place 這個框架中，只有 take 能與 place 組成「舉行」的意思。

option_analysis.label: A
option_analysis.reason_zh: 在現代標準英文中，have place 不是表示活動舉行的說法。

option_analysis.label: B
option_analysis.reason_zh: hold 以主動語態表示「舉辦」時，主詞是主辦者（The organizers will hold the panel discussion in Hall B）；活動當主詞時，要用被動的 will be held。在本題 will ___ place 的框架中，hold place 不表示活動舉行。

option_analysis.label: C
option_analysis.reason_zh: 正確。will take place in Hall B 意為「將在 B 廳舉行」。

option_analysis.label: D
option_analysis.reason_zh: make 與 place 的組合不表示活動舉行，不符合本句語意。

explanation.takeaway_zh: 活動本身當主詞、表示舉行時，可用 take place 或被動的 be held；以主辦者當主詞時，用 hold + 活動。看到 ___ place 的框架，表示舉行的組合是 take place。

questions.prompt: Every contract {{q11}} into French is reviewed by a second linguist before Clearword Language Services returns it to the client.

options.label: A
options.text: translating

options.label: B
options.text: translates

options.label: C
options.text: translate

options.label: D
options.text: translated

explanation.summary_zh: 空格在名詞 contract 之後，與 into French 一起修飾 contract。合約是被翻譯的對象，所以用過去分詞 translated，意思是 every contract (that is) translated into French。
explanation.reasoning_zh: 本句的主要動詞已經是 is reviewed（Every contract ... is reviewed by a second linguist），所以空格不能再填一個限定動詞。空格位於 contract 之後，與 into French 構成後位修飾語，可以看成省略了關係代名詞和 be 動詞的被動關係子句：every contract (that is / has been) translated into French。因此只需判斷分詞的主動或被動關係。合約接受翻譯的動作，所以用表示被動的過去分詞 translated。

option_analysis.label: A
option_analysis.reason_zh: translating 是現在分詞，放在名詞後修飾時，表示名詞主動執行動作，也就是合約自己在翻譯。本句的合約是被翻譯的文件，不是翻譯者，主被動關係不符。

option_analysis.label: B
option_analysis.reason_zh: translates 是限定動詞。句中已有主要動詞 is reviewed，又沒有 that 等關係詞連接。Every contract translates into French is reviewed 會出現兩個沒有連接的限定動詞，無法成句。

option_analysis.label: C
option_analysis.reason_zh: translate 是原形動詞，不能直接放在名詞後當修飾語。若當成限定動詞，它和單數主詞 every contract 不一致，而且句中已經有 is reviewed 當主要動詞。

option_analysis.label: D
option_analysis.reason_zh: 正確。every contract translated into French 即「每份被譯成法文的合約」。translated 表示合約接受翻譯的動作，整個修飾語之後接主要動詞 is reviewed。

explanation.takeaway_zh: 名詞後的空格若句中已有主要動詞，可以考慮用分詞片語修飾該名詞。名詞是動作的接受者時用過去分詞，名詞是動作的執行者時用現在分詞。

questions.prompt: Even when its forklifts show no signs of a fault, the Dunmore warehouse schedules {{q12}} maintenance every Monday to keep mechanical problems from developing during the holiday rush.

options.label: A
options.text: corrective

options.label: B
options.text: preventive

options.label: C
options.text: emergency

options.label: D
options.text: cosmetic

explanation.summary_zh: preventive maintenance 指「預防性保養」，也就是在設備尚未故障時先行保養，以免問題發生。句中的 show no signs of a fault 與 keep mechanical problems from developing 都支持這個答案。
explanation.reasoning_zh: 四個選項都能與 maintenance 搭配，所以要依句中線索判斷哪一個最符合語境。第一，Even when its forklifts show no signs of a fault 表示堆高機沒有故障跡象。第二，to keep mechanical problems from developing 說明保養是為了防止機械問題產生。第三，every Monday 表示保養是事先排定的固定行程。單看 every Monday 不足以排除其他選項，關鍵在於「沒有故障跡象」和「防止問題發生」這兩項線索。綜合來看，這是在故障出現前、為避免機械問題而安排的保養，最符合 preventive maintenance。

option_analysis.label: A
option_analysis.reason_zh: corrective maintenance（矯正性保養）指針對已出現的故障或缺陷進行修正。本句明說堆高機 show no signs of a fault，保養目的是防止問題 developing，不是修正既有故障，因此不符合語境。

option_analysis.label: B
option_analysis.reason_zh: 正確。schedules preventive maintenance every Monday 意為「每週一安排預防性保養」，符合「沒有故障跡象仍定期保養，以防機械問題發生」的句意。

option_analysis.label: C
option_analysis.reason_zh: emergency maintenance（緊急維修）指設備突然故障等緊急狀況下的搶修。本句的堆高機沒有故障跡象，保養是每週一事先排定、用來預防問題，與緊急搶修的情境不符。

option_analysis.label: D
option_analysis.reason_zh: cosmetic maintenance（外觀保養）指維持或改善外觀的保養。本句目的是 keep mechanical problems from developing，重點在機械問題而非外觀，因此不符合。

explanation.takeaway_zh: maintenance 前的形容詞說明保養的目的與時機：preventive（故障前預防）、corrective（修正既有故障）、emergency（緊急搶修）、cosmetic（外觀保養）。作答時要結合句中線索判斷，例如「沒有故障跡象」與「防止問題發生」。

questions.prompt: Staff who earned their forklift certification two years ago must take a {{q13}} course before the certification expires at the end of June.

options.label: A
options.text: refreshment

options.label: B
options.text: revival

options.label: C
options.text: refresher

options.label: D
options.text: recovery

explanation.summary_zh: refresher course 是給已受過訓練的人複習、更新所學內容的課程。本句的員工兩年前已取得堆高機證照，必須在證照六月底到期前上課，正符合複訓課程的情境。
explanation.reasoning_zh: 句中有兩條關鍵線索。Staff who earned their forklift certification two years ago 表示這些員工已受過訓練並取得證照；before the certification expires at the end of June 表示證照目前仍有效，課程要在到期前完成。這是已持證者在到期前接受的複習或更新訓練，也就是 refresher course。其他選項中，refreshment 與 refresher 字形相近，但指茶點、飲料，或提神、恢復精力，不指複訓課程；revival 指衰退或中斷後重新活躍、再度流行；recovery 指恢復健康或狀態，或找回失去的東西。在這個證照訓練的語境中，只有 refresher 能自然描述已持證員工在到期前上的課。

option_analysis.label: A
option_analysis.reason_zh: refreshment 與 refresher 字形相近，但 refreshment 指茶點、飲料，或提神、恢復精力，不表示複習、更新所學內容的訓練，無法描述證照到期前要上的課。

option_analysis.label: B
option_analysis.reason_zh: revival 指在衰退或中斷之後重新活躍、再度流行，例如某種風格的復興。本句說的是已持證員工在證照到期前上課，用 revival 無法自然描述這種複訓課程。

option_analysis.label: C
option_analysis.reason_zh: 正確。take a refresher course 意為參加複訓課程，符合「兩年前取得證照、須在到期前上課」的情境。

option_analysis.label: D
option_analysis.reason_zh: recovery 指恢復健康或狀態，或找回失去的東西。本句的課程是為證照即將到期的員工安排的，重點在複習、更新既有的操作資格，用 recovery 無法自然表達這種課程。

explanation.takeaway_zh: refresher course 指給已受訓者複習、更新的課程，常見於證照或資格到期前的訓練。要與字形相近的 refreshment（茶點、飲料；提神）區分，也不要與 revival（復興）、recovery（恢復、找回）混淆。

questions.prompt: Under the updated benefits plan, full-time employees who submit receipts for their gym membership fees can receive a {{q14}} of up to $500 per year.

explanation.reasoning_zh: 員工先自行繳交健身房會費，再提交收據，公司每年最多支付 500 美元，這正是 reimbursement（報銷）。commission、pension、dividend 也都是個人可能領到的錢，但給付原因各不相同，都不是依會費收據補回已付的費用。

option_analysis.label: A
option_analysis.reason_zh: 正確。a reimbursement of up to $500 per year 意為「每年最高 500 美元的費用報銷」，與繳交會費收據的條件相符。

option_analysis.label: B
option_analysis.reason_zh: commission 是依銷售業績給付的佣金（a 5 percent commission on each sale），與繳交健身房會費收據無關。

option_analysis.label: C

explanation.takeaway_zh: 與「錢」有關的商業名詞要看給付原因：reimbursement（報銷已付費用）、commission（銷售佣金）、pension（退休金）、dividend（股利）。

questions.prompt: Because the medieval manuscripts are highly {{q15}} to light, the curators will display them in dimmed cases and rotate them every three months.

explanation.reasoning_zh: 後半句的保護措施（dimmed cases、每三個月輪替）說明手稿容易受光線影響。sensitive to 表示容易受某事物影響。四個選項同字根，必須靠語意區分。

option_analysis.label: A

questions.prompt: The native-plant garden beside the Elmwood Public Library {{q16}} by Greenhollow Landscape Design and will open to visitors in May.

options.label: B
options.text: was designed

options.label: C
options.text: was designing

options.label: D

explanation.summary_zh: 花園是「被設計」的對象，後面又有 by + 設計公司，需要被動語態 was designed。
explanation.reasoning_zh: 主詞 The native-plant garden 是設計動作的接受者，by Greenhollow Landscape Design 是執行者，因此用 be + 過去分詞。此外，空格與 will open 以 and 並列，兩邊都必須是主要動詞。

option_analysis.label: A
option_analysis.reason_zh: 若視為主動過去式，表示花園「設計了」某物，主詞與動作的關係顛倒；若視為修飾 garden 的分詞，前半句就缺少主要動詞，無法與 and will open 並列。

option_analysis.label: B
option_analysis.reason_zh: 正確。was designed by Greenhollow 意為「由 Greenhollow 設計」。

option_analysis.label: C

option_analysis.label: D
option_analysis.reason_zh: has designed 是主動的現在完成式，會變成花園設計了某物，與 by Greenhollow Landscape Design 所表示的執行者不合。

explanation.takeaway_zh: 主詞是動作接受者、句中又有 by + 執行者時，考慮 be + 過去分詞的被動語態。

questions.prompt: {{q17}} the author's train was delayed by a signal problem, the book signing at Quill & Fern began forty minutes later than advertised.

options.label: A
options.text: Because

options.label: B
options.text: Although

options.label: C
options.text: Unless

options.label: D
options.text: Whereas

explanation.summary_zh: 作者的火車誤點，導致簽書會延後四十分鐘開始，前後為因果關係，用 Because。
explanation.reasoning_zh: 從屬子句說明火車因號誌問題誤點，主要子句說簽書會比公告時間晚開始。前者是後者的原因，所以用表示原因的連接詞。

option_analysis.label: A
option_analysis.reason_zh: 正確。Because 引導原因：因為火車誤點，所以簽書會延後。

option_analysis.label: B
option_analysis.reason_zh: Although 表示讓步（儘管…卻…），但誤點與延後是一致的結果，沒有與預期相反。

option_analysis.label: C
option_analysis.reason_zh: Unless 意為「除非」，表示條件；本句兩件事都已發生，「除非火車誤點，否則簽書會延後」不合邏輯。

option_analysis.label: D
option_analysis.reason_zh: Whereas 用於對照兩件不同的事，本句兩個子句不是對比關係。

explanation.takeaway_zh: 選從屬連接詞前，先判斷兩子句的邏輯：原因用 because，讓步用 although，條件用 unless，對照用 whereas。

questions.prompt: At Brightway Home Goods, all returned appliances are {{q18}} inspected by a technician before they can be placed back on the sales floor.

explanation.reasoning_zh: are inspected 是被動語態，空格插在 be 動詞與過去分詞之間，修飾 inspect 這個動作，表示「徹底地檢查」，所以要用副詞。

option_analysis.label: A
option_analysis.reason_zh: thorough 是形容詞，不能修飾 inspected 所表達的動作。

option_analysis.label: B
option_analysis.reason_zh: thoroughness 是名詞，放在 are 與 inspected 之間無法構成正確結構。

option_analysis.label: D
option_analysis.reason_zh: more thorough 仍是形容詞（比較級），不能修飾動作，句中也沒有比較對象。

questions.prompt: One of the proposals that the association's board members reviewed last week {{q19}} to establish a mentoring program for newly certified accountants.

options.label: A
options.text: aim

options.label: B
options.text: aims

options.label: C
options.text: are aiming

options.label: D
options.text: have aimed

explanation.summary_zh: 主要子句的主詞核心是第三人稱單數的 One。四個選項都是現在時間的形式，與 One 一致的是 aims。
explanation.reasoning_zh: that the association's board members reviewed last week 是修飾 proposals 的關係子句，這個子句的主詞是 board members，動詞是 reviewed。proposals 位於 of 片語中，不決定主要動詞的形式。空格是整句的主要動詞，主詞核心是第三人稱單數的 One，所以要選第三人稱單數形式 aims。

option_analysis.label: A
option_analysis.reason_zh: aim 是原形，也是非第三人稱單數的現在式，用於 I、you、we、they 或複數主詞（如 The proposals aim to...）。本句主詞核心是第三人稱單數的 One，因此不用 aim。選 aim 等於誤把 proposals 或 board members 當成主要動詞的主詞。

option_analysis.label: B
option_analysis.reason_zh: 正確。One ... aims to establish... 意為「其中一項提案旨在設立……」，aims 與單數主詞 One 一致。

option_analysis.label: C
option_analysis.reason_zh: are aiming 的 are 與單數主詞 One 不一致；若用進行式，本句應為 is aiming。

option_analysis.label: D
option_analysis.reason_zh: have aimed 的 have 與第三人稱單數主詞 One 不一致；若用現在完成式，本句應為 has aimed。

explanation.takeaway_zh: 主詞很長時，先找核心名詞。以 One of the + 複數名詞 + 關係子句當主詞時（如本句），主要動詞與 One 一致；of 片語和關係子句裡的名詞不決定主要動詞的形式。

questions.prompt: At Polyglot Bridge, urgent translation requests of fewer than 2,000 words are usually completed {{q21}} 24 hours of submission.

options.text: during

options.label: C
options.text: between

options.label: D

explanation.summary_zh: within 24 hours of submission 表示「與提交時間相距不超過 24 小時」；翻譯必定在提交之後才完成，所以這裡是「提交後 24 小時內完成」。
explanation.reasoning_zh: within + 時間長度 + of + 某事件，表示在該事件前後一段時間的範圍內。本句的事件是 submission，而完成翻譯只可能在提交之後，所以語意為提交後 24 小時內。

option_analysis.label: A
option_analysis.reason_zh: 正確。completed within 24 hours of submission 意為「於提交後 24 小時內完成」。

option_analysis.label: B
option_analysis.reason_zh: during 接特定期間（during the first 24 hours），不用於「___ 24 hours of + 事件」這種表示時限的結構。

option_analysis.label: C
option_analysis.reason_zh: between 需要兩個端點（between Monday and Friday），句中只有一段時間長度。

option_analysis.label: D
option_analysis.reason_zh: across 表示「橫跨、遍及」，不用來表示完成的時限。

explanation.takeaway_zh: 表示「某事件後多久內」可用 within + 時間長度 + of + 事件；實際是之前或之後，要依事件的先後邏輯判斷。

questions.prompt: By the time the replacement conveyor belt is installed next Thursday, the dispatch team {{q22}} all of the backlogged orders by hand.

explanation.reasoning_zh: By the time 子句以現在式 is installed 表示未來事件（next Thursday）。主要子句要表達「到那個未來時點已經完成」，而 all of the backlogged orders 說明完成的範圍，因此用未來完成式最貼切。by the time 不一定都搭配未來完成式，過去情境可用過去完成式；本句的關鍵是參考時點在未來。

option_analysis.label: A
option_analysis.reason_zh: had packed 是過去完成式，以過去某時點為基準，與未來的 next Thursday 不符。

option_analysis.label: B
option_analysis.reason_zh: 正確。will have packed 表示到下週四輸送帶裝好時，團隊已用人工包完所有積壓訂單。

option_analysis.label: C
option_analysis.reason_zh: has packed 是現在完成式，以「現在」為基準，無法表示「到下週四為止」的完成。

explanation.takeaway_zh: 判斷完成式時，先找參考時點在過去、現在或未來，再看句意是否強調在該時點前完成。

questions.prompt: Renters must {{q24}} all generators and pressure washers at the Larkfield depot by 6 P.M. on the due date to avoid a late fee.

questions.prompt: The final dress rehearsal of the revised second act went {{q25}} smoothly, so the director let the cast leave an hour early.

questions.prompt: Volunteers at the Maple Row Community Garden have found the revised watering schedule far more {{q26}} than the previous weekly rotation.

options.label: D
options.text: manageable

explanation.summary_zh: 在 find + 受詞 + 形容詞的句型中，形容詞當受詞補語來描述受詞。far more manageable than 表示新的澆水排程「容易應付得多」。
explanation.reasoning_zh: 在 have found the revised watering schedule far more ___ than... 中，the revised watering schedule 是受詞，空格描述它的性質，並與 more ... than 形成比較，因此需要形容詞 manageable。

option_analysis.label: A
option_analysis.reason_zh: manage 是動詞，不能放在 more ... than 中描述排程的性質。

option_analysis.label: B
option_analysis.reason_zh: management 是名詞。名詞有時能當受詞補語，但「覺得排程是比較多的管理」說不通；此處要描述排程的性質。

option_analysis.label: C
option_analysis.reason_zh: manageably 是副詞，不能當受詞補語來描述 schedule 這個名詞。

option_analysis.label: D
option_analysis.reason_zh: 正確。found the schedule far more manageable 意為「覺得新排程容易處理得多」。

explanation.takeaway_zh: find／make／keep + 受詞 + 補語時，若要描述受詞的性質或狀態，空格常需要形容詞。

questions.prompt: The Harbor Arts Museum's exhibition of early travel posters has been {{q27}} received by both critics and weekend visitors.

options.label: A
options.text: hotly

options.label: B
options.text: warmly

options.label: C
options.text: steeply

options.label: D
options.text: sharply

explanation.summary_zh: be warmly received 是常見搭配，意為「受到熱烈歡迎、廣受好評」。
explanation.reasoning_zh: received by critics and visitors 描述評論家與觀眾對展覽的反應。副詞 warmly 與 received 搭配，表示反應熱烈正面。其他副詞各有常見的搭配對象，與 received 連用時無法表達好評。

option_analysis.label: A
option_analysis.reason_zh: hotly 常與 debated、contested 搭配（hotly debated），不說 hotly received。

option_analysis.label: B
option_analysis.reason_zh: 正確。has been warmly received 意為「廣受好評」。

option_analysis.label: C
option_analysis.reason_zh: steeply 用於數字或價格急劇變化（prices rose steeply），不修飾 received。

option_analysis.label: D
option_analysis.reason_zh: sharply 常表示「急劇地」（fell sharply）或「嚴厲地」（sharply criticized），sharply received 不是自然搭配。

explanation.takeaway_zh: received 常見的副詞搭配有 warmly received、well received；hotly 則常配 debated。

questions.prompt: {{q28}} the annual plan requires a larger payment upfront, it saves subscribers about 20 percent compared with monthly billing.

options.label: A
options.text: Despite

options.label: B
options.text: In spite of

options.label: C
options.text: Although

options.label: D
options.text: Because of

explanation.summary_zh: 空格後是完整子句（主詞 the annual plan + 動詞 requires），需要連接詞；語意又是讓步，所以選 Although。
explanation.reasoning_zh: ___ the annual plan requires a larger payment upfront 有主詞和動詞，是子句，前面必須用連接詞。前後語意是「雖然年繳方案前期要付較多，卻能省下約 20%」，屬於讓步關係。

option_analysis.label: A
option_analysis.reason_zh: Despite 是介系詞，後接名詞或動名詞（despite the larger payment），不能直接接子句。

option_analysis.label: B
option_analysis.reason_zh: In spite of 也是介系詞片語，同樣不能直接接 the annual plan requires... 這個子句。

option_analysis.label: C
option_analysis.reason_zh: 正確。Although 引導讓步子句，連接「前期付款較多」與「整體較省錢」。

option_analysis.label: D
option_analysis.reason_zh: Because of 是介系詞片語，不能接子句；它表示原因，也與本句的讓步語意不符。

explanation.takeaway_zh: 空格後若是「主詞 + 動詞」的完整子句，需要連接詞；若是名詞片語，則可用介系詞。

questions.prompt: Fernway Landscape Design {{q29}} the new drip irrigation system at the Westbrook office park last Friday, two days ahead of schedule.

options.label: A
options.text: installed

options.label: B
options.text: installs

options.label: C
options.text: will install

options.label: D
options.text: has installed

explanation.summary_zh: last Friday 是明確的過去時間，用過去簡單式 installed。
explanation.reasoning_zh: 句中的 last Friday 指出動作發生在過去某個特定時間，two days ahead of schedule 說明這件事提前完成，所以用過去式描述該事件。

option_analysis.label: A
option_analysis.reason_zh: 正確。installed ... last Friday 表示上週五完成安裝。

option_analysis.label: B
option_analysis.reason_zh: installs 是現在簡單式，與 last Friday 的過去時間不符。

option_analysis.label: C
option_analysis.reason_zh: will install 是未來式，與已經過去的 last Friday 矛盾。

option_analysis.label: D
option_analysis.reason_zh: 現在完成式 has installed 一般不與 last Friday 這類明確的過去時間連用。

explanation.takeaway_zh: 句中有 last Friday、yesterday、two weeks ago 等明確的過去時間時，通常用過去簡單式。

questions.prompt: Because few applicants have met the requirements, Talbridge Recruiting is considering {{q30}} the application deadline for its logistics coordinator position by one week.

options.label: A
options.text: to extend

options.label: B
options.text: extend

options.label: C
options.text: extending

options.label: D
options.text: extended

explanation.summary_zh: consider 表示「考慮做某事」時接動名詞，所以是 considering extending。
explanation.reasoning_zh: 在 is considering ___ the application deadline 中，空格表示「延長截止日期」這件事，是 consider 的受詞，本身又帶有受詞 the application deadline。consider 表示考慮做某事時，標準用法是接 V-ing。

option_analysis.label: A
option_analysis.reason_zh: consider 表示「考慮做某事」時接動名詞，不接 to 不定詞，is considering to extend 不是標準用法。

option_analysis.label: B
option_analysis.reason_zh: 原形動詞 extend 不能直接接在 is considering 後面當受詞。

option_analysis.label: C
option_analysis.reason_zh: 正確。is considering extending the deadline 意為「正在考慮延長截止日期」。

option_analysis.label: D
option_analysis.reason_zh: 過去分詞 extended 不能當 consider 的受詞，無法表達「延長截止日期這件事」。

explanation.takeaway_zh: 表示「考慮做某事」用 consider + V-ing；suggest、avoid、postpone 等動詞也常接動名詞。

content.title: Follow-Up Request: Borrowed Material Samples
content.scenario_summary: The resource librarian at Halvorsen & Adeyemi Architects posts a follow-up notice after an earlier request to return material samples borrowed for a client presentation. Fourteen samples are still missing. A list of these samples, with the name of the employee who signed out each one, is posted outside the library. Staff must return the samples by May 15 because the supplier that lent them will collect them on May 16. The studio pays replacement costs only for samples that are not returned, and the supplier accepts damaged samples at no charge.

blocks.text: Halvorsen & Adeyemi Architects: Resource Library Notice
To: All design and visualization staff
From: Nadia Ferreira, Resource Librarian
Date: May 12
Subject: Follow-up request: borrowed material samples
On April 28, we asked everyone who borrowed material samples for the Dunmore Arts Center presentation to return them by May 9. Thank you to those who responded {{q1}}.

However, fourteen samples are still missing, including two limestone tiles and three oak veneer panels. A list of the {{q2}} samples has been posted on the board outside the library. {{q3}} If your name is on the list, please check your desk, model boxes, and presentation bags, and bring anything you find to the library desk by May 15.

These samples are on {{q4}} from our supplier, Corvale Surfaces, which will collect them on May 16. Under our agreement, the studio must pay the full replacement cost of any sample that is not returned. Corvale will accept chipped or scratched samples at no charge, so please return damaged ones as well.
Please contact me at extension 214 with any questions.

questions.prompt: Choose the best answer for blank {{q1}}.

options.label: A
options.text: prompt

options.label: B
options.text: promptly

options.label: C
options.text: promptness

options.label: D
options.text: prompted

explanation.summary_zh: 空格說明 responded「如何回應」。本句要表達「迅速地回應」，因此需要副詞 promptly。
explanation.reasoning_zh: 在 Thank you to those who responded ___. 中，who responded 是修飾 those 的關係子句。responded 在此沒有接受詞，回應的對象就是前一句提到的歸還請求，所以空格要補充「回應的方式」。通知作者是在感謝及時處理歸還請求的同仁。填入副詞 promptly 後，意思是「感謝那些迅速回應的同仁」，也呼應前句「5 月 9 日前歸還」的期限。prompted 拼法相近，但作過去式表示「促使了」，作過去分詞表示「被促使」。在限定動詞 responded 之後，不能直接接單獨的 prompted，需要改成 when prompted 這類結構；而且兩種用法都沒有「迅速地」的意思。

option_analysis.label: A
option_analysis.reason_zh: prompt 可作形容詞「迅速的」、動詞「促使」或名詞「提示」。本句要描述 responded 這個動作進行得快，應使用副詞 promptly；who responded prompt 不是表達「迅速回應」的自然說法。若把 prompt 當名詞，則要說 responded to a prompt，句意也與感謝歸還樣品的同仁不符。

option_analysis.label: B
option_analysis.reason_zh: 正確。副詞 promptly 修飾 responded，表示「迅速地回應」。句子結構完整，也與前句的歸還期限相呼應。

option_analysis.label: C
option_analysis.reason_zh: promptness 是名詞，意思是「迅速、及時」。本句的 responded 後面不直接接這個名詞；若要用名詞表達，需要改成 with promptness 這類介系詞片語，因此不能直接填入。

option_analysis.label: D
option_analysis.reason_zh: prompted 作過去式表示「促使了」，例如 The request prompted replies（這項請求促使了回覆）；作過去分詞則表示「被促使」。在限定動詞 responded 之後不能直接接單獨的 prompted，要用 when prompted 這類結構才能成立。此外，兩種用法都沒有「迅速地」的意思，無法表達本通知要感謝的迅速回應。

evidence.quote: Thank you to those who responded {{q1}}.
to return them by May 9

explanation.takeaway_zh: 本題空格修飾 responded，說明回應的方式，因此選副詞 promptly。字形相近的選項要分清楚：prompted 作過去式表示「促使了」，作過去分詞表示「被促使」，兩者都不能代替表示「迅速地」的 promptly。

questions.prompt: Choose the best answer for blank {{q2}}.

options.label: A
options.text: remarkable

options.label: B
options.text: prominent

options.label: C
options.text: exceptional

options.label: D
options.text: outstanding

explanation.summary_zh: 前一句說 fourteen samples are still missing，公布的清單應是「尚未歸還的」樣品；outstanding 在此表示「尚未處理完、未歸還的」。
explanation.reasoning_zh: 許多學習者熟悉 outstanding 作「傑出的」，但在付款、工作或借出物品等情境中，它也可表示「尚未完成、尚未結清」，例如 outstanding payments（尚未支付的款項）。本句緊接在「仍有十四件樣品下落不明」之後，後文又請名字在清單上的人找出樣品並送回圖書室，可見清單列的是還沒歸還的樣品。其他三個選項都是評價品質或醒目程度，而通知中完全沒有比較樣品的優劣，因此不符上下文。

option_analysis.label: A
option_analysis.reason_zh: remarkable 意為「非凡的、值得注意的」，是對品質或特色的評價。通知的重點是找回仍未歸還的樣品，並非挑出特別出色的樣品，因此語意不連貫。

option_analysis.label: B
option_analysis.reason_zh: prominent 意為「顯眼的、重要的」，描述外觀或地位。前一句談的是樣品仍下落不明，清單的用途是協助找回，與樣品是否顯眼無關。

option_analysis.label: C
option_analysis.reason_zh: exceptional 意為「特別出色的、不尋常的」，同樣屬於品質評價。前文只說樣品尚未歸還，沒有任何關於樣品好壞的內容，填入後與上下文脫節。

option_analysis.label: D
option_analysis.reason_zh: 正確。outstanding 在此作「尚未歸還的」解，直接承接前句的 still missing，也與後文請同仁找出並歸還樣品的指示一致。

evidence.quote: However, fourteen samples are still missing
A list of the {{q2}} samples has been posted on the board outside the library.

explanation.takeaway_zh: 遇到熟悉的多義字時，不要直接套用最熟悉的字義；outstanding 在借還、付款或待辦事項的情境中，可表示「尚未完成或未結清」，要由前後文判斷。

questions.prompt: Choose the best answer for blank {{q3}}.

options.label: A
options.text: Each entry also gives the name of the employee who signed out that sample.

options.label: B
options.text: To protect staff privacy, the list does not show who signed out each sample.

options.label: C
options.text: Each entry also gives the name of the supplier contact who provided that sample.

options.label: D
options.text: Borrowers' names will be added to the entries once every sample is returned.

explanation.summary_zh: 空格後的 If your name is on the list 是對收到通知的工作室同仁說的，並請名列清單的人檢查自己的物品。因此，空格句應說明清單上的姓名就是借用各樣品的同仁。四個選項中，只有 A 明確提供這項連結。
explanation.reasoning_zh: 前一句說清單已公布在圖書室外的布告欄，空格應補充清單的內容。後一句要求名字在清單上的人檢查自己的桌面、模型盒與簡報袋，並在 5 月 15 日前把找到的物品送到圖書室櫃台。要讓這項指示順理成章，清單上目前就必須列有借用各樣品的同仁姓名。A 的 Each entry 承接前句的清單；the name of the employee who signed out that sample 說明每筆項目都附有登記借用該樣品的員工姓名，正好為後句的 your name 提供依據。B 表示清單不顯示借用者，後句因此失去依據。D 說借用者姓名要等所有樣品歸還後才會加上，表示目前清單上還沒有借用者姓名，與後句以目前借用者姓名為前提的指示不符。C 說每筆項目附有提供樣品的供應商聯絡人姓名。這句並未排除清單上另有其他姓名，但也沒有說明清單列出借用樣品的同仁，因此無法建立「清單上的姓名＝借用樣品的同仁」這項連結。讀者無從得知後句的 your name 為何會出現在清單上，也不知道為何名列其中就要檢查自己的物品。A 明確提供了這項連結，所以是最能銜接前後句的選項。

option_analysis.label: A
option_analysis.reason_zh: 正確。每筆項目都附上登記借用該樣品的員工姓名，讓下一句 If your name is on the list 有明確依據，也說明了為何要請這些同仁檢查自己的桌面、模型盒和簡報袋。

option_analysis.label: B
option_analysis.reason_zh: 此句表示為了保護隱私，清單不顯示每件樣品由誰登記借用。這樣一來，下一句請名字在清單上的同仁找出並歸還樣品時，就缺少借用者姓名作為依據，與後句的指示不符。

option_analysis.label: C
option_analysis.reason_zh: 此句說每筆項目附有提供該樣品的供應商 Corvale Surfaces 聯絡人姓名。它沒有說清單上只有這些姓名，但也完全沒有提到借用樣品的同仁。後句以 If your name is on the list 對設計與視覺化同仁說話，並請名列清單的人檢查自己的物品；這項指示需要前句先說明清單上列有借用者姓名。C 缺少這項連結，無法像 A 一樣為後句的 your name 提供依據，因此不是最佳答案。

option_analysis.label: D
option_analysis.reason_zh: 此句說借用者的姓名要等所有樣品都歸還後才會加到清單項目上，表示目前清單上還沒有借用者姓名。然而，下一句已經在請目前名列清單的同仁於 5 月 15 日前找出並送回樣品。這項指示以清單上現有的借用者姓名為前提，因此與 D 無法銜接。

evidence.quote: To: All design and visualization staff
A list of the {{q2}} samples has been posted on the board outside the library.
If your name is on the list, please check your desk, model boxes, and presentation bags, and bring anything you find to the library desk by May 15.
from our supplier, Corvale Surfaces

explanation.takeaway_zh: 做句子填空時，除了確認主題相同，也要檢查後句預設了哪些事實。本題後句以 your name 對讀者說話，空格句必須明確說明清單上列有借用樣品的同仁姓名。如果句子只說清單附有其他人的姓名（例如供應商聯絡人），卻沒有說明借用者姓名，就無法順利銜接後句。

questions.prompt: Choose the best answer for blank {{q4}}.

options.label: A
options.text: order

options.label: B
options.text: credit

options.label: C
options.text: loan

options.label: D
options.text: hold

explanation.summary_zh: 同一句說供應商 which will collect them on May 16（將於 5 月 16 日收回樣品），前文又說同仁 borrowed 樣品，可見樣品是向供應商借來的，因此用 be on loan from（向……借用）。
explanation.reasoning_zh: 單看 These samples are on ___ from our supplier 這一部分，on order 似乎也說得通。但同句的 which will collect them 和前文的 borrowed 都顯示這是借用關係。供應商 Corvale Surfaces 要在 5 月 16 日把樣品收回；後一句又說，依照協議，工作室必須為未歸還的樣品支付全額更換費用，這也符合借用後歸還的安排。on loan from our supplier 正好表達「向供應商借來」。其他選項分別表示尚未到貨、延後付款或保留擱置，都不是本文描述的借用與歸還關係。

option_analysis.label: A
option_analysis.reason_zh: on order 表示「已下訂但尚未交貨」，描述的是等待交貨的狀態。同句的 which will collect them 表示供應商要把樣品收回，前文也說同仁已經 borrowed 這些樣品，這與等待交貨的情況不符。

option_analysis.label: B
option_analysis.reason_zh: on credit 表示先取得商品、延後付款，描述的是付款方式，不是借用關係。本文說同仁 borrowed 樣品，供應商之後會 collect them，只有未歸還的樣品才須支付更換費用；這是借用與歸還的安排，on credit 無法表達。

option_analysis.label: C
option_analysis.reason_zh: 正確。on loan from our supplier 意為「向供應商借用」，與同句供應商將收回樣品、前文的 borrowed，以及未歸還須支付更換費用的約定一致。

option_analysis.label: D
option_analysis.reason_zh: on hold 表示「暫時保留」或「暫停」，指的是預留或擱置的狀態。on hold from our supplier 在此無法表達「向這家供應商借來」，也無法呈現同句供應商將收回樣品、前文 borrowed 所描述的借用關係。

evidence.quote: These samples are on {{q4}} from our supplier, Corvale Surfaces, which will collect them on May 16.
we asked everyone who borrowed material samples
the studio must pay the full replacement cost of any sample that is not returned

explanation.takeaway_zh: on loan、on order、on credit、on hold 結構相似，意思卻不同。作答時先看同一句裡提示關係的字詞，例如 collect them，再用前文的 borrowed 等資訊確認文中描述的是借用、尚未到貨、延後付款，還是暫時保留。

content.title: Benefits Enrollment Fair Venue Change
content.scenario_summary: The HR department posts a notice moving its annual Benefits Enrollment Fair from Training Room 3B to the larger Atrium Hall in the Pembrook Building across the street because many employees registered. HR has sent registered employees' names to the lobby security desk, where they will receive visitor passes. The spare seats allow HR to extend the registration deadline, and the hall's streaming equipment lets employees who cannot attend in person watch an insurer's health-plan presentation online.

blocks.text: NOTICE: Benefits Enrollment Fair Venue Change
From: Human Resources
Posted: October 15

The Benefits Enrollment Fair on October 24 has been moved from Training Room 3B to the Atrium Hall in the Pembrook Building, across Fenwick Street from our main office. It will still run from 10:00 A.M. to 3:00 P.M. Employees who have already registered do not need to sign up again. We have sent {{q1}} names to the security desk in the Pembrook Building's lobby, where each attendee will receive a visitor pass.
We made the change because of the strong response to this year's fair. {{q2}} With the extra seating, we are also able to {{q3}} the October 18 registration deadline to October 22.

The Atrium Hall is also equipped for video streaming, so employees who cannot attend in {{q4}} can watch Corvane Health's 11:00 A.M. presentation on next year's medical plans. A viewing link will be posted on the HR intranet that morning.

questions.prompt: Choose the best answer for blank {{q1}}.

options.label: A
options.text: its

options.label: B
options.text: their

options.label: C
options.text: his

options.label: D
options.text: her

explanation.summary_zh: 空格指上一句「已報名的員工」的名字。先行詞是複數的人，所以用所有格 their。
explanation.reasoning_zh: 空格後接名詞 names，需要一個所有格限定詞說明「誰的名字」。單看這一句，their、his、her 都可能接上，必須回到前一句才能判斷。前一句的主詞是 Employees who have already registered（已報名的員工），是複數的人。本句接著說明他們不必重新報名的原因：人資部已把這些員工的名字送到大廳保全櫃台，員工到場後就在那裡領取訪客證。因此空格應填能指回這個複數先行詞的 their。

option_analysis.label: A
option_analysis.reason_zh: its 是單數所有格，通常指單一事物或機構。空格前的單數名詞只有 the Benefits Enrollment Fair（及代稱它的 It）和 the Pembrook Building 等。活動或建築物都沒有要送去保全櫃台、讓與會者領證用的名字，所以指涉不通。

option_analysis.label: B
option_analysis.reason_zh: 正確。their 指前一句的 Employees who have already registered，數一致，語意也合理：人資部已送出這些員工的名字，所以他們不必再報名，到場即可領訪客證。

option_analysis.label: C
option_analysis.reason_zh: his 必須指前文提過的一位男性。空格前公告沒有提到任何個人，找不到先行詞。前一句談的也是多位員工，並非某一個人。

option_analysis.label: D
option_analysis.reason_zh: her 必須指前文提過的一位女性，同樣找不到先行詞。句尾的 each attendee 出現在空格之後，而且是泛指每位與會者，不能讓 her 指涉成立。

evidence.quote: Employees who have already registered do not need to sign up again.
We have sent {{q1}} names to the security desk in the Pembrook Building's lobby, where each attendee will receive a visitor pass.

explanation.takeaway_zh: 所有格限定詞題：先問空格後的名詞屬於「誰」，再往前文找人稱、數、性別都吻合，而且語意說得通的先行詞。

questions.prompt: Choose the best answer for blank {{q2}}.

options.label: A
options.text: Fewer than 100 employees have registered, so a smaller room would have been enough.

options.label: B
options.text: The new hall seats 120 people, exactly as many as the training room does.

options.label: C
options.text: More than 260 employees have registered, and the new hall can seat up to 400.

options.label: D
options.text: More than 260 employees have registered, which fills every seat in the new hall.

explanation.summary_zh: 只有 C 同時交代「報名踴躍」和「新場地座位多於報名人數」，才能接到下一句的 the extra seating 與延長報名期限。
explanation.reasoning_zh: 前一句說換場地是因為報名反應熱烈（strong response）。後一句以 With the extra seating 開頭，並說人資部因此能調整報名截止日、讓更多人報名。所以空格句要提供兩項資訊：報名人數多，以及新場地還有多出來的座位。C 說超過 260 人報名、新場地最多可容納 400 人，多出的座位正是 the extra seating 的來源，也說明了為何還能繼續收報名。

option_analysis.label: A
option_analysis.reason_zh: 說報名不到 100 人、較小的房間就夠用，與前一句「因報名反應熱烈而換場地」矛盾，也引不出後一句的多餘座位和延長報名。

option_analysis.label: B
option_analysis.reason_zh: 說新場地和訓練室一樣都是 120 席，那就沒有後一句所說的 extra seating。為了熱烈的報名反應搬到同樣大小的場地，也和換場地的理由不合。

option_analysis.label: C
option_analysis.reason_zh: 正確。超過 260 人報名呼應前句的 strong response；新場地可容納 400 人表示仍有空位，讓後句的 With the extra seating 有明確來源，並自然接到延長報名期限。

option_analysis.label: D
option_analysis.reason_zh: 報名人數和 C 相同，卻說新場地已全部坐滿。後一句提到有多餘座位，還能再開放報名，前後矛盾。

evidence.quote: We made the change because of the strong response to this year's fair.
With the extra seating, we are also able to {{q3}} the October 18 registration deadline to October 22.

explanation.takeaway_zh: 句子填空要同時對照前一句的因果和後一句的指涉詞（例如 the extra seating）。選項內容相近時，選能讓後文說法成立的那一句。

questions.prompt: Choose the best answer for blank {{q3}}.

options.label: A
options.text: extend

options.label: B
options.text: shorten

options.label: C
options.text: enforce

options.label: D
options.text: meet

explanation.summary_zh: 報名截止日從較早的 10 月 18 日改到較晚的 10 月 22 日，理由是座位增加，所以選 extend（延長）。
explanation.reasoning_zh: 空格所在的結構是「動詞＋the October 18 registration deadline＋to October 22」，意思是把原定的期限改到新日期。22 日比 18 日晚，句首的 With the extra seating 也說明還有空位可以再收報名，所以人資部是在延長截止日。extend a deadline to＋日期 表示「把期限延到某日」，日期方向和原因都吻合。

option_analysis.label: A
option_analysis.reason_zh: 正確。extend the deadline to October 22 表示把截止日延到 22 日，符合日期往後移，也符合「座位變多、可以再收報名」的原因。

option_analysis.label: B
option_analysis.reason_zh: shorten 是縮短期限，新的截止日應該提前；但 22 日比 18 日晚，方向相反。座位增加也不是縮短報名時間的理由。

option_analysis.label: C
option_analysis.reason_zh: enforce a deadline 是「嚴格執行期限」，表示照原日期辦理，和後面 to October 22（改到新日期）在結構與語意上都對不上。

option_analysis.label: D
option_analysis.reason_zh: meet a deadline 是「趕上期限」，指在期限前完成某事。本句是人資部在調整期限，而且 meet the deadline to October 22 無法表達改期。

evidence.quote: With the extra seating, we are also able to {{q3}} the October 18 registration deadline to October 22.

explanation.takeaway_zh: 選擇和 deadline 搭配的動詞時，要看句中日期的移動方向和原因：往後改期用 extend，照原日期執行用 enforce，在期限前完成用 meet。

questions.prompt: Choose the best answer for blank {{q4}}.

options.label: A
options.text: presence

options.label: B
options.text: attendance

options.label: C
options.text: appearance

options.label: D
options.text: person

explanation.summary_zh: attend in person 表示「親自出席」，和本句後半「可線上觀看簡報」形成對比。
explanation.reasoning_zh: 本句說新場地有視訊直播設備，所以無法親自到場的員工可以線上觀看 Corvane Health 的簡報；下一句也說會公布觀看連結。空格要表達「本人實際到場」，英文的慣用說法是 in person，常接在 attend、meet、apply 等動詞後面。另外三個名詞雖然都和「出席、在場、出現」有關，但放進 attend in ___ 都不是自然的英文。

option_analysis.label: A
option_analysis.reason_zh: presence 意為「在場」，常見用法是 in the presence of someone（在某人面前）。attend in presence 不是標準的英文說法。

option_analysis.label: B
option_analysis.reason_zh: in attendance 常用於 be in attendance（出席、在場）。放在 attend 後面語意重複，也不是自然的搭配。

option_analysis.label: C
option_analysis.reason_zh: in appearance 意為「外表上」，和能不能到現場參加無關。

option_analysis.label: D
option_analysis.reason_zh: 正確。attend in person 表示親自到場參加，正好和後文的視訊直播、線上觀看連結形成對比。

evidence.quote: The Atrium Hall is also equipped for video streaming, so employees who cannot attend in {{q4}} can watch Corvane Health's 11:00 A.M. presentation on next year's medical plans.
A viewing link will be posted on the HR intranet that morning.

explanation.takeaway_zh: 中文的「出席、在場」可能對應好幾個英文名詞，但要表示「親自參加」時用 attend in person。學片語時要連同介系詞和常搭配的動詞一起記。

content.title: Email: Label Size Change Before a Packing Orientation
content.scenario_summary: A training coordinator at Northgate Fulfillment emails packing shift supervisors after a major client, Brightline Retail, changes its shipping-label specification from 10 x 10 cm to 10 x 15 cm just before a new-staff packing orientation on Thursday. Supervisors must remove outdated practice sheets from their training folders and collect revised sheets on Wednesday. The printing exercise moves from Stations 1–4, whose printers cannot produce the larger label, to Stations 5–8, which were upgraded last month. The scanning exercise is unaffected because the barcode position and address fields stay the same. Supervisors should point out the size difference to trainees who saw the old label during their interviews.

documents.title: Label size change for Thursday's orientation

blocks.text: To: Packing Shift Supervisors
From: Adaeze Okafor
Subject: Label size change for Thursday's orientation
Dear shift supervisors,

Yesterday, Brightline Retail told us that its shipping labels must now measure 10 by 15 centimeters instead of 10 by 10. This affects the packing orientation you are leading for new staff on Thursday.

The practice sheets in your training folders still show the old size. Please remove {{q1}} from the folders before Thursday so that trainees do not practice on an outdated layout. Revised sheets will be in your mailboxes on Wednesday afternoon.

Only the dimensions are different. The barcode position and address fields are {{q2}}, so the scanning exercise can run exactly as planned. {{q3}} For this reason, please conduct the printing exercise at Stations 5 through 8, which were upgraded last month.
Even a simple size change can be {{q4}} to trainees who were shown the old label during their interviews, so please point out the difference in your demonstration.
Thank you,
Adaeze Okafor, Training Coordinator, Northgate Fulfillment

questions.prompt: Choose the best answer for blank {{q1}}.

options.label: A
options.text: it

options.label: B
options.text: they

options.label: C
options.text: them

options.label: D
options.text: themselves

explanation.summary_zh: 空格是動詞 remove 的受詞，指的是前一句提到的 practice sheets（練習單，複數），因此要用複數受格代名詞 them。
explanation.reasoning_zh: 先找指涉對象。前一句說「你們訓練資料夾裡的練習單仍是舊尺寸」，接著要求「在週四前把＿＿從資料夾中移除」。能從資料夾中拿出來的是 practice sheets，這是複數名詞。空格位於 remove 之後當受詞，需要受格形式，所以選 them。若不看前一句，it 和 them 都可能成立，因此必須靠前文的複數先行詞才能判斷。

option_analysis.label: A
option_analysis.reason_zh: it 是單數受格代名詞，放在受詞位置文法上可行，但指涉對不上。前文可被移除的是複數的 practice sheets；附近的單數名詞 the old size（舊尺寸）是一種規格，不是能從資料夾中取出的東西。

option_analysis.label: B
option_analysis.reason_zh: they 是主格代名詞。雖然單複數與 practice sheets 相符，但放在 remove 後面當受詞時格位錯誤，應改用受格 them。

option_analysis.label: C
option_analysis.reason_zh: 正確。them 是複數受格，指前一句的 practice sheets。句意為「請在週四前把這些練習單從資料夾中移除，以免學員用過時的版面練習」。

option_analysis.label: D
option_analysis.reason_zh: themselves 是反身代名詞。當它作動詞的直接受詞時，須與該子句的主詞同指。本句是祈使句，隱含主詞是 you（各位主管），若要用反身代名詞應為 yourselves；而且「把自己從資料夾中移除」語意也不通。

evidence.quote: The practice sheets in your training folders still show the old size.
Please remove {{q1}} from the folders before Thursday

explanation.takeaway_zh: 代名詞題要先回到前文找出它所指的名詞，確認單複數，以及該名詞是否為能承受這個動作（此處為「被移除」）的對象。接著依空格在句中的角色（主詞或受詞等）選出正確的格。

questions.prompt: Choose the best answer for blank {{q2}}.

options.label: A
options.text: unchanged

options.label: B
options.text: undecided

options.label: C
options.text: unreadable

options.label: D
options.text: unnecessary

explanation.summary_zh: 前一句說「只有尺寸不同」，空格後又說掃描練習可以「完全照原計畫」進行，所以條碼位置與地址欄位應是「沒有改變的」，答案為 unchanged。
explanation.reasoning_zh: so 引導結果：條碼位置和地址欄位處於某種狀態，所以掃描練習能照原計畫進行。前句 Only the dimensions are different（只有尺寸不同）也表示尺寸以外的項目維持原樣，因此掃描練習不受影響。

option_analysis.label: A
option_analysis.reason_zh: 正確。unchanged 意為「未改變的」，呼應前句「只有尺寸不同」，也合理說明為何掃描練習可以照原計畫進行。

option_analysis.label: B
option_analysis.reason_zh: undecided 意為「尚未決定的」。若條碼位置還沒決定，掃描練習就無法「照原計畫」進行；而前句已說只有尺寸不同，表示其他規格是確定的，語意矛盾。

option_analysis.label: C
option_analysis.reason_zh: unreadable 意為「無法讀取的」。條碼若無法讀取，掃描練習反而會受影響，與 so 後面「可照原計畫進行」的結果相反。

option_analysis.label: D
option_analysis.reason_zh: unnecessary 意為「不必要的」。說條碼位置和地址欄位「不必要」，無法推出掃描練習可以照常進行，前後缺乏因果關係。

evidence.quote: Only the dimensions are different.
so the scanning exercise can run exactly as planned.

explanation.takeaway_zh: 詞彙題可利用 so 等因果連接詞前後的邏輯，再搭配前句的限定線索（如 Only ... are different），找出能讓原因與結果相互吻合的字。

questions.prompt: Choose the best answer for blank {{q3}}.

options.label: A
options.text: The printers at Stations 5 through 8, however, cannot produce the larger labels.

options.label: B
options.text: The printers at Stations 1 through 4 have already been set up for the larger labels.

options.label: C
options.text: The printing exercise, however, has been dropped from Thursday's schedule.

options.label: D
options.text: The printers at Stations 1 through 4, however, cannot produce the larger labels.

explanation.summary_zh: 空格前說掃描練習可照常進行，空格後用 For this reason 要求把列印練習改到「上個月升級過的」5 至 8 號工作站。因此空格必須說明 1 至 4 號工作站的印表機無法列印較大的新標籤。
explanation.reasoning_zh: For this reason 需要前一句提供原因。下一句的行動是「在 5–8 號工作站進行列印練習」，合理的原因是其他工作站（1–4 號）印不出較大的標籤。D 句中的 however 也與前句「掃描練習可照常進行」形成對比：掃描沒問題，列印卻有問題。

option_analysis.label: A
option_analysis.reason_zh: 這句說 5–8 號站的印表機無法列印大標籤，但下一句卻要大家到 5–8 號站做列印練習，工作站編號與後文矛盾。

option_analysis.label: B
option_analysis.reason_zh: 這句說 1–4 號站已設定好大標籤，那就沒有理由「因此」把列印練習改到 5–8 號站，For this reason 失去依據。

option_analysis.label: C
option_analysis.reason_zh: 這句說列印練習已從週四行程中取消，但下一句仍要求在 5–8 號站進行列印練習，前後互相矛盾。

option_analysis.label: D
option_analysis.reason_zh: 正確。however 表示與前句「掃描照常」相對；1–4 號站的印表機無法印出較大標籤，正好成為下一句 For this reason 改到 5–8 號站的理由。

evidence.quote: so the scanning exercise can run exactly as planned.
For this reason, please conduct the printing exercise at Stations 5 through 8, which were upgraded last month.

explanation.takeaway_zh: 句子填空題要注意空格後的 For this reason、this 等字需要什麼內容作為前提，並逐一核對編號、肯定或否定、是否已發生等細節是否與上下文一致。

questions.prompt: Choose the best answer for blank {{q4}}.

options.label: A
options.text: confused

options.label: B
options.text: confusing

options.label: C
options.text: confusion

options.label: D
options.text: confusingly

explanation.summary_zh: 空格是 can be 後的形容詞補語，描述的是主詞 a simple size change（尺寸變更）。這項變更是「令人困惑」的來源，而感到困惑的人由 to trainees 帶出，所以用 confusing。
explanation.reasoning_zh: 本句骨架為 Even a simple size change can be ＿＿ to trainees...。空格描述的是主詞「尺寸變更」，不是緊接在後的 trainees（學員）。學員是感到困惑的人，在這個句子裡以 to trainees 的形式出現，表示「對學員而言」。形容「引起困惑的事物」用 confusing，be confusing to + 人 即「對某人來說令人困惑」。本題的陷阱在於空格附近出現「人」，容易讓人誤選 -ed 形。

option_analysis.label: A
option_analysis.reason_zh: confused 作形容詞時描述「感到困惑的」人，放在這裡會變成「尺寸變更本身感到困惑」，語意不通。若把它看成被動式，be confused 通常指「被混淆」，例如 be confused with another label，與後面的 to trainees 也接不起來。若想用 confused，須改寫成 trainees may be confused by the size change。

option_analysis.label: B
option_analysis.reason_zh: 正確。confusing 描述尺寸變更會讓人困惑，整句意為「即使只是單純的尺寸變更，對面試時看過舊標籤的學員來說也可能令人困惑，所以請在示範時指出差異」。

option_analysis.label: C
option_analysis.reason_zh: confusion 是名詞「困惑、混亂」。can be confusion to trainees 不是自然的說法；若要用名詞，通常會改寫成 cause confusion for trainees 或 be a source of confusion。

option_analysis.label: D
option_analysis.reason_zh: confusingly 是副詞，在這裡無法單獨作 be 的補語來描述主詞 a simple size change。副詞需要修飾形容詞等成分，例如 confusingly similar，本句沒有這樣的成分。

evidence.quote: Even a simple size change can be {{q4}} to trainees who were shown the old label during their interviews

explanation.takeaway_zh: 選 -ing 或 -ed 形容詞時，先找出空格實際描述的名詞，不要被距離最近的名詞誤導。在本句中，描述引起感受的事物（a size change）用 -ing 形；若要描述產生感受的人，通常改用 -ed 形，例如 trainees may be confused。

content.title: Chamber Breakfast Catering Follow-Up
content.scenario_summary: A local business article reports that the Harwick Chamber of Commerce sent Fennel & Rye, a Quarry Lane bistro, a follow-up request to cater its June, September and December breakfasts after enthusiastic member feedback on the March breakfast. The bistro charges about ten percent more per guest than the previous caterer, but the board approved the bookings anyway. At the March event, allergy questions to servers slowed the buffet line, so the chamber wants an ingredient card beside every dish. The owner will prepare the cards from the kitchen's recipe files and will add two member-suggested hot dishes in December.

blocks.text: Bistro Booked for Chamber Breakfasts

The Harwick Chamber of Commerce has asked Fennel & Rye, a Quarry Lane bistro, to cater its June, September, and December breakfasts. The follow-up request came a week after the restaurant served 85 guests at the chamber's March breakfast.

Events manager Priya Nolan said the request reflects the {{q1}} response from members. Of the 85 guests, 71 returned feedback forms, and nearly all rated the food "excellent." Fennel & Rye charges about ten percent more per guest than the previous caterer. {{q2}}, the chamber's board approved the bookings without debate.

Nolan asked the bistro to keep most of the March menu but requested one improvement. At that breakfast, guests with food allergies had to ask servers about each dish's ingredients, slowing the buffet line. {{q3}} Owner Marco Ruiz said his staff will prepare the cards using the kitchen's recipe files.
Ruiz also plans to add two hot dishes to the December menu, both of {{q4}} were suggested on the feedback forms.

questions.prompt: Choose the best answer for blank {{q1}}.

options.label: A
options.text: cautious

options.label: B
options.text: mixed

options.label: C
options.text: enthusiastic

options.label: D
options.text: limited

explanation.summary_zh: 下一句提到85位賓客中有71位交回回饋表，而且幾乎所有填表者都把餐點評為 excellent，可見會員反應熱烈，故選 (C) enthusiastic。
explanation.reasoning_zh: 空格是修飾 response 的形容詞，四個選項都是形容詞，放進句中文法都成立，因此必須靠上下文判斷語意方向。緊接的句子提供兩項具體證據：回收率高（71/85），評價也近乎一致地好（nearly all rated the food "excellent"）。再加上商會在三月早餐會一週後就提出後續的外燴邀約，這些資訊都指向「熱烈的」回應。

option_analysis.label: A
option_analysis.reason_zh: cautious 意為「謹慎保留的」。填表者幾乎都給予 excellent 的評價，這並不是有所保留的反應，與下一句矛盾。

option_analysis.label: B
option_analysis.reason_zh: mixed 意為「褒貶不一的」。文中只提到近乎一致的好評，沒有提到任何負面意見，因此不能說反應好壞參半。

option_analysis.label: C
option_analysis.reason_zh: enthusiastic 意為「熱烈的、熱情的」。高回收率加上近乎全數的 excellent 評價，正好支持「會員反應熱烈」，也說明商會為何提出後續預訂，為正確答案。

option_analysis.label: D
option_analysis.reason_zh: limited 意為「有限的、少量的」。85人中有71人交回回饋表，回應的數量並不少，評價也極佳，與「回應有限」不符。

evidence.quote: the request reflects the {{q1}} response from members
Of the 85 guests, 71 returned feedback forms, and nearly all rated the food "excellent."

explanation.takeaway_zh: 若四個形容詞選項放進空格後文法都通，就要到前後句尋找具體證據（例如回收數量、評分），判斷應填入正面、負面或中性的字。

questions.prompt: Choose the best answer for blank {{q2}}.

options.label: A
options.text: As a result

options.label: B
options.text: Even so

options.label: C
options.text: For example

options.label: D
options.text: In other words

explanation.summary_zh: 前一句說 Fennel & Rye 每位賓客的收費比先前的業者高約一成，這是不利因素；後一句卻說董事會毫無異議就通過預訂。兩者是讓步關係，故選 (B) Even so（儘管如此）。
explanation.reasoning_zh: 判斷連接副詞時，要看它前後兩句的邏輯關係。前句提出一項可能引起反對的事實（收費較高），後句則是在這個條件下仍然發生的結果（without debate 直接通過）。兩句的方向相反，因此用表示讓步的 Even so 最能清楚表達「雖然較貴，仍然通過」。

option_analysis.label: A
option_analysis.reason_zh: As a result 表示因果。文中並沒有說「收費較高」促成董事會無異議通過，兩件事的方向相反，不能用因果關係連接。

option_analysis.label: B
option_analysis.reason_zh: Even so 表示「儘管如此」，用來連接不利條件與仍然發生的結果。收費較高，董事會卻仍毫無異議地通過，語意吻合，為正確答案。

option_analysis.label: C
option_analysis.reason_zh: For example 用來舉例說明前句。董事會通過預訂並不是「收費較高」的例子。

option_analysis.label: D
option_analysis.reason_zh: In other words 用來換句話說、重述前句。「董事會通過預訂」並不是在重述「收費較高」，語意不符。

evidence.quote: Fennel & Rye charges about ten percent more per guest than the previous caterer.
{{q2}}, the chamber's board approved the bookings without debate.

explanation.takeaway_zh: 前句是不利條件，後句是仍然發生的結果時，可用 Even so、Nevertheless 等表示讓步的轉折語連接。

questions.prompt: Choose the best answer for blank {{q3}}.

options.label: A
options.text: The chamber has therefore asked for two extra servers to staff the buffet table.

options.label: B
options.text: The chamber has therefore asked guests to list any allergies when they register online.

options.label: C
options.text: The chamber has therefore asked the bistro to drop dishes that contain common allergens.

options.label: D
options.text: The chamber has therefore asked for a card listing the ingredients beside every dish.

explanation.summary_zh: 下一句說老闆會用廚房的食譜檔案製作 the cards，表示前面必須先出現「卡片」。只有 (D) 提出在每道菜旁放置列出成分的卡片，同時也能解決前一句「過敏賓客必須逐一詢問成分」的問題。
explanation.reasoning_zh: 前一句描述三月份活動的問題：有食物過敏的賓客必須向服務人員詢問每道菜的成分，拖慢了取餐隊伍。四個選項都是商會「因此」提出的改善要求，單看前句，每一項都說得通。決定答案的是後一句：定冠詞片語 the cards 需要一個已提過的先行詞，而 recipe files（食譜檔案）正是成分資訊的來源。只有 D 同時與前後句銜接。

option_analysis.label: A
option_analysis.reason_zh: 增加兩名服務人員或許能讓隊伍變快，但後一句的 the cards 找不到指涉對象，「用食譜檔案製作」也和增派人手無關。

option_analysis.label: B
option_analysis.reason_zh: 請賓客在線上報名時填寫過敏資訊，同樣是針對過敏問題的做法，但文中沒有任何和報名有關的卡片，後一句的 the cards 無法銜接。

option_analysis.label: C
option_analysis.reason_zh: 刪除含常見過敏原的菜色屬於菜單調整，但後一句說的是「製作卡片」，不是刪減菜色，the cards 也沒有先行詞。

option_analysis.label: D
option_analysis.reason_zh: 「在每道菜旁放一張列出成分的卡片」讓賓客不必再詢問服務人員，回應了前句的問題。a card ... beside every dish 表示會有多張卡片，正好成為後句 the cards 的先行詞，而用食譜檔案製作成分卡片也合情合理，為正確答案。

evidence.quote: At that breakfast, guests with food allergies had to ask servers about each dish's ingredients, slowing the buffet line.
Owner Marco Ruiz said his staff will prepare the cards using the kitchen's recipe files.

explanation.takeaway_zh: 做句子填空題時，要同時檢查前句的問題與後句的指涉詞（the + 名詞、代名詞）。後句定冠詞所指的名詞，常常是排除其他選項的關鍵線索。

questions.prompt: Choose the best answer for blank {{q4}}.

options.label: A
options.text: which

options.label: B
options.text: them

options.label: C
options.text: whom

options.label: D
options.text: whose

explanation.summary_zh: 逗號後的部分需要一個關係代名詞，把它變成修飾 two hot dishes 的從屬子句。先行詞是事物，因此 both of which 正確，選 (A)。
explanation.reasoning_zh: 本句的主要子句是 Ruiz also plans to add two hot dishes to the December menu。逗號後的 both of ___ were suggested on the feedback forms 有自己的動詞 were suggested。由於兩部分之間只有逗號、沒有連接詞，後半部必須是從屬子句，因此空格要填關係代名詞。先行詞 two hot dishes 是事物，所以用 which。「數量詞 + of + which」可引導非限定關係子句，在此 both of which 整體作 were suggested 的主詞，意思是「這兩道菜都是回饋表上有人建議的」。

option_analysis.label: A
option_analysis.reason_zh: which 可指事物，both of which 引導非限定關係子句，修飾 two hot dishes，並作 were suggested 的主詞，結構與語意都正確。

option_analysis.label: B
option_analysis.reason_zh: them 是人稱代名詞，填入後 both of them were suggested... 本身是一個完整的獨立子句。它與前面的獨立子句之間只有逗號，在標準書面英文中會構成逗號接句（comma splice），需改用句號、分號、連接詞或關係子句。

option_analysis.label: C
option_analysis.reason_zh: whom 是指「人」的關係代名詞，但本句的先行詞 two hot dishes 是菜色，不是人，指涉不符。

option_analysis.label: D
option_analysis.reason_zh: whose 是所有格關係詞，後面要接名詞，例如 both of whose recipes。此處空格後直接接動詞 were，缺少被修飾的名詞，結構不完整。

evidence.quote: Ruiz also plans to add two hot dishes to the December menu, both of {{q4}} were suggested on the feedback forms.

explanation.takeaway_zh: 看到「逗號 + both/many/most 等數量詞 + of + 空格 + 動詞」的結構時，先判斷後半句是否需要成為從屬子句，再依先行詞選擇 which（事物）或 whom（人）。

content.title: Customer Review of an Art Supply Store's Rescheduled Workshops
content.scenario_summary: A customer posts an online review of Inkwell & Easel Art Supply, a store where she has long bought sketchbooks and gouache. The review focuses on the acrylic pouring workshops held in the store's back room. The workshops used to run only on Tuesday afternoons. After many customers asked for other times, the store moved them to Thursday evenings and Saturday mornings. The reviewer attended a Saturday session last weekend. She praises the instructor and notes that the $35 fee includes canvases, paints and pouring medium, and that aprons are provided. She warns Thursday participants that the store's lot closes before the evening session, so they should park on the street. She recommends the workshops to beginners.

documents.title: Customer Review: Inkwell & Easel Art Supply

blocks.text: Inkwell & Easel Art Supply, 48 Dunmore Street
Reviewer: Hana Okafor
Rating: 4 out of 5 stars
Posted: May 12

I have bought sketchbooks and gouache at Inkwell & Easel for years, but this review is about the acrylic pouring workshops held in the back room. Until March, they ran only on Tuesdays at 2:00 P.M., so people with daytime jobs missed out. After many customers asked for other times, the store revised the schedule. Sessions now take place on Thursdays at 6:30 P.M. and Saturdays at 10:00 A.M.

I finally joined a Saturday session last weekend. The instructor, Colm Byrne, explained each technique clearly and still helped everyone individually. The $35 fee covers canvases, paints and pouring medium, and aprons are provided, so just bring old shoes.

One caution for Thursday participants: the store's parking lot closes at 6:00 P.M., before the evening session starts, so plan to park on Dunmore Street. Otherwise, I highly recommend these workshops, especially for beginners.

questions.prompt: Why did Ms. Okafor write the review?

options.label: A
options.text: To praise the store's range of painting supplies

options.label: B
options.text: To recommend a class whose times were recently changed

options.label: C
options.text: To ask the store to keep its parking lot open later

options.label: D
options.text: To point out a mistake in a published workshop schedule

explanation.summary_zh: 評論者明確表示，這篇評論的主題是店內的壓克力流體畫工作坊。她說明店家應顧客要求修改了上課時段，並提到自己上週末參加了改期後的週六課程，結尾則大力推薦這些工作坊。所以寫作目的是推薦一個最近更改時段的課程。
explanation.reasoning_zh: 目的題要找作者寫這篇文章的主旨。第一段用 but 轉折，接著寫出 "this review is about the acrylic pouring workshops"，直接點明主題。之後交代時段從週二下午改為週四晚上與週六上午（the store revised the schedule）。結尾的 "I highly recommend these workshops" 則表明推薦。選項 B 的 "a class whose times were recently changed" 就是 workshops 加上 revised the schedule 的換句話說。

option_analysis.label: A
option_analysis.reason_zh: 她確實提到多年來在這家店買素描本和不透明水彩（gouache），但緊接著用 but 轉折，說明本評論是關於工作坊。購買用品只是背景，文中也沒有評論店內用品的種類，因此不是寫作目的。

option_analysis.label: B
option_analysis.reason_zh: 正確。全文圍繞工作坊：先說明舊時段讓白天上班的人錯過課程（people with daytime jobs missed out），再說明店家修改了時段，接著描述她參加的週六課程，最後推薦給初學者。這與「推薦一個時段最近更改的課程」相符。

option_analysis.label: C
option_analysis.reason_zh: 停車場晚上六點關閉，只是給週四學員的提醒。她建議學員改停在 Dunmore Street，並沒有要求店家延長停車場的開放時間。

option_analysis.label: D
option_analysis.reason_zh: 時段修改的原因是許多顧客要求其他時段（After many customers asked for other times），並不是公布的課表有錯誤。文中也沒有指出任何排程錯誤。

evidence.quote: but this review is about the acrylic pouring workshops held in the back room
After many customers asked for other times, the store revised the schedule.
I highly recommend these workshops, especially for beginners

explanation.takeaway_zh: 目的題先找 "this review is about…"、"I'm writing to…" 這類點明主題的句子，再對照結尾的結論或建議。文中的背景資訊或次要提醒，可能被改寫成干擾選項，要分清主旨與附帶細節。

questions.prompt: According to the review, what should people attending a Thursday session do?

options.label: A
options.text: Bring their own aprons

options.label: B
options.text: Pay extra for canvases

options.label: C
options.text: Arrive by 2:00 P.M.

options.label: D
options.text: Park somewhere other than the store's lot

explanation.summary_zh: 第三段專門提醒週四學員：店家停車場晚上 6:00 關閉，比晚間課程開始的時間還早，所以要停在 Dunmore Street。換句話說，就是停在店家停車場以外的地方。
explanation.reasoning_zh: 題目限定「週四課程」的學員，所以要找與 Thursday 直接相關的指示。"One caution for Thursday participants" 之後說明停車場 6:00 P.M. 關閉，而第一段提到週四課程 6:30 P.M. 才開始，因此評論者建議 "plan to park on Dunmore Street"。選項 D 把具體街名改寫為 "somewhere other than the store's lot"。其他選項都取材自文中的其他細節，但內容或適用對象錯誤。

option_analysis.label: A
option_analysis.reason_zh: 文中說 "aprons are provided"，圍裙由店家提供。學員需要自備的是舊鞋（just bring old shoes），不是圍裙。

option_analysis.label: B
option_analysis.reason_zh: 文中說 $35 的費用已包含畫布、顏料與流體畫調和劑（covers canvases, paints and pouring medium），沒有提到畫布要另外付費。

option_analysis.label: C
option_analysis.reason_zh: 下午 2:00 是三月以前週二課程的舊時段。改期後的週四課程是晚上 6:30 開始，這個選項把舊時段套到了週四學員身上。

option_analysis.label: D
option_analysis.reason_zh: 正確。評論者提醒週四學員，停車場在課程開始前就關閉，應改停在 Dunmore Street，也就是店家停車場以外的地方。

evidence.quote: One caution for Thursday participants: the store's parking lot closes at 6:00 P.M., before the evening session starts, so plan to park on Dunmore Street.
Sessions now take place on Thursdays at 6:30 P.M. and Saturdays at 10:00 A.M.
The $35 fee covers canvases, paints and pouring medium, and aprons are provided, so just bring old shoes.
Until March, they ran only on Tuesdays at 2:00 P.M.

explanation.takeaway_zh: 細節題若限定特定對象或時段（例如週四學員），先找出與該對象直接相關的句子。干擾選項可能把文中其他時段或其他條件的細節，套到錯誤的對象上，作答前要確認適用對象一致。

content.title: Delayed Gift Box Order
content.scenario_summary: An account manager at Corwin Packaging emails a soap company customer about 2,000 printed holiday gift boxes originally scheduled to ship on October 20. Coated board for the order was damaged by moisture while being transported from the paper supplier, and replacement board is due on October 22. The complete order can now ship no earlier than October 29. As an alternative, the supplier offers to send 600 matte-finish boxes on October 20 using uncoated board it has in stock, with the remaining 1,400 following on October 29 at no extra charge. The customer must choose an option by October 16.

blocks.text: From: Priya Natarajan <p.natarajan@corwinpack.example>
To: Daniel Okafor <d.okafor@saltmeadowsoap.example>
Date: October 14
Subject: Gift box order C-2271
Dear Mr. Okafor,

I am writing about the 2,000 printed gift boxes for your holiday soap sets, which were scheduled to ship on October 20. Yesterday our press operators found that the coated board for your order had been damaged by moisture while being transported from our paper supplier, so it cannot be used. A replacement shipment is due on October 22, and the earliest we can ship the complete order is now October 29.

Alternatively, if you need boxes sooner for your store displays, we could send 600 on October 20, printed on uncoated board that we have in stock. These would have a matte finish rather than the glossy one you selected. The remaining 1,400 boxes would follow on October 29, and there would be no additional charge for the second delivery.
Please let me know by October 16 which option you prefer so that we can schedule our press time.
Sincerely,
Priya Natarajan, Account Manager, Corwin Packaging

questions.prompt: What is the main purpose of the e-mail?

options.label: A
options.text: To request approval of a new design for some gift boxes

options.label: B
options.text: To announce that a replacement shipment of board has arrived

options.label: C
options.text: To report a delay and ask a client to choose an option

options.label: D
options.text: To explain why an extra charge applies to a second delivery

explanation.summary_zh: 寄件人先說明紙板受損導致原訂10月20日的出貨無法如期進行，再提出兩種出貨方式，並請收件人於10月16日前回覆選擇，因此主旨是「通知延誤並請客戶做選擇」。
explanation.reasoning_zh: 判斷寫信目的時，要看整封信的架構：第一段交代問題與新的最早出貨日（10月29日），第二段以 Alternatively 提出分批出貨的替代方案，最後一段明確提出請求 "Please let me know ... which option you prefer"。信件由「說明問題」走向「請對方決定」，選項C同時涵蓋這兩部分。其他選項都是抓住信中出現過的細節（亞光表面、替換紙板、第二批出貨），卻把它們的關係講錯。

option_analysis.label: A
option_analysis.reason_zh: 信中確實提到分批方案的盒子會是亞光（matte）而非客戶原先選擇的亮面（glossy），但這是使用庫存未塗佈紙板所產生的差異，屬於替代出貨方案的說明，寄件人並未要求客戶核准新的盒子設計。

option_analysis.label: B
option_analysis.reason_zh: 替換紙板 "is due on October 22"，也就是預計10月22日才到，而這封信寫於10月14日，紙板尚未送達，因此不是在宣布材料已到貨。

option_analysis.label: C
option_analysis.reason_zh: 正確。第一段說明紙板受潮無法使用、完整訂單最早要到10月29日才能出貨（延誤），第二段提出分批出貨的替代方案，最後請對方回覆偏好哪一個方案，完全符合「報告延誤並請客戶選擇」。

option_analysis.label: D
option_analysis.reason_zh: 信中明確說第二批出貨 "there would be no additional charge"，也就是不另收費用，與「解釋為何要收額外費用」正好相反。

evidence.quote: which were scheduled to ship on October 20
the earliest we can ship the complete order is now October 29
Alternatively, if you need boxes sooner for your store displays, we could send 600 on October 20
Please let me know by October 16 which option you prefer

explanation.takeaway_zh: 作答目的題時，留意信件開頭交代的問題與結尾提出的請求；若信中提供多個方案並要求回覆，主旨通常包含「請對方做決定」。細節出現在信中，不代表它就是寫信的主要目的。

questions.prompt: What caused the problem with the order?

options.label: A
options.text: A printing press needed repairs.

options.label: B
options.text: Some board was damaged before it reached the plant.

options.label: C
options.text: Some boxes were printed with the wrong finish.

options.label: D
options.text: A paper supplier sent less board than requested.

explanation.summary_zh: 信中說訂單所用的塗佈紙板在從紙材供應商運來的途中受潮損壞，因此無法使用；選項B「紙板在到達工廠前就受損」是這句話的改寫。
explanation.reasoning_zh: 原文 "had been damaged by moisture while being transported from our paper supplier" 表示紙板在運送過程中受潮。選項B把 "while being transported from our paper supplier" 改寫為 "before it reached the plant"，把 "damaged by moisture" 簡化為 "damaged"。這類細節題常用同義改寫，而非照抄原文用字。

option_analysis.label: A
option_analysis.reason_zh: 信中提到印刷機（press）只有兩處：發現問題的是 "press operators"，以及最後要 "schedule our press time"；並沒有說機器故障或需要維修。

option_analysis.label: B
option_analysis.reason_zh: 正確。紙板是在從紙材供應商運來的途中受潮損壞，也就是在抵達工廠之前就已受損，因此不能用於這筆訂單。

option_analysis.label: C
option_analysis.reason_zh: 亞光表面（matte finish）是替代方案中600個盒子會有的特性，屬於提議中的做法，並不是已經發生的印刷錯誤。

option_analysis.label: D
option_analysis.reason_zh: 紙材供應商確實出現在信中，但問題在於紙板受潮損壞，信中沒有提到供應商送來的紙板數量不足。

evidence.quote: the coated board for your order had been damaged by moisture while being transported from our paper supplier, so it cannot be used

explanation.takeaway_zh: 細節題要找出原文中說明原因的句子（如 so 前面的內容），再比對選項的改寫；對於信中出現過的人、事、物（印刷機、供應商、表面處理），要確認選項描述的關係是否與原文一致。

content.title: Letter Extending a Wireless Microphone Trial
content.scenario_summary: Vireo Sound Systems writes to the facilities manager of Brennock Conference Centre, which is trialing eight wireless microphones. The charging dock failed on March 2, and its replacement did not arrive until March 6. To make up for the lost testing days, the supplier extends the trial from March 14 to March 28 at no additional cost. The letter explains that the $150 trial fee already paid will be deducted if the centre buys the system. If the centre does not keep the system and calls the office, a courier will collect the equipment, which must be packed in its original cases. A technician's email address is provided for setup questions.

blocks.text: Vireo Sound Systems
220 Calder Road, Ashby
March 9
Ms. Harriet Okonjo, Facilities Manager, Brennock Conference Centre, 41 Wharf Street, Ashby
Dear Ms. Okonjo,

Thank you for letting us know that the charging dock supplied with your trial set of eight wireless microphones stopped working on March 2. We regret the inconvenience. Because the replacement dock did not reach you until March 6, you lost several days of testing. We are therefore extending your trial period, which was originally scheduled to end on March 14, until March 28 at no additional cost.

If you decide to buy the system, the $150 trial fee you have already paid will be deducted from the purchase price. If you would prefer not to keep it, please call our office, and we will send a courier to collect the equipment from your centre. All items should be packed in their original cases.
Should you have any questions about setting up the microphones, our technician, Paolo Brandt, can be reached at p.brandt@vireosound.example.
Sincerely,
Nadia Ferreira, Customer Accounts Manager

questions.prompt: Why did Ms. Ferreira write the letter?

options.label: A
options.text: To confirm that a customer has purchased a system

options.label: B
options.text: To notify a customer that a trial has been lengthened

options.label: C
options.text: To tell a customer that a replacement part is on its way

options.label: D
options.text: To remind a customer that a trial fee is due

explanation.summary_zh: 信件的核心是告知 Okonjo 女士：因充電座故障而損失測試天數，因此試用期從 3 月 14 日延長到 3 月 28 日，且不另收費。
explanation.reasoning_zh: 第一段先說明背景：充電座 3 月 2 日故障，替換品 3 月 6 日才送達，導致測試天數減少。接著用 therefore 帶出這封信真正要傳達的決定：「We are therefore extending your trial period」。後兩段的費用抵扣、退回方式和技術人員聯絡資訊，都是延長試用期之後的配套說明。因此 B 選項把 extend 改寫為 lengthened，正確表達寫信目的。

option_analysis.label: A
option_analysis.reason_zh: 信中只說「If you decide to buy the system」，表示是否購買仍未決定，並不是確認已購買。

option_analysis.label: B
option_analysis.reason_zh: 正確。信中明確表示 extending your trial period，並把結束日期從 3 月 14 日延到 3 月 28 日，lengthened 是同義改寫。

option_analysis.label: C
option_analysis.reason_zh: 替換充電座確實是信中提到的零件，但信上說它 did not reach you until March 6，表示 3 月 6 日已經送達，而信件日期是 3 月 9 日，並非仍在運送途中。

option_analysis.label: D
option_analysis.reason_zh: 信中提到 $150 試用費時說的是 you have already paid（已支付），而且是說明購買時可扣抵，並非提醒繳費。

evidence.quote: We are therefore extending your trial period, which was originally scheduled to end on March 14, until March 28 at no additional cost.
Because the replacement dock did not reach you until March 6, you lost several days of testing.
the $150 trial fee you have already paid

explanation.takeaway_zh: 判斷寫信目的時，先找出信中真正的「決定或請求」，它常出現在 therefore、so 等表結果的連接詞之後；前面的背景說明和後面的配套細節通常不是主旨。

questions.prompt: What is NOT mentioned in the letter?

options.label: A
options.text: The date on which the trial was first set to end

options.label: B
options.text: The amount already paid for the trial

options.label: C
options.text: A technician's planned visit to the conference centre

options.label: D
options.text: An instruction for packing equipment to be returned

explanation.summary_zh: 信中確實提到技術人員 Paolo Brandt，但只提供他的電子郵件供詢問安裝問題，並未提到他會到會議中心拜訪，所以 C 是未提及的內容。
explanation.reasoning_zh: NOT 題要逐一核對選項。A 對應 originally scheduled to end on March 14；B 對應 the $150 trial fee you have already paid；D 對應 All items should be packed in their original cases。C 則把信中的兩個元素錯誤組合：信中提到會到 your centre 的是快遞人員（courier），而且這是有條件的安排——客戶決定不留下設備並致電辦公室後，才會派快遞來收回設備。至於技術人員 Paolo Brandt，信中只提供他的 email 作為詢問安裝問題的聯絡方式，並沒有提到他會到現場拜訪。

option_analysis.label: A
option_analysis.reason_zh: 有提及。信中說試用期 originally scheduled to end on March 14，「first set to end」就是「原定結束」的改寫。

option_analysis.label: B
option_analysis.reason_zh: 有提及。信中寫明 the $150 trial fee you have already paid，已付金額為 150 美元。

option_analysis.label: C
option_analysis.reason_zh: 正確答案（未提及）。信中對技術人員 Paolo Brandt 只說 can be reached at 一個電子郵件地址，並未安排他到場；信中提到會到 centre 的是 courier，而且是在客戶決定不留下設備並來電之後才會派來收回設備，人物與目的都不同。

option_analysis.label: D
option_analysis.reason_zh: 有提及。退回設備時 All items should be packed in their original cases，即須以原本的箱子包裝，屬於包裝方面的指示。

evidence.quote: originally scheduled to end on March 14
the $150 trial fee you have already paid
If you would prefer not to keep it, please call our office, and we will send a courier to collect the equipment from your centre.
All items should be packed in their original cases.
our technician, Paolo Brandt, can be reached at p.brandt@vireosound.example

explanation.takeaway_zh: NOT 題中，有些選項會把文中真實出現的人物和另一個人的行動拼在一起，看起來像是有提及，其實正是「未提及」的答案，例如本題把快遞人員到場收件說成技術人員到場。核對時要同時確認「誰」在「什麼條件下」做「什麼」，不能只看關鍵字是否出現。

content.title: Live Chat: Returning a Coffee Grinder
content.scenario_summary: A customer chats with Larkspur Home Goods support about returning a coffee grinder that is too tall to fit under her kitchen cabinets. She plans to return it to the Elm Street store on Saturday and asks whether discarding the original box will be a problem. The agent confirms that unboxed, undamaged items are accepted with a receipt. He also explains that, because the Elm Street store is being renovated, its returns counter has moved to the company's warehouse outlet on Canal Road until May 31. The new location is near the customer's office, so she tentatively suggests dropping off the item during her Friday lunch break instead. The agent gives the outlet's weekday hours and says the refund will go back to the original card.

blocks.text: Larkspur Home Goods | Live Chat Support

Hi. Last week I bought a coffee grinder at your Elm Street store, but it's too tall to fit under my kitchen cabinets. I plan to take it back there on Saturday for a refund. I threw away the box, though. Will that be a problem?
blocks.speaker: Dana Whitfield

blocks.text: Hi, Ms. Whitfield. Not at all. We accept unboxed items as long as they're undamaged and you have the receipt. Please note, however, that the Elm Street store is being renovated, so its returns counter has moved. Until May 31, returns are being handled at our warehouse outlet at 48 Canal Road.
blocks.speaker: Owen Price

blocks.text: Canal Road? That's right by my office.
blocks.speaker: Dana Whitfield

blocks.text: Maybe I'll drop it off during my lunch break on Friday instead.
blocks.speaker: Dana Whitfield

blocks.text: That should work. The outlet is open from 10 A.M. to 7 P.M. on weekdays. The returns counter is just inside the main entrance, and your refund will go back to the card you paid with.
blocks.speaker: Owen Price

blocks.text: Great. Thanks for telling me about the move!
blocks.speaker: Dana Whitfield

questions.prompt: Why did Ms. Whitfield start the chat?

options.label: A
options.text: To find out where returns are currently being accepted

options.label: B
options.text: To ask whether she can return an item without its packaging

options.label: C
options.text: To request an exchange for a smaller coffee grinder

options.label: D
options.text: To check the weekday hours of a warehouse outlet

explanation.summary_zh: Whitfield 女士在第一則訊息中說明自己已經把盒子丟掉，並詢問「Will that be a problem?」。這表示她發起對話，是想確認沒有原包裝能不能退貨，所以答案是 B。
explanation.reasoning_zh: 目的題要看發起對話的人開頭提出了什麼問題。她先交代背景：磨豆機太高，打算星期六拿回 Elm Street 門市退款。接著才提出真正的問題：盒子丟了是否會有影響。B 用 without its packaging 改寫 threw away the box，與她的提問相符。至於退貨櫃台已搬遷、倉儲門市的營業時間等資訊，都是客服 Owen 在回覆中主動補充的，並不是她聯絡客服的原因。

option_analysis.label: A
option_analysis.reason_zh: 退貨櫃台搬遷的消息是 Owen 主動告知的（Please note, however...）。Whitfield 女士原本打算把商品拿回 Elm Street 門市（take it back there），最後還感謝 Owen 告訴她搬遷的事（Thanks for telling me about the move!），可見她發起對話時並不是要詢問退貨地點。這是把對方提供的資訊誤當成發起者的目的。

option_analysis.label: B
option_analysis.reason_zh: 正確。她說 I threw away the box, though. Will that be a problem?，就是在問沒有原包裝還能不能退貨。Owen 隨後回答 We accept unboxed items...，也直接回應了這個問題。

option_analysis.label: C
option_analysis.reason_zh: 她確實提到磨豆機太高、放不進櫥櫃下方，但她明說要退貨退款（for a refund），並沒有要求換成較小的機型。

option_analysis.label: D
option_analysis.reason_zh: 她第一則訊息只問丟掉盒子是否影響退貨，沒有問營業時間；平日營業時間是 Owen 在她提出週五午休送去的想法之後（d1-b6）才主動補充的，因此不是她發起對話的原因。

evidence.quote: I threw away the box, though. Will that be a problem?
I plan to take it back there on Saturday for a refund.
Not at all. We accept unboxed items as long as they're undamaged and you have the receipt.
Please note, however, that the Elm Street store is being renovated, so its returns counter has moved.
The outlet is open from 10 A.M. to 7 P.M. on weekdays.
Thanks for telling me about the move!

explanation.takeaway_zh: 解答目的題時，先鎖定發起者第一則訊息裡的問句或請求。對方在回覆中主動補充的資訊（例如地點變更、營業時間）常被設計成干擾選項，要分清楚「誰問了什麼」和「誰提供了什麼」。

questions.prompt: At 10:05 A.M., what does Ms. Whitfield most likely mean when she writes, "That's right by my office"?

options.label: A
options.text: She already knew that the returns counter had moved.

options.label: B
options.text: She is concerned about traveling to a different location.

options.label: C
options.text: The new return location is convenient for her.

options.label: D
options.text: She works at the Larkspur warehouse outlet.

explanation.summary_zh: Owen 告知退貨改在 48 Canal Road 的倉儲門市辦理。Whitfield 女士回答 Canal Road 就在她辦公室附近，接著提議（Maybe I'll...）改在週五午休時間送過去。可見她的意思是新地點對她來說很方便，答案是 C。
