explanation.reasoning_zh: right by 意思是「就在……旁邊／附近」。單看這句話只是在描述位置，要結合前後文才能判斷她的意圖。前一則訊息告知退貨地點改到 Canal Road；她說完這句之後，緊接著就提議改在週五午休時段送過去（instead 表示取代原本週六拿回 Elm Street 門市的計畫）。這說明新地點離她上班的地方近、順路，對她來說辦理退貨反而更方便。

option_analysis.label: A
option_analysis.reason_zh: 她以 Canal Road? 的疑問語氣回應，最後還說 Thanks for telling me about the move!，表示是聽了 Owen 的說明才得知搬遷，並非事先就知道。

option_analysis.label: B
option_analysis.reason_zh: 這與她的態度相反。她得知新地點後，立刻說 Maybe I'll drop it off during my lunch break on Friday instead.，主動提議利用午休時間就近送去，沒有表現出對換地點的擔憂。

option_analysis.label: C
option_analysis.reason_zh: 正確。新退貨地點在 Canal Road，就在她辦公室附近，所以她提議（Maybe I'll...）改在週五午休時間就近送去，可見新地點對她很方便。

option_analysis.label: D
option_analysis.reason_zh: right by my office 是說她的辦公室在 Canal Road 附近，並不代表她在 Larkspur 的倉儲門市上班。她打算（Maybe）利用午休時間把商品送過去，也顯示她是從別處前往該門市辦理退貨的顧客。

evidence.quote: Until May 31, returns are being handled at our warehouse outlet at 48 Canal Road.
Canal Road? That's right by my office.
Maybe I'll drop it off during my lunch break on Friday instead.
Thanks for telling me about the move!

explanation.takeaway_zh: 解答意圖題時，不能只翻譯字面意思，要同時看前一則訊息提供了什麼新資訊，以及說話者接下來採取或提議的行動。前後兩端一起看，才能判斷這句話是表示方便、擔憂、驚訝還是其他態度；同時留意 Maybe 這類語氣詞，區分「提議」與「已決定」。

content.title: Planning Team Chat: Substitute Welcome Kit Item
content.scenario_summary: In a planning-team chat for the Harborline Logistics Forum, coordinator Priya Nair reports that the insulated bottles ordered for attendee welcome kits are back-ordered until a week after the event. The supplier, Bright Path Promotions, offers bamboo travel mugs at the same unit price by March 9, but it can engrave the logo in only one color. A colleague's worry that the mugs won't fit in the kit bags is resolved. However, the sponsorship manager notes that sponsor Ardent Freight's agreement requires a full-color logo. He will raise the matter at his afternoon meeting with the sponsor's marketing director, before the supplier's Thursday-noon deadline. A colleague suggests full-color notebooks as a backup, and Nair will request a quote for them.

blocks.text: Harborline Logistics Forum – Planning Team
Hi, both. Bright Path Promotions called about the welcome kits. The insulated bottles we ordered are back-ordered, and the earliest they can ship is March 24, a week after the forum ends.
blocks.speaker: Priya Nair

blocks.text: They've offered bamboo travel mugs instead, at the same unit price and with delivery by March 9, so we'd still have time to pack the kits. The catch is that the logo can only be engraved in one color. I'd like your thoughts before I reply.
blocks.speaker: Priya Nair

blocks.text: Mugs are bulkier than bottles. Will 400 of them fit in the kit bags we already have?
blocks.speaker: Hana Kowalczyk

blocks.text: Bright Path says they will. They checked the bag dimensions from our original order.
blocks.speaker: Priya Nair

blocks.text: The engraving is what worries me. Ardent Freight's sponsorship agreement says their logo will appear in full color on the kit item.
blocks.speaker: Tomás Ferreira

blocks.text: Right, and Bright Path needs our answer by noon Thursday to keep the March 9 delivery date.
blocks.speaker: Priya Nair

blocks.text: I'm meeting Ardent's marketing director at 2:00 this afternoon anyway. Leave it with me.
blocks.speaker: Tomás Ferreira

blocks.text: If they won't accept a one-color logo, Bright Path's catalog also has notebooks with full-color covers.
blocks.speaker: Hana Kowalczyk

blocks.text: Good thinking. I'll get a quote on those just in case.
blocks.speaker: Priya Nair

questions.prompt: Why did Ms. Nair start the online chat?

options.label: A
options.text: To pass on a sponsor's request to change a kit item

options.label: B
options.text: To get feedback on a substitute item proposed by a supplier

options.label: C
options.text: To ask a colleague to check the size of the kit bags

options.label: D
options.text: To request a price quote for a backup item

explanation.summary_zh: Nair 女士先說明原訂的保溫瓶缺貨，供應商改提議竹製隨行杯。她想在回覆供應商之前先聽同事的意見，所以答案是 B。
explanation.reasoning_zh: 目的題要看發起人開頭幾則訊息裡明確提出的請求。9:12 她說保溫瓶缺貨待補（back-ordered），最早 3 月 24 日才能出貨。9:13 她說供應商 "offered bamboo travel mugs instead"，最後寫 "I'd like your thoughts before I reply."，意思是先徵詢同事意見再回覆。B 的 substitute item proposed by a supplier 就是「供應商提議的替代品」的改寫。

option_analysis.label: A
option_analysis.reason_zh: 提議更換品項的是供應商 Bright Path Promotions，不是贊助商 Ardent Freight。在對話中，贊助商只是需要確認能否接受單色標誌的一方，並沒有主動要求更換。

option_analysis.label: B
option_analysis.reason_zh: 正確。9:13 的訊息先說明供應商提出以隨行杯替代，再說 "I'd like your thoughts before I reply"，明確表示要聽取同事對這項替代方案的看法。

option_analysis.label: C
option_analysis.reason_zh: 關心禮袋裝不裝得下的是 Kowalczyk 女士（9:15）。Nair 女士回答供應商已核對過袋子尺寸，她並沒有請同事去檢查，這也不是她開啟對話的原因。

option_analysis.label: D
option_analysis.reason_zh: 筆記本是 Kowalczyk 女士到 9:22 才提出的備案，Nair 女士 9:23 才說要去詢價。這是對話後段的後續行動，不是她發起對話的目的。

evidence.quote: They've offered bamboo travel mugs instead
I'd like your thoughts before I reply.
I'll get a quote on those just in case.

explanation.takeaway_zh: 目的題要抓發起人在開頭訊息中明說的請求，例如 I'd like your thoughts。對話後段才出現的備案，或別人提出的疑問，常被拿來當干擾選項。

questions.prompt: What problem with the travel mugs does Mr. Ferreira point out?

options.label: A
options.text: They may not fit in the kit bags.

options.label: B
options.text: They cost more per unit than the bottles.

options.label: C
options.text: They cannot show a sponsor's logo in the way that was agreed.

options.label: D
options.text: They will not be delivered before the forum.

explanation.summary_zh: Ferreira 先生擔心的是隨行杯只能單色雕刻，而贊助合約規定標誌要以全彩呈現，所以答案是 C。
explanation.reasoning_zh: 9:13 Nair 女士提到 "the logo can only be engraved in one color"。9:18 Ferreira 先生接著說 "The engraving is what worries me"，並指出 Ardent Freight 的贊助合約規定 "their logo will appear in full color on the kit item"。兩則合起來看，隨行杯無法照合約約定的方式呈現贊助商標誌。C 的 in the way that was agreed 就是改寫合約中「全彩」的約定。

option_analysis.label: A
option_analysis.reason_zh: 擔心禮袋裝不下的是 Kowalczyk 女士（9:15），不是 Ferreira 先生。而且 Nair 女士已轉述，供應商核對過袋子尺寸後表示裝得下。這個選項是把別人的疑慮套到 Ferreira 先生身上。

option_analysis.label: B
option_analysis.reason_zh: 9:13 明確說隨行杯 "at the same unit price"，單價與原本相同，並沒有比較貴，Ferreira 先生也沒有提到價格。

option_analysis.label: C
option_analysis.reason_zh: 正確。Ferreira 先生點出合約要求贊助商標誌全彩呈現，而隨行杯只能單色雕刻，兩者不符。

option_analysis.label: D
option_analysis.reason_zh: 會在論壇結束後才到的是原本的保溫瓶（最早 3 月 24 日出貨）。隨行杯 3 月 9 日前即可送達，對話中也說還來得及包裝禮袋。Ferreira 先生並沒有提出交期問題。

evidence.quote: The catch is that the logo can only be engraved in one color.
The engraving is what worries me. Ardent Freight's sponsorship agreement says their logo will appear in full color on the kit item.
Will 400 of them fit in the kit bags we already have?

explanation.takeaway_zh: 細節題要確認是「誰」針對「哪一個物品」提出問題。同一段對話中，其他人提出的疑慮，或關於原訂物品的事實，常被拿來當干擾選項。

questions.prompt: At 9:20 A.M., what does Mr. Ferreira most likely mean when he writes, "Leave it with me"?

options.label: A
options.text: He will bring up the matter at a meeting later today.

options.label: B
options.text: He will give Bright Path Promotions the team's answer.

options.label: C
options.text: He would rather wait for the original bottles.

options.label: D
options.text: He has already approved the change with Ardent Freight.

explanation.summary_zh: Ferreira 先生下午兩點本來就要和 Ardent Freight 的行銷總監見面。"Leave it with me" 意思是「這件事交給我」，表示他會在會中提出單色標誌的問題，所以答案是 A。
explanation.reasoning_zh: 前文中，Ferreira 先生擔心單色雕刻不符贊助合約，Nair 女士也補充供應商需要在週四中午前得到答覆。他接著寫 "I'm meeting Ardent's marketing director at 2:00 this afternoon anyway."，再說 "Leave it with me."，意思是由他利用下午的會面處理這件待決的事。Kowalczyk 女士 9:22 以 "If they won't accept a one-color logo" 回應，也顯示大家還在等贊助商的答覆。

option_analysis.label: A
option_analysis.reason_zh: 正確。他提到今天下午 2 點要見贊助商的行銷總監，"Leave it with me" 表示他會在那次會面中提出這個問題。

option_analysis.label: B
option_analysis.reason_zh: 他要見的是贊助商 Ardent 的行銷總監，不是供應商 Bright Path。而且 Nair 女士 9:13 說 "before I reply"，表示回覆供應商的是她本人。

option_analysis.label: C
option_analysis.reason_zh: 原本的保溫瓶最早 3 月 24 日才出貨，是論壇結束一週之後。Ferreira 先生沒有建議等待，他是主動要去確認贊助商能否接受替代品。

option_analysis.label: D
option_analysis.reason_zh: 這句話寫於上午 9:20，和行銷總監的會面要到下午 2 點才進行。他 9:18 也才剛表達對雕刻的擔憂，可見問題尚未解決。Kowalczyk 女士隨後還在考慮對方不接受的情況，所以看不出已獲贊助商同意。

evidence.quote: I'm meeting Ardent's marketing director at 2:00 this afternoon anyway. Leave it with me.
The engraving is what worries me.
If they won't accept a one-color logo

explanation.takeaway_zh: 意圖題要結合說話者的前一句（例如下午要和誰見面）以及對話中尚未解決的事項，判斷 "Leave it with me" 這類慣用語在這裡是指他要負責處理哪一件事。

content.title: Partner Hotel Ticket Reservations for a Textile Exhibition
content.scenario_summary: The partnerships coordinator of the Corvane Museum of Textile Arts writes to the guest relations manager of the Aldmoor Grand Hotel, which is already a museum partner, to introduce a new reservation service for the timed-entry exhibition Woven Coastlines (April 5 to August 30). Beginning March 20, partner hotels can use an online portal to reserve up to 20 tickets per visit date, as early as 30 days in advance. Each ticket must be assigned to a named guest by noon on the day before the visit, or it is released for general sale. Entering a guest's name generates a booking code with the guest's name and entry time, which the guest shows at the east-lobby partner desk to collect tickets. Assigned tickets are invoiced monthly at a $14 partner rate, two dollars below standard adult admission, and released tickets are not charged. Login details are enclosed.

documents.title: Letter from the Corvane Museum of Textile Arts

blocks.text: Corvane Museum of Textile Arts
14 Weaver's Row, Aldmoor
March 10
Ms. Ilse Varga, Guest Relations Manager, Aldmoor Grand Hotel, 220 Canal Street, Aldmoor
Dear Ms. Varga,

Our spring exhibition, Woven Coastlines: Textiles of the North Sea Ports, opens on April 5 and runs through August 30. Because admission is by timed ticket and weekend slots are expected to sell out quickly, we have introduced a reservation service for our partner hotels, including the Aldmoor Grand.

Beginning March 20, your guest relations team can log in to our partner portal and reserve up to 20 tickets per visit date, as early as 30 days in advance. Your team must then assign each reserved ticket to a guest by noon on the day before the visit; any ticket still unassigned at that point will be released for general sale. When a guest's name is entered, the portal generates a booking code. Each code will carry the guest's name and entry time, so guests need only show it at the partner desk in our east lobby to collect their tickets.
Assigned tickets will be invoiced to your hotel at the end of each month at our partner rate of $14, two dollars below standard adult admission. You will not be charged for tickets that are released.
Your portal login details are enclosed. Please contact me at partners@corvanemuseum.example with any questions.
Sincerely,
Tobias Wren, Partnerships Coordinator

questions.prompt: Why did Mr. Wren write to Ms. Varga?

options.label: A
options.text: To describe a new way for her hotel to book tickets for guests

options.label: B
options.text: To invite her to an early viewing of an exhibition

options.label: C
options.text: To ask her hotel to join a museum partnership program

options.label: D
options.text: To report a change to an exhibition's schedule

explanation.summary_zh: 信中第一段說明博物館為合作飯店「推出了一項訂票服務」，第二段起詳細介紹如何透過合作入口網站預訂門票，因此寫信目的是介紹飯店替房客訂票的新方式。
explanation.reasoning_zh: 目的題要看整封信的重心。第一段先交代背景：展覽採分時段入場、週末時段可能很快售完，接著點出 we have introduced a reservation service for our partner hotels。後面各段分別說明預訂上限、指定房客的期限、取票方式、帳單計算和登入資料，全都圍繞這項新服務的使用方法。選項 A 的 a new way ... to book tickets 正是 reservation service 的換句話說。

option_analysis.label: A
option_analysis.reason_zh: 正確。信中說博物館為合作飯店推出新的訂票服務，並說明 Varga 女士的團隊可登入入口網站為房客預訂門票，全信都在介紹這套做法。

option_analysis.label: B
option_analysis.reason_zh: 錯誤。信中雖提到展覽將於 4 月 5 日開幕，但沒有邀請 Varga 女士參加任何提前參觀或預展活動。

option_analysis.label: C
option_analysis.reason_zh: 錯誤。信中寫 our partner hotels, including the Aldmoor Grand，表示 Aldmoor Grand 飯店已經是合作飯店，因此不是邀請對方加入合作計畫。

option_analysis.label: D
option_analysis.reason_zh: 錯誤。信中提到展期為 4 月 5 日至 8 月 30 日，但只是說明展期，並未表示日期有任何變更。

evidence.quote: we have introduced a reservation service for our partner hotels, including the Aldmoor Grand
your guest relations team can log in to our partner portal and reserve up to 20 tickets per visit date

explanation.takeaway_zh: 目的題通常可從第一段找到主旨句，例如 we have introduced...，再用後面段落是否都在支持這個主題來確認；信中提到的日期或身分常被改寫成看似相關、實際錯誤的選項。

questions.prompt: According to the letter, what must the hotel's guest relations team do by noon on the day before a visit?

options.label: A
options.text: Pay the museum for the reserved tickets

options.label: B
options.text: Collect the tickets at the partner desk

options.label: C
options.text: Enter a guest's name for each reserved ticket

options.label: D
options.text: Reserve a block of 20 tickets

explanation.summary_zh: 信中規定飯店團隊必須在參觀前一天中午以前，把每張預訂的門票指定給一位房客，而指定方式是在系統中輸入房客姓名，因此答案是 C。
explanation.reasoning_zh: 題目的關鍵是 by noon on the day before a visit，回到第二段可找到同一個期限：Your team must then assign each reserved ticket to a guest by noon on the day before the visit。下一句 When a guest's name is entered, the portal generates a booking code 說明「指定給房客」實際上就是輸入房客姓名。其他選項都借用了信中的細節，例如付款、取票地點、20 張上限，但這些與「中午期限」並沒有對應關係。

option_analysis.label: A
option_analysis.reason_zh: 錯誤。信中說已指定的門票會在每月月底開帳單給飯店，未指定而釋出的門票則不收費，並沒有要求在參觀前一天中午以前付款。

option_analysis.label: B
option_analysis.reason_zh: 錯誤。到東側大廳合作櫃台取票的是房客本人，憑訂位代碼領票；這是房客到館時的步驟，不是飯店團隊在前一天中午以前要做的事。

option_analysis.label: C
option_analysis.reason_zh: 正確。信中要求團隊在參觀前一天中午以前 assign each reserved ticket to a guest，並說明輸入房客姓名後系統會產生訂位代碼，與「為每張門票輸入房客姓名」意思相符。

option_analysis.label: D
option_analysis.reason_zh: 錯誤。信中說每個參觀日期最多可訂 20 張（up to 20），且最早可提前 30 天預訂。20 張是上限而非必訂數量，也與中午期限無關。

evidence.quote: Your team must then assign each reserved ticket to a guest by noon on the day before the visit
When a guest's name is entered, the portal generates a booking code
Assigned tickets will be invoiced to your hotel at the end of each month

explanation.takeaway_zh: 細節題若題目帶有明確時間點，先找出原文中相同的期限，再核對該期限搭配的是哪個動作和哪個執行者；干擾選項常把信中真實存在的細節配到錯誤的時間或人物上。

questions.prompt: In the letter, the word "carry" in the second paragraph is closest in meaning to

options.label: A
options.text: transport

options.label: B
options.text: stock

options.label: C
options.text: support

options.label: D
options.text: include

explanation.summary_zh: Each code will carry the guest's name and entry time 指訂位代碼上「帶有、包含」房客姓名與入場時間，因此最接近的意思是 include。
explanation.reasoning_zh: carry 有多種意思，必須依上下文判斷。這裡的主詞是 code（訂位代碼），受詞是 the guest's name and entry time（資訊）。後半句說房客只要出示代碼就能取票，表示代碼本身顯示了這些資料。代入 include 後成為 Each code will include the guest's name and entry time，意思與語法角色（及物動詞）都保持一致。

option_analysis.label: A
option_analysis.reason_zh: 錯誤。transport 是「運送」人或物品，用於 carry 的實體搬運意思；訂位代碼並不是把姓名和時間運送到某處。

option_analysis.label: B
option_analysis.reason_zh: 錯誤。stock 是商店「備有、販售」某種商品，對應 a store carries a product 的用法；此處主詞是代碼，受詞是資訊，不是商品。

option_analysis.label: C
option_analysis.reason_zh: 錯誤。support 是「支撐、承受（重量）」或「支持」，對應 carry a load 的意思；代碼並不是在支撐或支持房客的姓名與時間。

option_analysis.label: D
option_analysis.reason_zh: 正確。include 表示「包含」，代入後意指每個代碼都包含房客姓名與入場時間，與後文「出示代碼即可取票」的說法一致。

evidence.quote: Each code will carry the guest's name and entry time, so guests need only show it at the partner desk in our east lobby to collect their tickets

explanation.takeaway_zh: 同義字題要看目標字的主詞與受詞屬於什麼類型：當 carry 的主詞是代碼、標籤、文件等，受詞是資訊時，通常表示「載有、包含」，而不是「搬運」或「販售」。

content.title: Independent Bookshop Opens Shelves to Local Self-Published Authors
content.scenario_summary: A local newspaper article reports that Tamsin & Hale Books, an independent shop on Wexley Road since 2009, will set aside two bookcases for titles by area writers starting April 1. Customers often asked for books by neighborhood writers, but the shop usually could not offer any because most self-published books are sold only online. To be eligible, authors must live in Dunmore County, the book must have an ISBN, and it cannot have been first published more than five years ago. The rules allow one title per author and up to sixty titles in the first round. Books are sold on consignment: authors supply five copies, the shop keeps 35 percent of each sale, and unsold copies can be picked up after three months. Applications are due March 20. Accepted authors are invited, but not required, to join a May evening reading.

documents.title: Wexley Road Bookshop Makes Room for Local Writers

blocks.text: Wexley Road Bookshop Makes Room for Local Writers
By Priya Nandakumar, Staff Writer | March 4

Authors who publish their own books will soon be able to find their work on the shelves of Tamsin & Hale Books, the independent shop that has operated on Wexley Road since 2009. Beginning April 1, the store will set aside two bookcases near its front window for titles by area writers.

Owner Marguerite Hale said the idea came from her customers. "People kept asking whether we carried anything by writers from the neighborhood," she explained. "Since most self-published books are sold only online, we usually had to say no."

To qualify, authors must live in Dunmore County, and their book must have an ISBN, the identification number that stores use to order and track titles. Books first published more than five years ago are not eligible. Each author may submit one title, and the shop will accept up to sixty titles in the first round.

Accepted books will be sold on consignment: authors supply five copies, and the shop keeps 35 percent of the price of each copy sold. Unsold copies can be picked up at the store after three months. Application forms are available at the front counter or at tamsinhale.example/local and are due March 20. Selected authors will also be invited, though not required, to join an evening reading at the shop in May.

questions.prompt: What is the main purpose of the article?

options.label: A
options.text: To announce that a bookshop is reopening on Wexley Road

options.label: B
options.text: To describe a bookshop's plan to sell books by local writers

options.label: C
options.text: To explain why most self-published books are sold online

options.label: D
options.text: To promote a series of evening readings at a bookshop

explanation.summary_zh: 整篇文章報導 Tamsin & Hale Books 將設立專區販售當地作者的書，並說明這個計畫的緣由、資格條件與寄售方式，所以答案是 B。
explanation.reasoning_zh: 第一段開宗明義指出，書店從 4 月 1 日起要把櫥窗旁的兩個書櫃留給當地作者的書。後面幾段依序交代這個計畫：第二段說明構想來源，第三段列出申請資格，第四段說明寄售條件與申請期限。各段都圍繞同一個計畫，因此主旨是「介紹書店販售當地作者書籍的計畫」。

option_analysis.label: A
option_analysis.reason_zh: 文中說這家書店「since 2009」就在 Wexley Road 營業。文章沒有提到書店曾經關閉或即將重新開幕，地點只是背景資訊。

option_analysis.label: B
option_analysis.reason_zh: 正確。第一段宣布設立當地作者書櫃，後續段落都在說明這個計畫的細節。

option_analysis.label: C
option_analysis.reason_zh: 「自行出版的書大多只在網路販售」出自店主的話。這句話只用來解釋為什麼過去顧客問起時，店裡通常無法提供在地作者的書，屬於背景說明，不是全文的寫作目的。

option_analysis.label: D
option_analysis.reason_zh: 文中只提到入選作者會受邀參加五月的一場晚間朗讀會，而且是附帶活動、並非強制。文章沒有在宣傳一系列朗讀活動。

evidence.quote: Beginning April 1, the store will set aside two bookcases near its front window for titles by area writers.
To qualify, authors must live in Dunmore County

explanation.takeaway_zh: 判斷文章目的時，先看開頭段落宣布了什麼，再確認後續段落是否都在補充同一件事。只在單一段落出現的背景說明或附帶活動，通常不是主旨。

questions.prompt: What is one requirement a book must meet to be eligible?

options.label: A
options.text: Copies of it must already have been sold online.

options.label: B
options.text: Its author must provide at least sixty copies.

options.label: C
options.text: It must have been first published within the past five years.

options.label: D
options.text: Its author must agree to read from it at the shop.

explanation.summary_zh: 文中說「首次出版超過五年的書不符合資格」。換句話說，書必須是近五年內首次出版的，所以答案是 C。
explanation.reasoning_zh: 第三段列出資格條件：作者須住在 Dunmore County、書須有 ISBN，而且首次出版超過五年的書不符資格。選項 C 把「超過五年不合格」改寫成「須在過去五年內首次出版」，意思相同。其他選項都借用了文中出現的數字或活動，但與資格條件的關係不對。

option_analysis.label: A
option_analysis.reason_zh: 文中提到自行出版的書大多只在網路販售，但這只是店主說明過去店裡通常無法提供這類書的原因。文中並沒有要求書必須已在網路上賣出過。

option_analysis.label: B
option_analysis.reason_zh: 「sixty」是書店第一輪最多接受的書目數量（up to sixty titles），不是每位作者要提供的本數。依第四段，作者只需提供五本。

option_analysis.label: C
option_analysis.reason_zh: 正確。第三段的「Books first published more than five years ago are not eligible」即表示書必須在近五年內首次出版。

option_analysis.label: D
option_analysis.reason_zh: 五月的晚間朗讀會只是邀請入選作者參加，文中明確說「though not required」，並非資格條件。

evidence.quote: Books first published more than five years ago are not eligible.
the shop will accept up to sixty titles in the first round
Selected authors will also be invited, though not required, to join an evening reading at the shop in May.

explanation.takeaway_zh: 細節題的正解可能把原文的否定說法改寫成肯定說法，例如「超過五年不合格」等於「須在五年內」。也要留意數字屬於哪個項目：是書目總數還是每人本數；以及活動是「邀請」還是「規定」。

questions.prompt: What is suggested about Tamsin & Hale Books?

options.label: A
options.text: It has seldom been able to offer books by neighborhood writers.

options.label: B
options.text: It charges authors a fee to submit an application.

options.label: C
options.text: It moved to its Wexley Road location recently.

options.label: D
options.text: It will mail unsold copies back to authors.

explanation.summary_zh: 店主說，顧客常問店裡有沒有在地作者的書，而他們「usually had to say no」。由此可推知，書店過去很少能提供這類書，所以答案是 A。
explanation.reasoning_zh: 第二段引述店主的話：顧客一直詢問是否有住在附近的作者寫的書，但因為自行出版的書大多只在網路販售，店裡通常只能回答沒有。「通常只能說沒有」直接支持「過去很少能提供在地作者的書」這個推論；店主也說這個構想來自顧客，與此情況相呼應。

option_analysis.label: A
option_analysis.reason_zh: 正確。店主說顧客問起在地作者的書時，店裡「usually had to say no」，可推知書店過去很少有這類書可提供。

option_analysis.label: B
option_analysis.reason_zh: 文中提到的金額條件只有書售出後書店保留售價的 35%。文章沒有提到任何申請費，只說申請表可在櫃台或網站取得。

option_analysis.label: C
option_analysis.reason_zh: 文中說書店「has operated on Wexley Road since 2009」，表示已在當地營業多年，與「最近才搬來」相矛盾。

option_analysis.label: D
option_analysis.reason_zh: 第四段只說未售出的書三個月後可以到店取回（picked up at the store）。文中沒有提到書店會把書寄回給作者。

evidence.quote: "People kept asking whether we carried anything by writers from the neighborhood," she explained. "Since most self-published books are sold only online, we usually had to say no."
the independent shop that has operated on Wexley Road since 2009
Unsold copies can be picked up at the store after three months.

explanation.takeaway_zh: 推論題的答案要能從原文直接推得，例如「通常只能說沒有」可推出「很少能提供」。文中沒提到的事（如申請費、郵寄）或與原文矛盾的說法（如最近才搬來），都不能選。

content.title: Follow-Up Notice on Website Project Profiles
content.scenario_summary: At Brannock & Sato Architects, the communications coordinator posts a follow-up notice to project leads about draft profiles for the studio's redesigned website. Eleven of sixteen profiles are final, and the five still awaiting review are listed with their leads. Leads must check their drafts by March 11 by typing corrections into files in a shared folder, which the web firm Fernhill Digital will collect on March 12. Reviewers should focus on facts, because some figures came from original proposals. Photographs are carried over from the current site, and clients can be marked 'Withheld'. The site launches March 30, and unchecked profiles will be added in a later update.

blocks.text: Brannock & Sato Architects
To: All project leads
From: Lena Okafor, Communications Coordinator
Date: March 3
Follow-Up: Website Project Profiles

On February 18, I sent each project lead a draft profile of their project for our redesigned website and asked for corrections by February 28. Thank you to everyone who has already replied. Eleven of our sixteen profiles are now final, and the five that still need review are listed below. [[1]]
Profiles still awaiting review

If your project appears on the list, please check your draft by March 11. The draft files are saved in the Website Review folder on the shared drive. Type your corrections directly into your file rather than sending them by e-mail. [[2]] On March 12, Fernhill Digital, the firm building our site, will collect the files from that folder and copy the text into its page templates.

When reviewing, focus on the facts rather than the writing style. Several drafts were based on our original proposals, so figures such as building area and completion year may have changed. [[3]] Photographs are being carried over from our current website and do not need to be checked. A few clients have asked us not to publish their names; if yours is one of them, type "Withheld" in the client line.

The site will go live on March 30. [[4]] Any profile that has not been checked by the deadline will be left off at launch and added in a later update. If you have questions, please call me at extension 214.

questions.prompt: What is the main purpose of the notice?

options.label: A
options.text: To announce that a website will be launched earlier than planned

options.label: B
options.text: To introduce the firm that is building the studio's new website

options.label: C
options.text: To remind certain employees to complete a task requested earlier

options.label: D
options.text: To ask project leads for photographs of recently finished buildings

explanation.summary_zh: 這是一份後續提醒通知：2 月 18 日已請專案負責人修正網站簡介草稿，現在請名單上尚未完成的人在 3 月 11 日前完成審閱，故選 (C)。
explanation.reasoning_zh: 標題「Follow-Up」與第一段交代了先前的請求：2 月 18 日寄出草稿，並要求在 2 月 28 日前回覆修正。接著說明 16 份中已有 11 份定稿，剩下 5 份列在表中。第二段的 "If your project appears on the list, please check your draft by March 11" 才是通知要讀者採取的行動。選項中的 certain employees 對應名單上的專案負責人，a task requested earlier 對應先前交辦的草稿審閱。

option_analysis.label: A
option_analysis.reason_zh: 通知確實提到網站 3 月 30 日上線，但沒有說這個日期比原訂計畫提早，上線日期也不是通知的主旨。

option_analysis.label: B
option_analysis.reason_zh: Fernhill Digital 只在說明檔案收取流程時以同位語順帶提及（the firm building our site），通知並不是為了介紹這家公司。

option_analysis.label: C
option_analysis.reason_zh: 正確。通知針對名單上專案的負責人（certain employees），催促他們完成 2 月 18 日就已提出的審閱工作（a task requested earlier）。

option_analysis.label: D
option_analysis.reason_zh: 通知說照片沿用現有網站，且 "do not need to be checked"，並沒有要求負責人提供新建物的照片。

evidence.quote: Follow-Up: Website Project Profiles
On February 18, I sent each project lead a draft profile of their project for our redesigned website and asked for corrections by February 28.
If your project appears on the list, please check your draft by March 11.

explanation.takeaway_zh: 主旨題先看標題與第一段交代的背景，再找出通知要求讀者採取的具體行動。標題為 Follow-up 時，要特別留意先前的請求，以及目前尚未完成的部分。

questions.prompt: According to the notice, why might some figures in the drafts be inaccurate?

options.label: A
options.text: Some drafts were based on early proposal documents.

options.label: B
options.text: Some drafts were copied from the studio's current website.

options.label: C
options.text: Some drafts were prepared by the firm building the new site.

options.label: D
options.text: Some clients asked the studio to withhold certain details.

explanation.summary_zh: 第三段說明，部分草稿是根據原始提案撰寫的，所以建築面積、完工年份等數字可能已有變動。(A) 是這句話的同義改寫。
explanation.reasoning_zh: 題目問的是「數字（figures）」為何可能不正確。關鍵句 "Several drafts were based on our original proposals, so figures such as building area and completion year may have changed" 用 so 連接因果：草稿依據的是提案時的資料，之後這些數字可能已經改變。original proposals 在選項中改寫為 early proposal documents。

option_analysis.label: A
option_analysis.reason_zh: 正確。based on our original proposals 改寫為 based on early proposal documents，正是通知中數字可能已改變的原因。

option_analysis.label: B
option_analysis.reason_zh: 從現有網站沿用的是照片（Photographs are being carried over from our current website），通知並未說草稿文字或數字取自現有網站。此選項把照片的細節錯套到數字上。

option_analysis.label: C
option_analysis.reason_zh: Fernhill Digital 的工作是 3 月 12 日收取檔案，並把文字放入頁面版型。通知沒有說草稿由這家公司撰寫，也沒有把數字錯誤歸因於它。

option_analysis.label: D
option_analysis.reason_zh: 客戶要求不公開的是名稱（not to publish their names），處理方式是在客戶欄填寫 Withheld，與數字可能過時無關。

evidence.quote: Several drafts were based on our original proposals, so figures such as building area and completion year may have changed.
Photographs are being carried over from our current website and do not need to be checked.

explanation.takeaway_zh: 細節題要鎖定題目中的關鍵名詞（此處為 figures），找出與它直接相連的因果句。同一段中其他項目（照片、客戶名稱）的處理方式，常被拿來當成干擾選項。

questions.prompt: Where would this sentence fit most naturally in the passage? "However, please do not rename the file or move it out of the folder."
questions.target_text: However, please do not rename the file or move it out of the folder.

explanation.summary_zh: 插入句用 However 與前一句「直接在檔案中修改」形成對比；下一句「Fernhill Digital 將從該資料夾收取檔案」則說明檔案必須留在原處的原因。因此放在 [2]。
explanation.reasoning_zh: 插入句有三個線索。第一，這裡的 However 表示轉折，前文需要有能與「不要改檔名、不要移動檔案」形成對比的內容。第二，the file 與 the folder 需要明確的指涉對象。第三，後句若能說明這項限制的原因，銜接會更緊密。在 [2]，前句 "Type your corrections directly into your file" 允許直接修改檔案內容，However 隨即轉為限制：可以改內容，但不要改檔名或移動檔案。the file 指 your file，the folder 指前面提到的 Website Review folder。後句 "will collect the files from that folder" 說明網頁公司會直接到那個資料夾收取檔案，正好解釋為何檔案必須留在原處。

option_analysis.label: A
option_analysis.reason_zh: [1] 的前一句只說明 11 份已定稿、5 份列於下方。第一段雖提到先前請負責人修正（asked for corrections），但尚未提到任何檔案或資料夾，the file、the folder 沒有明確的指涉對象；緊鄰的前句只是進度說明，沒有可讓 However 加以限制的許可內容。

option_analysis.label: B
option_analysis.reason_zh: 正確。前句允許直接修改檔案，However 轉為「但別改檔名、別移動」；後句說明 Fernhill Digital 會從 that folder 收取檔案，前後銜接最緊密。

option_analysis.label: C
option_analysis.reason_zh: [3] 位於談審閱重點的段落，前句說明部分數字可能因根據原始提案而已改變，與「別改檔名、別移動檔案」沒有轉折關係；後句談照片不必檢查，插入後同樣不連貫。

option_analysis.label: D
option_analysis.reason_zh: [4] 的前句只宣布網站 3 月 30 日上線，後句說明截止前未審核的簡介上線時不列入。插入句的 However 與上線日期沒有對比關係，還會打斷「上線日期」與「上線時不列入」之間的連結。

evidence.quote: The draft files are saved in the Website Review folder on the shared drive. Type your corrections directly into your file rather than sending them by e-mail. [[2]] On March 12, Fernhill Digital, the firm building our site, will collect the files from that folder
Eleven of our sixteen profiles are now final, and the five that still need review are listed below. [[1]]
so figures such as building area and completion year may have changed. [[3]] Photographs are being carried over from our current website
The site will go live on March 30. [[4]] Any profile that has not been checked by the deadline will be left off at launch

explanation.takeaway_zh: 句子插入題可先圈出插入句中的轉折詞與指稱詞（如 However、the file、the folder），確認前文有可對比的內容與明確的指涉對象，再檢查後一句是否承接或解釋插入句。

questions.prompt: What is suggested about the studio's redesigned website?

options.label: A
options.text: It will show the client's name for every project.

options.label: B
options.text: Its launch will be delayed until all profiles are approved.

options.label: C
options.text: It will feature newly taken photographs of projects.

options.label: D
options.text: It may launch with fewer than sixteen project profiles.

explanation.summary_zh: 網站共有 16 份專案簡介，目前已定稿 11 份；截止前未審核的簡介上線時不列入。因此網站有可能以少於 16 份簡介上線，選 (D)。
explanation.reasoning_zh: 本題要結合兩處資訊。第一段 "Eleven of our sixteen profiles are now final" 交代總數與完成數；最後一段 "Any profile that has not been checked by the deadline will be left off at launch and added in a later update" 交代逾期的處理方式。剩下的 5 份中，只要有任何一份沒在截止日前完成審閱，上線時就不會出現，網站便少於 16 份。通知無法確定是否有人逾期，因此選項用 may 表達可能性，與文意相符。

option_analysis.label: A
option_analysis.reason_zh: 通知提到 "A few clients have asked us not to publish their names"，並請負責人在客戶欄填寫 Withheld，可見有些專案不會顯示客戶名稱，與「每個專案都顯示」矛盾。

option_analysis.label: B
option_analysis.reason_zh: 上線日期為 3 月 30 日。逾期的簡介是「上線時不列入，之後再補上」，而不是延後整個網站的上線時間。

option_analysis.label: C
option_analysis.reason_zh: 通知說照片是從現有網站沿用（carried over），並非新拍攝的照片。

option_analysis.label: D
option_analysis.reason_zh: 正確。16 份中仍有 5 份待審，而未在截止日前審核的簡介上線時不列入，所以網站上線時可能不足 16 份。

evidence.quote: Eleven of our sixteen profiles are now final
Any profile that has not been checked by the deadline will be left off at launch and added in a later update.

explanation.takeaway_zh: 推論題常需要把數量資訊與條件規定結合起來看。同時要留意選項的語氣（如 may）是否與原文提供的確定程度相符。

content.title: Bicycle Repair Service Plan Eligibility E-mail
content.scenario_summary: A bicycle shop's service manager e-mails a customer who asked for the shop's Free Adjustment Plan to cover a gear-cable replacement. The plan is automatic for bicycles sold by the shop, but a bicycle stays eligible only if it receives an in-shop safety inspection at least once every twelve months. Her last inspection was in November 2023, so coverage lapsed in November 2024. The manager explains that approving a $40 inspection during the current repair visit reactivates the plan and makes the repair labor free. Without the inspection, labor costs $25. The $12 cable is charged either way because parts are excluded. She must choose by April 10, and pickup is expected on April 12.

blocks.text: From: Tomas Brandt <tbrandt@larkspurcycles.example>
To: Priya Nair <pnair@mailbox.example>
Date: April 8, 2025
Subject: Your bicycle repair and the Free Adjustment Plan
Dear Ms. Nair,
Thank you for leaving your bicycle with us yesterday. Our mechanic has found that the rear shifting problem you described is caused by a stretched gear cable, which will need to be replaced.

On your drop-off form, you asked us to apply the Free Adjustment Plan to this repair. Like every bicycle sold at Larkspur, yours was automatically enrolled in the plan, which covers labor for gear and brake adjustments, including cable replacement. [[1]] To stay eligible, however, a bicycle must receive a full safety inspection at our shop at least once every twelve months. Our records show that you last brought your bicycle in for an inspection in November 2023, so its coverage lapsed in November 2024. [[2]]

Fortunately, coverage can be restored. If you approve a safety inspection ($40) while your bicycle is here, the plan will be reactivated immediately, and the labor for your repair will be free. [[3]] Without the inspection, the labor would cost $25. Parts are not covered by the plan, so the new cable ($12) will be charged in either case.
Please reply to this e-mail or call our service desk at 555-0148 by April 10 to let us know which option you prefer. [[4]] Either way, your bicycle should be ready for pickup on April 12.
Best regards,
Tomas Brandt, Service Manager, Larkspur Cycles

questions.prompt: What is the main purpose of the e-mail?

options.label: A
options.text: To share the findings of an annual safety inspection

options.label: B
options.text: To notify a customer that her bicycle is ready for pickup

options.label: C
options.text: To explain how a customer's lapsed coverage can be reactivated

options.label: D
options.text: To promote a service plan that the shop has just introduced

explanation.summary_zh: Nair 女士要求把這次維修套用 Free Adjustment Plan。信中說明她的車超過十二個月沒做安全檢查，所以保障已經失效；但只要她同意趁這次送修順便做檢查，就能立即恢復保障。因此主旨是說明失效的保障如何重新啟用。
explanation.reasoning_zh: 第二段先回應她在送修單上的要求（apply the Free Adjustment Plan to this repair），接著說明資格條件與失效原因（coverage lapsed in November 2024）。第三段以 Fortunately, coverage can be restored 開頭，提出恢復方法並列出兩種費用。全信主軸是「方案為何失效、如何恢復」，C 正是這個內容的換句話說。

option_analysis.label: A
option_analysis.reason_zh: 信中確實提到技師的發現（變速線被拉長），但那是針對她描述的後變速問題所做的維修診斷，不是年度安全檢查。安全檢查還要等她同意（If you approve a safety inspection）才會進行，所以沒有檢查結果可以報告。

option_analysis.label: B
option_analysis.reason_zh: 信末說車子預計 April 12 才能取車，而且她還需要先回覆選擇哪個方案，表示目前尚未修好。通知可取車並非本信目的。

option_analysis.label: C
option_analysis.reason_zh: 正確。信中說明她的保障因未按時檢查而失效（lapsed），並告知同意安全檢查就能 reactivated immediately，與「說明失效的保障如何重新啟用」相符。

option_analysis.label: D
option_analysis.reason_zh: 方案並非新推出：她的保障在 2024 年 11 月失效，可見方案在那之前就已存在。信的重點是處理她個人的保障問題，而非推銷方案。

evidence.quote: you asked us to apply the Free Adjustment Plan to this repair
so its coverage lapsed in November 2024
Fortunately, coverage can be restored.

explanation.takeaway_zh: 主旨題要看整封信大部分篇幅在處理什麼問題，不要只抓開頭出現的細節。回應對方請求、又提出解決辦法的信，主旨常是「說明問題＋提供解方」。

questions.prompt: What is NOT indicated about the Free Adjustment Plan?

options.label: A
options.text: Customers who buy bicycles at Larkspur do not have to sign up for it separately.

options.label: B
options.text: It pays the full cost of replacing a gear cable.

options.label: C
options.text: Its eligibility depends on inspections carried out by Larkspur.

options.label: D
options.text: Its coverage can be restored while a bicycle is in for repairs.

explanation.summary_zh: 方案雖然涵蓋 cable replacement，但涵蓋的只是 labor（工資）；信中明確寫出 Parts are not covered by the plan，新變速線的 $12 無論如何都要付。因此「支付更換變速線的全部費用」與信件內容相反。
explanation.reasoning_zh: 本題的陷阱在 which covers labor for gear and brake adjustments, including cable replacement 這句：including cable replacement 說明的是 labor 涵蓋的範圍，意思是「換線的工資」也包含在內，而不是整個換線費用都免費。再對照第三段 Parts are not covered by the plan，可知零件另外收費，B 的 full cost 不成立。其餘三個選項都是原文的換句話說，需逐一對應：A 對應 automatically enrolled；C 對應 at our shop（寄件人即 Larkspur 的服務經理）；D 對應 while your bicycle is here 即可 reactivated。

option_analysis.label: A
option_analysis.reason_zh: 有提到。Like every bicycle sold at Larkspur, yours was automatically enrolled 表示在 Larkspur 買的車會自動加入方案，也就是不必另外申請（sign up separately）。

option_analysis.label: B
option_analysis.reason_zh: 正確答案（與原文相反）。就換線而言，方案涵蓋的是工資；Parts are not covered by the plan, so the new cable ($12) will be charged in either case，零件費用仍要另付，所以不是 full cost。

option_analysis.label: C
option_analysis.reason_zh: 有提到。維持資格須 receive a full safety inspection at our shop at least once every twelve months，our shop 指寄件人所屬的 Larkspur Cycles，即資格取決於在 Larkspur 做的檢查。

option_analysis.label: D
option_analysis.reason_zh: 有提到。她因後變速問題把車留在店裡維修（leaving your bicycle with us），信中說 If you approve a safety inspection ($40) while your bicycle is here, the plan will be reactivated immediately，即車子送修期間就能恢復保障。

evidence.quote: Like every bicycle sold at Larkspur, yours was automatically enrolled in the plan, which covers labor for gear and brake adjustments, including cable replacement.
a bicycle must receive a full safety inspection at our shop at least once every twelve months
Thank you for leaving your bicycle with us yesterday.
If you approve a safety inspection ($40) while your bicycle is here, the plan will be reactivated immediately
Parts are not covered by the plan, so the new cable ($12) will be charged in either case.

explanation.takeaway_zh: NOT 題要留意保障範圍的限定詞，例如本文 labor（工資）與 parts（零件）的區別。本文的 including 是在 labor 這個既定範圍內舉例，並未把範圍擴大到零件；看到 full cost 這類表示「全部」的字眼時，要回原文確認是否真的毫無例外。

questions.prompt: Where would this sentence fit most naturally in the passage? "If we do not hear from you by then, we will replace the cable without performing the inspection."
questions.target_text: If we do not hear from you by then, we will replace the cable without performing the inspection.

explanation.summary_zh: 插入句中的 by then 需要前文剛提出一個未來的期限，hear from you 也需要前文已請對方回覆。[4] 的前一句正好請她在 April 10 前回信或來電，後一句 Either way 又能涵蓋兩種結果，所以應放在 [4]。
explanation.reasoning_zh: 插入句交代「若到期限前沒收到回覆，就只換線、不做檢查」，屬於未回覆時的預設處理方式。前一句 Please reply... by April 10 to let us know which option you prefer 同時提供了期限（by then = by April 10）與回覆的動作（hear from you）。插入後，Either way 可以指「她回覆做出選擇」或「未回覆而採預設處理」兩種情況，接著說明無論如何 April 12 都能取車，前後銜接完整。

option_analysis.label: A
option_analysis.reason_zh: [1] 的前句只介紹方案涵蓋哪些工資，此時尚未出現任何期限，by then 沒有可指的時間點；信中也還沒提到安全檢查，the inspection 指涉不清。

option_analysis.label: B
option_analysis.reason_zh: [2] 前句提到的 November 2023 與 November 2024 都是已經過去的時間點，沒有任何未來的回覆期限可讓 by then 指涉；此時信中也尚未請她回覆，hear from you 沒有依據。此外，後句 Fortunately, coverage can be restored 直接承接 lapsed，插入此句會打斷這個轉折。

option_analysis.label: C
option_analysis.reason_zh: [3] 前句只說若同意檢查，工資就免費；while your bicycle is here 描述的是一段期間，不是可讓 by then 指涉的期限。信中也還沒請她回覆，放在這裡等於尚未提出請求就先講未回覆時的處理方式。

option_analysis.label: D
option_analysis.reason_zh: 正確。前句提出 by April 10 的回覆期限，by then 和 hear from you 都有明確對應；後句 Either way 涵蓋選擇與預設兩種結果，前後銜接都成立。

evidence.quote: Please reply to this e-mail or call our service desk at 555-0148 by April 10 to let us know which option you prefer. [[4]] Either way, your bicycle should be ready for pickup on April 12.
you last brought your bicycle in for an inspection in November 2023, so its coverage lapsed in November 2024. [[2]]
the labor for your repair will be free. [[3]] Without the inspection, the labor would cost $25.

explanation.takeaway_zh: 做句子插入題時，先找出插入句裡需要前文支撐的詞語（如 by then、hear from you、the inspection），再回到文中找它們能對應的具體時間、動作或名詞，最後檢查下一句是否也能順接。

questions.prompt: What is suggested about Ms. Nair?

options.label: A
options.text: She has owned her bicycle for more than a year.

options.label: B
options.text: She bought her bicycle in November 2023.

options.label: C
options.text: She requested a free brake adjustment.

options.label: D
options.text: She can pick up her bicycle on April 10.

explanation.summary_zh: 信件日期是 2025 年 4 月 8 日，而她上次帶自己的車來檢查是在 2023 年 11 月。由此可推知她至少從 2023 年 11 月起就擁有這輛車，到寄信時已超過一年。
explanation.reasoning_zh: you last brought your bicycle in for an inspection in November 2023 表示當時她已擁有這輛車，並帶來店裡檢查。對照信件日期 April 8, 2025，兩者相隔約一年五個月，因此可推論她擁有這輛車超過一年。

option_analysis.label: A
option_analysis.reason_zh: 正確。她在 2023 年 11 月就帶自己的車來檢查，而信件寫於 2025 年 4 月，可推知她擁有這輛車已超過一年。

option_analysis.label: B
option_analysis.reason_zh: 2023 年 11 月是她最近一次帶車來檢查的時間；信中並未說這是購車時間，也沒有提到購買日期（只說這輛車是 Larkspur 售出的：Like every bicycle sold at Larkspur, yours...），因此無法推知她在 2023 年 11 月購車。

option_analysis.label: C
option_analysis.reason_zh: 她要求把方案套用在 this repair 上，也就是變速線拉長造成的後變速問題。煞車調整只是方案的保障範圍之一，並非她要求的項目。

option_analysis.label: D
option_analysis.reason_zh: April 10 是回覆選擇的期限；信中說車子預計 April 12 才可取車。

evidence.quote: Date: April 8, 2025
you last brought your bicycle in for an inspection in November 2023
by April 10 to let us know which option you prefer

explanation.takeaway_zh: 推論題常需要結合信件日期與內文提到的時間點。同時要分清楚每個日期代表的事件（檢查、失效、回覆期限、取車），並區分「文中沒提到」與「文中有證據支持」，不要把未提及的事當成可推知的結論。

content.title: Clearpath Language Desk Schedule
content.scenario_summary: After a successful three-month trial at a chamber of commerce office, a translation company publishes the weekly schedule for its now permanently funded walk-in language desk for local business owners. The schedule adds two neighborhood sites, lists days, hours, and languages, and explains that sessions are walk-in Monday through Thursday but by appointment only on Friday. It also states session length, that sessions remain free, and that certified translations for court or government filings are handled through a price quotation from the main office.

blocks.text: Clearpath Language Desk: Weekly Schedule
Effective: April 7
Offered by: Clearpath Translation Services in partnership with the Dunmore Chamber of Commerce

From January through March, Clearpath staffed a trial language desk at the Chamber's Harbor Street office. During those three months, our translators helped more than 400 local business owners make sense of leases, permit applications, and supplier letters. The response was so positive that the Chamber has agreed to fund the desk permanently. Starting April 7, the desk will be open five days a week and will add two neighborhood sites closer to many of the businesses it serves.
Desk days, locations, hours, and languages
rows: Eastgate Public Library, Meeting Room B
All languages listed above (by appointment only)

blocks.text: Before You Visit
Walk-in visitors are welcome Monday through Thursday and are served in order of arrival. Friday sessions must be booked at least one day in advance at clearpath.example/desk.
Each session lasts up to 30 minutes. Please bring the original document or a clear copy.

Desk translators can explain what a document says and help you write a short reply. They cannot prepare certified translations for court or government filings. If you need one, ask the desk staff for a price quotation; Clearpath's main office will then contact you within two business days.
As during the trial, all desk sessions are free of charge.

questions.prompt: What is the main purpose of the schedule?

options.label: A
options.text: To report how many businesses used a trial service

options.label: B
options.text: To announce that a service is moving to a larger office

options.label: C
options.text: To show when and where a tested service will now be offered

options.label: D
options.text: To explain why some documents cannot be translated at the desk

explanation.summary_zh: 本文的主要目的是公告試辦成功的語言服務台，從4月7日起固定開放的日期、地點、時段與語言，因此選C。
explanation.reasoning_zh: 第一段先交代試辦期間（一月到三月）的成果，作為背景與理由；接著說明商會同意長期出資，並宣布從4月7日起每週開放五天、新增兩個社區據點。文件主體是一張列出每天地點、時段與語言的表格，標題也是Weekly Schedule。由此可知全文重點是告知這項「已經試辦過」的服務今後何時、何地提供，而試辦成果與注意事項都是輔助資訊。

option_analysis.label: A
option_analysis.reason_zh: 文中確實提到試辦期間協助了超過400位業主，但這個數字只是說明服務受歡迎、因而擴大辦理的背景理由，並非全文的主要目的；文件主體是新的每週時程表。

option_analysis.label: B
option_analysis.reason_zh: 文中沒有提到搬遷到更大的辦公室。Harbor Street辦公室的Room 2仍在週一、週三、週五使用，服務台是「新增」兩個社區據點，而不是從原地點搬走。

option_analysis.label: C
option_analysis.reason_zh: 正確。第一段說明試辦後將長期開放並新增據點，表格列出每天的地點、時段與語言，正是說明這項經過試辦的服務今後的提供時間與地點。

option_analysis.label: D
option_analysis.reason_zh: 注意事項只提到服務台不能製作用於法院或政府申辦的認證翻譯，並未說明原因；而且譯者仍可解釋文件內容，並非某些文件「不能翻譯」。這只是附帶說明，不是文件目的。

evidence.quote: The response was so positive that the Chamber has agreed to fund the desk permanently.
Starting April 7, the desk will be open five days a week and will add two neighborhood sites closer to many of the businesses it serves.
Clearpath Language Desk: Weekly Schedule

explanation.takeaway_zh: 主旨題要區分「背景／理由」與「主要告知事項」：開頭的成果數據常是鋪陳，文件真正要讀者使用的資訊（如時程表本身）才是目的所在。

questions.prompt: When can a business owner get help in Korean without making an appointment?

options.label: A
options.text: On Monday morning at the Harbor Street office

options.label: B
options.text: On Wednesday morning at the Harbor Street office

options.label: C
options.text: On Thursday afternoon at the Westfield Business Incubator

options.label: D
options.text: On Friday morning at the Harbor Street office

explanation.summary_zh: 表格中列有韓語的只有週三上午（Harbor Street辦公室）與週五（所有語言但僅限預約）；週一至週四歡迎現場臨櫃，因此不需預約即可獲得韓語協助的是週三上午，選B。
explanation.reasoning_zh: 此題要同時核對兩個條件：語言與是否需要預約。先在表格找韓語：週三列出「Korean, Mandarin」，週五則是「所有上列語言（僅限預約）」。再看注意事項：週一到週四接受現場臨櫃，週五必須至少提前一天預約。符合「韓語」且「不必預約」的只有週三上午9點到下午1點的Harbor Street辦公室。

option_analysis.label: A
option_analysis.reason_zh: 週一上午雖然在Harbor Street辦公室且可現場臨櫃，但提供的語言是西班牙語和越南語，沒有韓語。

option_analysis.label: B
option_analysis.reason_zh: 正確。週三上午在Harbor Street辦公室提供韓語和中文，且週一至週四歡迎現場臨櫃，不需預約。

option_analysis.label: C
option_analysis.reason_zh: 週四下午在Westfield Business Incubator可現場臨櫃，但語言是西班牙語和葡萄牙語，沒有韓語。

option_analysis.label: D
option_analysis.reason_zh: 週五上午確實涵蓋所有上列語言（包含韓語），但標示為僅限預約，且需至少提前一天預約，不符合「不必預約」的條件。

evidence.quote: Korean, Mandarin
All languages listed above (by appointment only)
Walk-in visitors are welcome Monday through Thursday and are served in order of arrival. Friday sessions must be booked at least one day in advance

explanation.takeaway_zh: 表格題常設下「條件組合」陷阱：找到符合第一個條件（語言）的列後，還要回到附註核對第二個條件（是否需預約），排除只符合一半的選項。

questions.prompt: What is suggested about the language desk during the trial period?

options.label: A
options.text: It operated at only one location.

options.label: B
options.text: It charged nonmembers a reduced fee.

options.label: C
options.text: It was staffed by volunteers from the Chamber.

options.label: D
options.text: It offered late-afternoon hours in Westfield.

explanation.summary_zh: 試辦期間服務台設在商會的 Harbor Street 辦公室，正式開辦後才「新增」兩個社區據點，可推知試辦時只有一個地點，選A。
explanation.reasoning_zh: 第一段說明一月到三月的試辦語言服務台設在商會的 Harbor Street 辦公室，並說從4月7日起將新增（add）兩個社區據點。對照表格，除了 Harbor Street 辦公室之外的地點只有 Eastgate Public Library 和 Westfield Business Incubator，正好對應新增的兩處。因此可以推論試辦期間只在一個地點運作。

option_analysis.label: A
option_analysis.reason_zh: 正確。試辦服務台設在 Harbor Street 辦公室，正式開辦後才新增兩個據點，可推知試辦期間只有這一個地點。

option_analysis.label: B
option_analysis.reason_zh: 與原文矛盾。最後一項注意事項說「和試辦期間一樣，所有服務台諮詢都免費」，表示試辦期間也是免費；文中也沒有區分會員與非會員收費。

option_analysis.label: C
option_analysis.reason_zh: 文中只說 Clearpath 安排譯者駐點（Clearpath staffed a trial language desk），並未說人員是來自商會的志工，因此 C 缺乏文本支持。

option_analysis.label: D
option_analysis.reason_zh: 週四下午3點到晚上7點的 Westfield 時段屬於4月7日起生效的新時程；試辦地點是 Harbor Street 辦公室，Westfield 則對應新增的社區據點，因此無法推知試辦期間在 Westfield 提供傍晚前時段。

evidence.quote: From January through March, Clearpath staffed a trial language desk at the Chamber's Harbor Street office.
will add two neighborhood sites closer to many of the businesses it serves
As during the trial, all desk sessions are free of charge.

explanation.takeaway_zh: 推論題可比對「過去狀況」與「新增／改變的內容」：既然是新增的據點，就表示原本沒有，由此推出試辦時的情形；文中未提及的細節（如人員身分）則不能當作推論依據。

questions.prompt: What should a visitor do to obtain a translation that can be submitted to a court?

options.label: A
options.text: Book a Friday session online

options.label: B
options.text: Bring the original document to Room 2

options.label: C
options.text: Contact Clearpath's main office within two business days

options.label: D
options.text: Ask the desk staff for a cost estimate

explanation.summary_zh: 服務台譯者無法製作用於法院或政府申辦的認證翻譯，需要的人應向服務台人員索取報價，因此選D（cost estimate為price quotation的換句話說）。
explanation.reasoning_zh: 題目中「可提交給法院的翻譯」對應原文的certified translations for court or government filings。注意事項說明服務台譯者不能製作這類翻譯，若有需要，應「向服務台人員索取報價」，之後由Clearpath總公司在兩個工作天內與訪客聯絡。所以訪客要做的事是請服務台人員提供費用估價。

option_analysis.label: A
option_analysis.reason_zh: 線上預約是週五諮詢時段的規定，與取得法院用認證翻譯無關；而且服務台譯者本身就無法製作認證翻譯，預約時段也解決不了。

option_analysis.label: B
option_analysis.reason_zh: 攜帶文件正本或清楚影本是一般諮詢的準備事項，Room 2也只是Harbor Street辦公室的服務地點，並非取得認證翻譯的程序。

option_analysis.label: C
option_analysis.reason_zh: 動作主體顛倒：原文是Clearpath總公司在訪客索取報價後「於兩個工作天內聯絡訪客」，並不是要訪客在兩個工作天內主動聯絡總公司。

option_analysis.label: D
option_analysis.reason_zh: 正確。原文要需要認證翻譯的訪客「ask the desk staff for a price quotation」，cost estimate正是price quotation的同義改寫。

evidence.quote: They cannot prepare certified translations for court or government filings. If you need one, ask the desk staff for a price quotation; Clearpath's main office will then contact you within two business days.

explanation.takeaway_zh: 細節題常把原文中的時間、人物或動作方向對調（誰聯絡誰）；讀到相關句子時要確認動作主體，並留意同義改寫（price quotation → cost estimate）。

content.title: Trial Workdays Before an Office Move
content.scenario_summary: Two documents connected to Hensley Mutual's office move. First, an updated RoomDesk booking confirmation issued May 30 lists all of Customer Care employee Priya Raman's trial bookings at Tallow House. She has desk 5-17 on June 4 and June 5 and desk 4-08 on June 11. Each booking has a 10:00 A.M. check-in deadline, after which the desk is released to colleagues. The confirmation replaces one sent on May 27. Second, a facilities notice dated May 20 tells Claims, Underwriting and Customer Care staff that their teams will move from 18 Kerr Street to Floors 4 and 5 of Tallow House over the weekend of June 21. It sets up a two-week trial period from June 2 to June 13 and allows each employee to book a desk on no more than four days. The first digit of a desk number shows the floor. Floor 4 is a quiet floor with height-adjustable desks that each have two monitors. Floor 5 has shared team tables with one monitor per desk and also has phone booths. The notice also covers a temporary access pass collected on an employee's first booked day, parking reimbursement of up to $14 per day at a nearby public garage, and daily surveys that will inform permanent seating plans announced on June 16.

blocks.text: RoomDesk Booking Confirmation (Updated)
Issued: May 30
Booking reference: TH-2291
Employee: Priya Raman, Customer Care
Site: Tallow House
Your reserved desks
This confirmation replaces the one sent on May 27 and lists all of your current trial bookings at Tallow House.

To check in, scan the code on your desk with the RoomDesk mobile app. If you have not checked in by the time shown, your desk is released so that colleagues can reserve it. To cancel a booking, please use the portal at least one day in advance.
Facilities Notice
To: Claims, Underwriting and Customer Care staff, 18 Kerr Street
From: Facilities Management, Hensley Mutual
Date: May 20
Subject: Trial workdays at Tallow House, June 2–13

Your teams will move from 18 Kerr Street to Floors 4 and 5 of Tallow House over the weekend of June 21. So that you can try out the new space before then, we have arranged a two-week trial period from June 2 to June 13. During the trial, each employee may reserve a desk at Tallow House on a maximum of four days in total. Reservations are made through the RoomDesk portal, and every confirmation shows a desk number.

The first digit of a desk number indicates its floor. Floor 4 is a designated quiet area, and each of its desks (4-01 to 4-40) is height-adjustable and has two monitors. Floor 5 desks (5-01 to 5-36) are arranged at shared team tables and have one monitor each. Six phone booths for private calls are also located on Floor 5.

Kerr Street ID cards will not open doors at Tallow House until the move. On your first booked day, show your RoomDesk confirmation at the lobby security desk to receive a temporary pass. Please keep this pass for any later trial days.

The Tallow House garage will not open until after the move. If you drive on a trial day, please park at the public garage on Delmar Avenue, one block north. Facilities will reimburse up to $14 per day when you submit your parking receipt with your booking reference number.
At the end of each trial day, you will receive a short online survey. Permanent seating plans will be announced on June 16 and will take your responses into account.

questions.prompt: What is the main purpose of the notice?

options.label: A
options.text: To announce a change to the date of an office move

options.label: B
options.text: To invite staff to try out a new workplace before relocating

options.label: C
options.text: To explain how permanent desks at Tallow House will be assigned

options.label: D
options.text: To remind employees to return their current ID cards

explanation.summary_zh: 通知說明，公司在 6 月 21 日週末正式搬遷前，安排了 6 月 2 日至 13 日的試用期，讓員工先到 Tallow House 預約座位、試用新的辦公空間，因此選 B。
explanation.reasoning_zh: 第一段先交代搬遷時間，接著寫 "So that you can try out the new space before then, we have arranged a two-week trial period"。同段接著說明預約天數上限，之後各段再說明座位編號與樓層設備、臨時通行證的領取方式、停車補助，以及每日問卷。這些內容都是試用期的執行細節。目的題應選能涵蓋全文的選項，而不是只對應其中一句的選項。

option_analysis.label: A
option_analysis.reason_zh: 通知確實提到搬遷時間是 "the weekend of June 21"，但沒有任何字句表示日期有變更。此選項把文中的搬遷日期誤解成「更改日期」。

option_analysis.label: B
option_analysis.reason_zh: 正確。"try out the new space before then" 對應選項中的 try out a new workplace before relocating，而且其餘各段都在說明這段試用期的安排。

option_analysis.label: C
option_analysis.reason_zh: 只有最後一句提到正式座位安排將於 6 月 16 日公布，並會參考員工的問卷回覆。通知並未說明具體如何分配座位，這只是附帶資訊，不是全文主旨。

option_analysis.label: D
option_analysis.reason_zh: 通知只說 Kerr Street 的識別證在搬遷前無法開啟 Tallow House 的門，並請員工到大廳領取臨時通行證，並沒有要求歸還現有的識別證。

evidence.quote: Your teams will move from 18 Kerr Street to Floors 4 and 5 of Tallow House over the weekend of June 21.
So that you can try out the new space before then, we have arranged a two-week trial period from June 2 to June 13.
Permanent seating plans will be announced on June 16 and will take your responses into account.
Kerr Street ID cards will not open doors at Tallow House until the move.

explanation.takeaway_zh: 目的題要找出全文各段共同服務的目標。只在單一句子中出現的資訊（例如正式座位的公布日期）可能被拿來當作干擾選項，不能代表全文主旨。

questions.prompt: What does the notice indicate about parking during the trial period?

options.label: A
options.text: Employees may use the Tallow House garage during the trial.

options.label: B
options.text: Parking passes are issued at the lobby security desk.

options.label: C
options.text: Reimbursement requests must include a desk number.

options.label: D
options.text: Facilities will repay nearby parking fees up to a set amount.

explanation.summary_zh: 通知說，試用日開車的員工可停在往北一個街區、位於 Delmar Avenue 的公共停車場，Facilities 每天最多補助 14 美元。因此 D「附近停車場的費用可在固定金額內報銷」正確。
explanation.reasoning_zh: 原文的 "one block north" 在選項中改寫為 nearby，"reimburse up to $14 per day" 則改寫為 repay ... up to a set amount。本題的正確選項是把原文換句話說，而不是照抄原文，作答時要辨認同義改寫。

option_analysis.label: A
option_analysis.reason_zh: 原文明確說 "The Tallow House garage will not open until after the move"，也就是試用期間無法使用，與選項內容相反。

option_analysis.label: B
option_analysis.reason_zh: 大廳保全櫃台發放的是進出大樓用的 temporary pass（臨時通行證），文中沒有提到停車證。此選項把門禁段落的資訊錯接到停車問題上。

option_analysis.label: C
option_analysis.reason_zh: 申請報銷時須附上的是停車收據和 "booking reference number"（預約編號），不是座位號碼（desk number）。這兩種號碼都出現在預約確認單上，容易混淆。

option_analysis.label: D
option_analysis.reason_zh: 正確。員工需停在附近的公共停車場，Facilities 依收據每天最多補助 14 美元，與 up to a set amount 相符。

evidence.quote: The Tallow House garage will not open until after the move.
please park at the public garage on Delmar Avenue, one block north
Facilities will reimburse up to $14 per day when you submit your parking receipt with your booking reference number.

explanation.takeaway_zh: 細節題可能把具體的數字條件改寫成概括說法（up to $14 per day → up to a set amount），也可能把同一份文件中性質相近的項目對調（預約編號 vs. 座位號碼）作為陷阱，要逐字核對對象。

questions.prompt: In the booking confirmation, the word "released" is closest in meaning to

options.label: A
options.text: made available

options.label: B
options.text: made public

options.label: C
options.text: discharged

options.label: D
options.text: excused

explanation.summary_zh: 確認單說，若未在指定時間前報到，"your desk is released so that colleagues can reserve it"。意思是保留的座位被「釋出、開放」給同事預約，所以選 A made available。
explanation.reasoning_zh: 後面的目的子句 so that colleagues can reserve it 說明了 released 的結果：座位變成別人可以預約的狀態。released 在此是被動語態中的過去分詞，主詞是 your desk。release 還有其他意思，例如發布消息、讓人出院、免除某人的義務，但在這個以「座位」為主詞、並以「讓同事預約」為目的的句子裡都不符合上下文。

option_analysis.label: A
option_analysis.reason_zh: 正確。代入後成為 your desk is made available so that colleagues can reserve it，語意完整，「開放」與「讓同事預約」直接呼應。

option_analysis.label: B
option_analysis.reason_zh: made public 是「公開發布」，用於 release a report、release a statement 這類資訊。本句的座位並不是被公開的消息，代入後無法表達「可供預約」。

option_analysis.label: C
option_analysis.reason_zh: discharged 常指讓病人出院、解除某人職務或排放液體等。說座位被 discharged，無法表達「開放給別人預約」。

option_analysis.label: D
option_analysis.reason_zh: excused 指准許某人免做某事，對象通常是人。說座位被 excused，不符合本句語意。

evidence.quote: If you have not checked in by the time shown, your desk is released so that colleagues can reserve it.

explanation.takeaway_zh: 多義字題要先看清楚主詞（desk）與上下文表達的目的（讓同事預約），再選出在這個搭配中保持原意、詞性也相同的選項。

questions.prompt: What is one difference between Ms. Raman's June 4 booking and her June 11 booking?

options.label: A
options.text: On June 11, she will be working on the floor with the phone booths.

options.label: B
options.text: On June 11, she must collect a temporary pass at the security desk.

options.label: C
options.text: On June 11, her desk will be equipped with two monitors.

options.label: D
options.text: On June 11, she will have a later check-in deadline.

explanation.summary_zh: 預約確認單顯示，6 月 4 日的座位是 5-17，6 月 11 日是 4-08。通知說座位號碼的第一位數字代表樓層：4 樓每張桌子有兩台螢幕，5 樓每張只有一台。因此只有 6 月 11 日的座位有兩台螢幕，選 C。
explanation.reasoning_zh: 第一步，從確認單的表格找出兩天各自的座位號碼。第二步，用通知中「座位號碼 → 樓層 → 設備」的對應關係比較兩天的差異。只看其中一份文件無法得出答案：確認單沒有說明設備，通知則無法告訴我們她哪一天坐哪一張桌子。

option_analysis.label: A
option_analysis.reason_zh: 通知說電話亭位於 5 樓。6 月 11 日她的座位 4-08 在 4 樓，反而是 6 月 4 日的 5-17 才和電話亭在同一層。選項把兩天的情況弄反了。

option_analysis.label: B
option_analysis.reason_zh: 通知規定在「第一個預約日」到大廳保全櫃台領取臨時通行證，之後的試用日繼續使用同一張。確認單列出她目前所有的試用預約，其中最早的是 6 月 4 日，所以 6 月 11 日並不是她的第一個預約日。

option_analysis.label: C
option_analysis.reason_zh: 正確。4-08 屬於 4-01 至 4-40 的範圍，位於 4 樓，該樓每張桌子都有兩台螢幕。6 月 4 日的 5-17 在 5 樓，只有一台。

option_analysis.label: D
option_analysis.reason_zh: 表格中三天的報到期限都是 10:00 A.M.，6 月 11 日的期限並沒有比較晚。

evidence.quote: Floor 4 is a designated quiet area, and each of its desks (4-01 to 4-40) is height-adjustable and has two monitors.
Floor 5 desks (5-01 to 5-36) are arranged at shared team tables and have one monitor each.
On your first booked day, show your RoomDesk confirmation at the lobby security desk to receive a temporary pass.

explanation.takeaway_zh: 遇到代碼（如座位號碼）時，先在一份文件找出個人的日期與代碼，再到另一份文件查出該代碼代表的條件或設備，最後比較題目問的兩個項目。

content.title: Replacement Lids for a Printed Tea Tin Order
content.scenario_summary: Noor Haddad, operations manager at Calloway Leaf Tea, e-mails tin supplier Pellworth Tinworks. One of four 500-tin cartons of printed Autumn Ember tins arrived with plain silver lids instead of the approved embossed copper lids. Cartons 1, 2 and 4 will fill new retailer Ivers Market's 1,500-tin order for pickup on September 19, leaving Carton 3 for the company's own online shop, where sales begin October 1. She asks for 500 replacement lids. She also asks to add 150 extra tins at the original unit price for café owners on October sales visits, shipped to the Fenwick Avenue office. In addition, she notes that the Tanner Road warehouse is closed September 12–13, so deliveries on those dates must go to the Linden Street shop. The account manager apologizes and explains that silver lids for another client's gift sets were packed on the same line. He adds a lid check before cartons are sealed. Matching lids will go by express courier and are scheduled to arrive September 12, following her delivery instructions. The extra tins come from surplus printing and will leave by regular freight on September 15 for the Fenwick Avenue office, billed separately at $0.84 each. The replacement lids, the express delivery and the September 17 collection of the silver lids by Pellworth's own driver are free.

blocks.text: From: Noor Haddad <n.haddad@callowayleaf.example>
To: Graham Osei <g.osei@pellworthtin.example>
Date: September 9
Subject: Order PW-2238 – incorrect lids
Dear Mr. Osei,

The 2,000 printed tins for our new Autumn Ember blend arrived on September 6 in four cartons of 500 tins and lids each. The tins look excellent, but the lids in Carton 3 are plain silver ones, not the embossed copper lids we approved. Cartons 1, 2, and 4 are correct.

Ivers Market, which will start stocking our teas in its twelve stores this autumn, has ordered 1,500 tins for pickup on September 19. We'll fill that order from the three correct cartons, which leaves Carton 3 for our own online shop, where Autumn Ember goes on sale on October 1. Could you send 500 copper lids to replace the silver ones?

Our marketing team would also like 150 extra tins with copper lids to hand out to café owners during sales visits in October. Could these be added at the original unit price? If so, please ship them directly to the team at our Fenwick Avenue office.
Finally, our Tanner Road warehouse will be closed on September 12 and 13, so any delivery arriving on those dates should go to our shop at 82 Linden Street instead.
Best regards, Noor Haddad, Operations Manager, Calloway Leaf Tea
From: Graham Osei <g.osei@pellworthtin.example>
To: Noor Haddad <n.haddad@callowayleaf.example>
Date: September 10
Subject: RE: Order PW-2238 – incorrect lids
Dear Ms. Haddad,

Please accept my apologies. The silver lids were meant for another client's gift sets, which were packed on the same line as your order that day. From now on, our packing team will check the lids in every carton against the order sheet before sealing it.

We will send 500 copper lids from the same production run as your order by express courier tomorrow, and they are scheduled to arrive on September 12. The courier has the delivery instructions from your message.

We printed surplus Autumn Ember tins during your run, so we can supply the 150 extra tins, complete with copper lids, at the original price of $0.84 each. They will leave our plant by regular freight on September 15, go directly to your Fenwick Avenue office, and appear on a separate invoice.
There is no charge for the replacement lids, the express delivery, or the collection of the silver lids, which our own driver will pick up from your warehouse on September 17.
Kind regards, Graham Osei, Account Manager, Pellworth Tinworks

explanation.summary_zh: 第一封郵件主要是通報第3箱的蓋子與核准的款式不符，並請對方寄送替換蓋子，因此答案是 (B)。
explanation.reasoning_zh: 第一段說明2,000個罐子分四箱送達。第3箱裝的是素面銀色蓋子，而不是雙方核准的壓紋銅色蓋子，第1、2、4箱則正確。第二段結尾提出核心請求：寄500個銅色蓋子來替換銀色蓋子。後面加訂150個罐子、倉庫休息日改送地址都是附帶事項。(B) 的 a problem with part of a delivery，正是「四箱中只有一箱出錯」的改寫。

option_analysis.label: A
option_analysis.reason_zh: 信中提到 Ivers Market 的訂單 for pickup on September 19，只是在說明出貨時程，並沒有要求更改取貨日期。

option_analysis.label: B
option_analysis.reason_zh: 正確。四箱中只有第3箱的蓋子有誤，也就是「部分到貨品有問題」；信中接著請對方寄送替換蓋子。

option_analysis.label: C
option_analysis.reason_zh: 壓紋銅色蓋是先前已核准的設計（the embossed copper lids we approved）。寄件者是指出收到的蓋子與核准設計不符，並不是要核准新設計。

option_analysis.label: D
option_analysis.reason_zh: 寄件者沒有取消任何品項，反而詢問能否加訂150個罐子，與「取消部分訂單」方向相反。

evidence.quote: The tins look excellent, but the lids in Carton 3 are plain silver ones, not the embossed copper lids we approved.
Could you send 500 copper lids to replace the silver ones?

explanation.takeaway_zh: 判斷郵件目的時，先找開頭提出的問題和隨後的明確請求；本信後段的加訂與地址變更屬於附帶事項，不是寫信的主因。

questions.prompt: According to Mr. Osei's e-mail, what is NOT something Pellworth Tinworks will do?

options.label: A

explanation.summary_zh: 替換蓋子明天以快遞寄出，預定9月12日送達；150個加訂罐子則是9月15日以一般貨運寄往 Fenwick Avenue 辦公室。兩者並非同批寄送，所以 (D) 不是該公司會做的事。
explanation.reasoning_zh: NOT 題要逐一核對選項。A：by express courier 表示以快遞寄送替換蓋子。B：From now on 引出新做法，包裝團隊封箱前會依訂單表核對蓋子。C：our own driver 會到客戶倉庫收回銀色蓋子。D 則與內文矛盾：蓋子是 by express courier tomorrow、scheduled to arrive on September 12；加訂罐子是 will leave our plant by regular freight on September 15，而且送往 Fenwick Avenue 辦公室。兩批貨的出貨日期、運送方式和目的地都不同。同一封信同時提到兩批貨，容易讓人誤以為會一起寄出。

option_analysis.label: A
option_analysis.reason_zh: 有提及。by express courier 即以快遞寄送替換蓋子，對應 expedited service（加急服務）；同信中加訂罐子用的則是 regular freight。

option_analysis.label: B
option_analysis.reason_zh: 有提及。From now on 表示今後改變做法：包裝團隊封箱前會依訂單表核對每一箱的蓋子，等於在包裝流程中新增一道步驟，避免同樣的錯誤。

option_analysis.label: C
option_analysis.reason_zh: 有提及。our own driver 指 Pellworth 公司自己的司機，他會在9月17日到客戶倉庫收回銀色蓋子，也就是選項所說的 the silver lids。

option_analysis.label: D
option_analysis.reason_zh: 正確答案（與內文矛盾）。替換蓋子明天（9月11日）快遞寄出，預定9月12日送達；加訂罐子9月15日才以一般貨運從工廠出貨，並送往 Fenwick Avenue 辦公室，不是與蓋子同批寄送。

evidence.quote: We will send 500 copper lids from the same production run as your order by express courier tomorrow, and they are scheduled to arrive on September 12.
They will leave our plant by regular freight on September 15, go directly to your Fenwick Avenue office, and appear on a separate invoice.

explanation.summary_zh: 第一封郵件說 Ivers Market 今年秋天「將開始」在旗下十二家店販售寄件公司的茶，可推知寫信時這些店還沒有販售 Calloway Leaf Tea 的茶，答案為 (A)。

option_analysis.label: C

content.title: Copperleaf Entrance Planters: Palette Correction
content.scenario_summary: Copperleaf Landscape Studio advertises spring entrance-planter packages for local businesses. The advertisement includes a palette table that lists the recommended hours of direct sun for each palette, a $240-per-planter price with a two-planter minimum, optional drip irrigation, and a spring offer: free October replanting with autumn varieties for orders of three or more planters submitted by April 15. On April 9, the practice manager of a physiotherapy clinic orders three charcoal planters with the Partial Shade palette and no irrigation. She notes that her north-facing entrance gets about three hours of direct sun. On April 11, the studio's client coordinator emails every client who ordered after the advertisement ran. He explains that the light ranges were misprinted: Partial Shade actually needs four to six hours, and entrances with less than four hours should use Deep Shade. He offers a free palette change if clients reply by April 18; otherwise, the designer will review the choice with them at the site visit before any plants are ordered. The corrected table was posted online that morning.

blocks.text: Copperleaf Landscape Studio
Spring Entrance Planters for Local Businesses

First impressions start at the door. Our designers create container gardens suited to your building, your light conditions and your budget. Every order includes fiberglass planters in charcoal, sand or white, a planting plan, premium soil and installation. Before any plan is finalized, a designer visits your site to take measurements and observe how much direct sun the entrance receives.
Choose your palette

Dear Ms. Kowalczyk,

Thank you for choosing Copperleaf for your entrance planters. We are contacting every client who has ordered since our spring advertisement appeared, because the light ranges in its palette table were printed incorrectly.

If we do not hear from you by then, your designer will review the choice with you during the site visit, before any plants are ordered.
Nothing else in the advertisement was affected, and we posted a corrected table at copperleafstudio.example/planters this morning. We apologize for the confusion.
Dev Malhotra, Client Coordinator, Copperleaf Landscape Studio
