options.label: D
options.text: To request details about the sunlight at an entrance

explanation.summary_zh: 電子郵件的主旨是「更正春季花槽廣告」。第一段說明廣告中植栽組合（palette）表格的日照範圍印錯了，所以寫信目的是更正先前刊登的資訊，答案為 B。
explanation.reasoning_zh: 目的題先看主旨與開頭段落。主旨寫 Correction to our spring planter advertisement；第一段說明店家正在聯絡所有在廣告刊出後下單的客戶，原因是 palette table 的日照範圍 printed incorrectly。後面幾段（正確的日照範圍、如何免費更改、網站已貼出更正表格）都在處理這項錯誤。因此全信的主要目的是更正已公布的資訊，B 的 information that appeared in an advertisement 正是同義改寫。

option_analysis.label: A
option_analysis.reason_zh: 信中雖提到設計師的 site visit，但只說未回覆時會在勘查時討論植栽組合，並沒有提供勘查的日期或時間，也不是寫信的主要目的。

option_analysis.label: B
option_analysis.reason_zh: 正確。主旨與第一段都指出廣告中的植栽組合表格印錯，全信內容都圍繞這項更正。

option_analysis.label: C
option_analysis.reason_zh: 信中說 all palettes are priced the same，改選組合不收費，並沒有宣布任何價格變動。

option_analysis.label: D
option_analysis.reason_zh: 信中請「選了 Partial Shade 但日照不足四小時」的客戶在 4 月 18 日前回覆以更新訂單，並不是要求說明入口的日照情形；Kowalczyk 女士的日照描述早已寫在訂購單上。

evidence.quote: Correction to our spring planter advertisement
because the light ranges in its palette table were printed incorrectly

explanation.takeaway_zh: 目的題優先看主旨與開頭段落，再確認後續內容是否都在支撐同一件事。只在信中順帶提到的細節（例如到場勘查）常被設計成陷阱。

questions.prompt: According to the e-mail, what will happen if a client who needs to change palettes does not reply by April 18?

options.label: A
options.text: The order will be switched to the Deep Shade palette automatically.

options.label: B
options.text: The installation will be postponed until a reply is received.

options.label: C
options.text: The palette will be discussed with the client during the site visit.

options.label: D
options.text: The planters will be priced according to a different palette.

explanation.summary_zh: 信中說，若到期仍未收到回覆，設計師會在到場勘查時與客戶一起檢視所選的植栽組合，而且是在訂購植物之前進行，故選 C。
explanation.reasoning_zh: 題目問的是「需要更換組合的客戶若未在 4 月 18 日前回覆」的結果。對應句是 If we do not hear from you by then, your designer will review the choice with you during the site visit, before any plants are ordered。其中 review the choice with you 改寫為 be discussed with the client。要注意條件與結果必須對應：信中並沒有說未回覆時會自動更換組合、延後安裝或改變價格。

option_analysis.label: A
option_analysis.reason_zh: 信中雖建議日照不足四小時的入口改用 Deep Shade，但未回覆時的處理方式是 review the choice with you（與客戶一起檢視），並不是由店家自動換成 Deep Shade。

option_analysis.label: B
option_analysis.reason_zh: 信中完全沒有提到延後安裝。未回覆時只是改在勘查時討論，並未說訂單會暫停到收到回覆為止。

option_analysis.label: C
option_analysis.reason_zh: 正確，對應 your designer will review the choice with you during the site visit。

option_analysis.label: D
option_analysis.reason_zh: 信中明說 all palettes are priced the same，不論採用哪一種組合價格都相同，因此不會改依另一種組合計價。

evidence.quote: If we do not hear from you by then, your designer will review the choice with you during the site visit, before any plants are ordered.
There is no charge for the change, since all palettes are priced the same.

explanation.takeaway_zh: 遇到 if 條件題，先找出與題目條件相符的子句，再核對它的結果。不要把信中其他段落的建議（例如改用 Deep Shade）誤當成未回覆時的處理方式。

questions.prompt: According to the advertisement, what is included in every order?

options.label: A
options.text: Soil and installation

options.label: B
options.text: Drip irrigation for each planter

options.label: C
options.text: Monthly maintenance visits

options.label: D
options.text: Planters in a custom color

explanation.summary_zh: 廣告寫明每筆訂單都包含花槽、種植計畫、優質土壤與安裝，因此 Soil and installation 為正確答案 A。
explanation.reasoning_zh: 題目的 every order 對應廣告中的 Every order includes...。所列項目包括 premium soil and installation，正是選項 A 的內容。其他選項不是需要加價的項目，就是廣告中沒有提到。

option_analysis.label: A
option_analysis.reason_zh: 正確。premium soil and installation 列在 Every order includes 之後，屬於每筆訂單都包含的內容。

option_analysis.label: B
option_analysis.reason_zh: 滴灌系統是加購項目：Drip irrigation can be added for $70 per planter，並非每筆訂單都包含。

option_analysis.label: C
option_analysis.reason_zh: 廣告完全沒有提到每月到府維護的服務。

option_analysis.label: D
option_analysis.reason_zh: 廣告只提供 charcoal、sand、white 三種標準顏色，並沒有提到可以訂製其他顏色。

evidence.quote: Every order includes fiberglass planters in charcoal, sand or white, a planting plan, premium soil and installation.
Drip irrigation can be added for $70 per planter.

explanation.takeaway_zh: 細節題要分清「已包含」（includes）與「可加購」（can be added for）。在這則廣告中，附有價格的 can be added 項目屬於額外付費選項。

questions.prompt: Based on the corrected palette information, what is most likely true in Ms. Kowalczyk's case?

options.label: A
options.text: Her entrance gets too much direct sun for the Deep Shade palette.

options.label: B
options.text: Her entrance is better suited to the Full Sun palette.

options.label: C
options.text: Her planters will need drip irrigation because of the limited light.

options.label: D
options.text: Her chosen palette requires more direct sun than her entrance receives.

explanation.summary_zh: 訂購單顯示 Kowalczyk 女士選了 Partial Shade，且入口每天約只有三小時直射日照。更正後的資訊指出 Partial Shade 需要四到六小時，所以她選的組合需要比入口實際更多的日照，答案為 D。
explanation.reasoning_zh: 本題需結合兩份文件。（1）訂購單：Palette: Partial Shade，備註寫 about three hours of direct sun a day。（2）電子郵件的更正：Partial Shade 需要 four to six hours，不足四小時的入口應改用 Deep Shade。三小時少於四小時，所以她原本選的組合日照需求高於入口條件。只看原廣告（Partial Shade 標示為兩到六小時）會以為她選得正確；只看電子郵件則不知道她選了哪種組合、入口有多少日照，因此必須結合訂購單與電子郵件。題目用 most likely，是因為三小時是她自己的估計值。

option_analysis.label: A
option_analysis.reason_zh: 這是依原廣告的錯誤範圍得出的結論。原表格寫 Deep Shade 適用 Less than two hours of direct sun，三小時看似太多；但更正後，不足四小時的入口應使用 Deep Shade，三小時正好符合，並不是日照太多。

option_analysis.label: B
option_analysis.reason_zh: Full Sun 需要超過六小時的直射日照（More than six hours of direct sun），信中也確認這個範圍無誤。她的入口約三小時，遠遠不足，不可能更適合 Full Sun。

option_analysis.label: C
option_analysis.reason_zh: 訂購單上 Drip irrigation 填的是 No，而且沒有任何文件把滴灌系統與日照不足連結起來；滴灌只是加購項目。

option_analysis.label: D
option_analysis.reason_zh: 正確。約三小時的日照少於更正後 Partial Shade 所需的最低四小時。

evidence.quote: Palette: Partial Shade
the doorway gets about three hours of direct sun a day
The Partial Shade palette needs four to six hours of direct sun, not two to six as stated.
Entrances receiving less than four hours should use the Deep Shade palette instead.

explanation.takeaway_zh: 題組中出現「更正」時，要以更正後的資訊為準，並把個人資料（例如訂購單內容）代入新的標準檢查。舊資訊常被設計成陷阱選項。

questions.prompt: What is indicated about Ms. Kowalczyk's order?

options.label: A
options.text: It includes drip irrigation for each planter.

options.label: B
options.text: It qualifies for a free seasonal replanting.

options.label: C
options.text: It was submitted after the advertisement was corrected.

options.label: D
options.text: It falls below the studio's minimum number of planters.

explanation.summary_zh: 廣告的春季優惠是：4 月 15 日前訂購三個以上花槽，十月可免費換種秋季植物。訂購單顯示她在 4 月 9 日訂了 3 個花槽，符合條件，答案為 B。
explanation.reasoning_zh: 本題需結合廣告的優惠條件（three or more planters、by April 15）與訂購單（Number of planters: 3、Date submitted: April 9）。三個符合「三個以上」，4 月 9 日也早於 4 月 15 日。選項中的 free seasonal replanting 是 replant them with autumn varieties in October at no charge 的改寫。此外，電子郵件說 Nothing else in the advertisement was affected，表示這項優惠並未被更正。

option_analysis.label: A
option_analysis.reason_zh: 訂購單的 Drip irrigation 欄位填的是 No，她沒有加購滴灌系統。

option_analysis.label: B
option_analysis.reason_zh: 正確。訂購數量（3 個）與下單日期（4 月 9 日）都符合廣告中的春季優惠條件。

option_analysis.label: C
option_analysis.reason_zh: 訂購單日期是 4 月 9 日；電子郵件日期為 4 月 11 日，並說 we posted a corrected table ... this morning，可見更正是在她下單之後才公布，她是在更正前下單的。

option_analysis.label: D
option_analysis.reason_zh: 廣告的最低訂購量是兩個（a minimum order of two），她訂了三個，並未低於最低數量。

evidence.quote: Submit an order for three or more planters by April 15, and we will replant them with autumn varieties in October at no charge.
Date submitted: April 9
Number of planters: 3
Drip irrigation: No
Date: April 11
we posted a corrected table at copperleafstudio.example/planters this morning
with a minimum order of two

explanation.takeaway_zh: 優惠資格題要逐一核對每個條件（數量、期限）是否都符合。在本題中，three or more 包含剛好三個的情況。

content.title: Westmere Association Spring Seminar: Revised Workshop Schedule
content.scenario_summary: The events coordinator of the Westmere Association of Certified Bookkeepers emails registrants of its Spring Practice Seminar (May 16–17) after the conference centre's Larch Room is closed on May 17 for electrical upgrades. The payroll-software workshop moves from Saturday morning to Friday afternoon in the Birch Room. The records-retention workshop moves to the Main Hall and starts at 2:00 instead of 1:30, because the members' lunch is served there first. Registrants may switch workshops (same fee) or cancel for a full refund. Those who ordered the now-outdated printed handbook may choose the free digital version only and receive a refund. A member's invoice shows a Saturday-only pass at the member rate, the payroll workshop ($60) and a printed handbook ($15). In his reply, the member, a bookkeeper in a small office who meets clients on Friday afternoons, asks to switch to the records-retention workshop and to receive only the digital handbook, which results in a $15 refund.

blocks.text: From: Mireille Okafor <events@westmere-acb.example>
To: Spring Practice Seminar registrants
Date: April 22, 2025
Subject: Revised workshop schedule
Dear Registrant,
The Halden Conference Centre has informed us that the Larch Room will be closed on Saturday, May 17, for electrical upgrades. As a result, both hands-on workshops have been rescheduled as follows.
Workshop schedule changes
rows: Saturday, May 17, 9:00 a.m.–12:00 noon, Larch Room

blocks.text: Workshop 2 will start half an hour later because the members' lunch is being served in the Main Hall beforehand and centre staff need time to reset the room. As the hall is much larger than the Larch Room, seats remain available.

Registrants with a Saturday-only pass who booked Workshop 1 may attend the Friday session without buying a Friday pass. If the revised time does not suit you, you may switch to the other workshop or cancel for a full refund of the workshop fee. Both workshops cost the same, so switching involves no extra charge or refund.

The printed seminar handbook went to press before these changes, so its schedule pages are out of date. An updated digital handbook will be emailed to all registrants on May 9. If you ordered a printed copy but would now prefer the digital version only, we will refund what you paid for it.
Please reply with any changes by May 2. Refunds go to the original payment method within ten business days.
Mireille Okafor, Events Coordinator, Westmere Association of Certified Bookkeepers
Westmere Association of Certified Bookkeepers — Invoice
Invoice number: SPS-0417
Invoice date: April 3, 2025
Billed to: Daniel Ferreira, Ferreira Bookkeeping, 18 Calder Street, Rosslyn
Member number: WA-2268
Spring Practice Seminar, May 16–17, Halden Conference Centre
Payment received: $170.00 by credit card ending in 4471 on April 3, 2025
Balance due: $0.00
Member rates apply only to members whose annual dues are current.
From: Daniel Ferreira <d.ferreira@ferreirabookkeeping.example>
To: Mireille Okafor <events@westmere-acb.example>
Date: April 24, 2025
Subject: RE: Revised workshop schedule
Dear Ms. Okafor,

Thank you for the early notice. Unfortunately, the new slot for the payroll workshop won't work for me. Friday afternoons are when my clients drop off their weekly paperwork, and with only one assistant in the office, I can't step away.

Since I'll be at the centre on Saturday anyway, I'd like to move to the records retention workshop instead. Please also change my handbook order to the digital version only. I'd rather read it on my tablet than carry a printed copy around.
Could you confirm both changes? My invoice number is SPS-0417.
Best regards, Daniel Ferreira, Ferreira Bookkeeping

questions.prompt: What is the main purpose of the first email?

options.label: A
options.text: To report that the seminar will move to a different venue

options.label: B
options.text: To inform registrants of new workshop times and locations

options.label: C
options.text: To remind members to renew their annual dues

options.label: D
options.text: To announce that workshop registration has reopened

explanation.summary_zh: 第一封電子郵件主要是通知報名者：兩場實作工作坊的時間和教室都已更動。因此答案是 B。
explanation.reasoning_zh: 信件開頭先說明 Larch Room 在 5 月 17 日因電力升級而關閉，接著寫「As a result, both hands-on workshops have been rescheduled as follows」，並用表格列出原本與新的時間及教室。後面幾段則說明配合改期可選擇的做法，包括轉換場次、取消退費和講義退費。可見全信重點在告知時程與地點的變更。選項中的 new workshop times and locations 是 rescheduled 以及表格欄位 time and room 的改寫。

option_analysis.label: A
option_analysis.reason_zh: 研討會仍在 Halden Conference Centre 舉行，只有場館內的教室從 Larch Room 改為 Birch Room 或 Main Hall，並沒有換到另一個場地（venue）。

option_analysis.label: B
option_analysis.reason_zh: 正確。信中說明兩場工作坊已重新排程，並以表格列出新的時間與教室。

option_analysis.label: C
option_analysis.reason_zh: 「年費需有效」的說法只出現在第二份文件（發票）的附註中，第一封信並沒有提醒會員續繳年費。

option_analysis.label: D
option_analysis.reason_zh: 信中提到 Main Hall 較大，因此「seats remain available」。這是說明已報名者可以轉換場次，並不是宣布工作坊重新開放報名。

evidence.quote: As a result, both hands-on workshops have been rescheduled as follows.
The Halden Conference Centre has informed us that the Larch Room will be closed on Saturday, May 17, for electrical upgrades.
seats remain available
Member rates apply only to members whose annual dues are current.

explanation.takeaway_zh: 作答主旨題時，要看開頭交代的事件（如 As a result...），以及全文大部分篇幅在處理什麼。附帶的細節（例如仍有空位）不等於主旨。

questions.prompt: According to the first email, why will Workshop 2 start later than originally planned?

options.label: A
options.text: Its new room will first be used for a meal.

options.label: B
options.text: Electrical work in its original room will run longer than planned.

options.label: C
options.text: More members have signed up for it than expected.

options.label: D
options.text: Its room must first be used for Workshop 1.

explanation.summary_zh: Workshop 2 延後半小時開始，是因為新教室 Main Hall 會先供應會員午餐，餐後場館人員需要時間重新布置。因此選 A。
explanation.reasoning_zh: 答案就寫在「Workshop 2 will start half an hour later because ...」之後：會員午餐會先在 Main Hall 供應，場館人員需要時間 reset the room。選項 A 的 its new room will first be used for a meal 正是 lunch is being served in the Main Hall beforehand 的改寫。要注意，信中另一個原因「Larch Room 電力升級」是兩場工作坊都必須換教室的理由，不是 Workshop 2 延後半小時的理由。

option_analysis.label: A
option_analysis.reason_zh: 正確。Main Hall 會先供應會員午餐，之後需要重新布置，所以 Workshop 2 延後半小時開始。

option_analysis.label: B
option_analysis.reason_zh: 電力升級是 Larch Room 當天關閉的原因。信中沒有提到工程會延誤，而且 Workshop 2 已改到 Main Hall，不需要等原教室的工程結束。

option_analysis.label: C
option_analysis.reason_zh: 信中只說 Main Hall 比 Larch Room 大很多、仍有空位，並沒有提到報名人數超出預期，這也不是延後開始的原因。

option_analysis.label: D
option_analysis.reason_zh: 表格顯示 Workshop 1 改到 5 月 16 日（星期五）在 Birch Room 舉行，不會在 5 月 17 日使用 Main Hall，所以不是 Workshop 2 延後的原因。

evidence.quote: Workshop 2 will start half an hour later because the members' lunch is being served in the Main Hall beforehand and centre staff need time to reset the room.
The Halden Conference Centre has informed us that the Larch Room will be closed on Saturday, May 17, for electrical upgrades.
As the hall is much larger than the Larch Room, seats remain available.
Friday, May 16, 1:30–4:30 p.m., Birch Room

explanation.takeaway_zh: 同一篇文章可能出現好幾個原因。作答時要確認每個 because 解釋的是哪一個結果，例如「教室關閉的原因」和「開始時間延後的原因」並不相同。

questions.prompt: What can be inferred about Mr. Ferreira from the invoice?

options.label: A
options.text: He registered to attend both days of the seminar.

options.label: B
options.text: He still owes part of the amount he was billed.

options.label: C
options.text: His annual membership dues are up to date.

options.label: D
options.text: He received a discount for registering early.

explanation.summary_zh: 發票顯示 Ferreira 先生的通行證以會員價計費，而附註說明會員價只適用於年費有效的會員。由此可推論他的年費已繳清，因此選 C。
explanation.reasoning_zh: 表格第一列「Seminar pass: Saturday, May 17 (member rate)」表示他被收取會員價。發票下方又說明「Member rates apply only to members whose annual dues are current.」。把「他享有會員價」和「會員價的適用條件」結合起來，就能推出他目前的年費有效（up to date）。這個推論完全根據發票上寫明的條件，不需要額外假設。

option_analysis.label: A
option_analysis.reason_zh: 發票只列出 5 月 17 日（星期六）的單日通行證，沒有星期五的通行證，因此不能說他報名了兩天。

option_analysis.label: B
option_analysis.reason_zh: 發票顯示已收到 $170.00 的付款，而且「Balance due: $0.00」，沒有尚未付清的金額。

option_analysis.label: C
option_analysis.reason_zh: 正確。他被收取 member rate，而會員價只給年費有效的會員，所以可推論他的年費已繳清。

option_analysis.label: D
option_analysis.reason_zh: 他享有的較低價格標示為 member rate（會員價），發票上沒有任何早鳥優惠（early registration）的記載。

evidence.quote: Seminar pass: Saturday, May 17 (member rate)
Member rates apply only to members whose annual dues are current.
Balance due: $0.00

explanation.takeaway_zh: 推論題常把「適用條件」（如 only to members whose dues are current）和「某人確實適用」（如 member rate）結合起來。若選項把優惠換成其他名目（如早鳥價），就要回到原文核對。

questions.prompt: According to the revised schedule, when will the workshop that Mr. Ferreira wants to attend begin?

options.label: A
options.text: At 1:30 p.m. on May 16

options.label: B
options.text: At 9:00 a.m. on May 17

options.label: C
options.text: At 1:30 p.m. on May 17

options.label: D
options.text: At 2:00 p.m. on May 17

explanation.summary_zh: Ferreira 先生在第二封電子郵件中表示要改參加 records retention 工作坊。根據第一封信表格的新時程，Workshop 2: Records Retention Rules 在 5 月 17 日下午 2:00 開始，因此選 D。
explanation.reasoning_zh: 第一步，從第三份文件得知他無法參加改到星期五的 payroll 工作坊，想改上「the records retention workshop」。第二步，回到第一份文件的表格，找到 Workshop 2: Records Retention Rules 這一列，Revised time and room 欄寫的是「Saturday, May 17, 2:00–5:00 p.m., Main Hall」。題目問的是新時程，所以要看 Revised 欄，而不是原本的 1:30。第三份文件沒有寫時間，第一份文件也沒說他選哪一場，兩份文件必須合併才能作答。

option_analysis.label: A
option_analysis.reason_zh: 5 月 16 日下午 1:30 是 Workshop 1（Cloud Payroll Tools）的新時間，正是 Ferreira 先生說無法配合的時段。

option_analysis.label: B
option_analysis.reason_zh: 5 月 17 日上午 9:00 是 Workshop 1 原本的時間，這個時段已改到星期五，也不是他想參加的工作坊。

option_analysis.label: C
option_analysis.reason_zh: 5 月 17 日下午 1:30 是 Workshop 2 原本在 Larch Room 的開始時間，新時程已延後半小時。

option_analysis.label: D
option_analysis.reason_zh: 正確。他選擇的 Records Retention Rules 工作坊，新時間是 5 月 17 日下午 2:00 到 5:00，地點在 Main Hall。

evidence.quote: the new slot for the payroll workshop won't work for me
I'd like to move to the records retention workshop instead
Saturday, May 17, 2:00–5:00 p.m., Main Hall
Saturday, May 17, 1:30–4:30 p.m., Larch Room

explanation.takeaway_zh: 遇到有「原本／新」兩欄的時程表時，先從另一份文件確認人物選的是哪一列，再看清楚題目問的是哪一欄。

questions.prompt: Once his requested changes are made, how much will Mr. Ferreira most likely be refunded?

explanation.summary_zh: Ferreira 先生是「轉換」工作坊而不是取消；兩場費用相同，轉換不會退款。只有改為僅收數位版講義這一項，可以退回印刷版講義的費用，而發票上該項金額是 $15.00，因此選 A。
explanation.reasoning_zh: 三份文件各提供一部分資訊。第三份文件：他要改上 records retention 工作坊，並把講義改成只要數位版。第一份文件：兩場工作坊價格相同，轉換「no extra charge or refund」；改成只要數位版的人，會退還印刷版所付的金額（refund what you paid for it）。第二份文件：印刷版講義（Printed seminar handbook）為 $15.00。此外，他的信寫於 4 月 24 日，早於 5 月 2 日的回覆期限。綜合以上資訊，應退金額為 $15.00。

option_analysis.label: A
option_analysis.reason_zh: 正確。只有印刷版講義改為數位版可以退費，發票上該項為 $15.00；轉換工作坊不涉及退款。

option_analysis.label: B
option_analysis.reason_zh: $60.00 是 Workshop 1 的費用，只有取消工作坊才會全額退還。他選擇轉到另一場，而兩場價格相同，所以不退款。

option_analysis.label: C
option_analysis.reason_zh: $75.00 是工作坊費用加上印刷版講義，必須同時取消工作坊和印刷版講義才會是這個金額，與他的要求不符。

option_analysis.label: D
option_analysis.reason_zh: $95.00 是星期六通行證的費用。他表示星期六仍會到場，並沒有取消通行證。

evidence.quote: I'd like to move to the records retention workshop instead
Please also change my handbook order to the digital version only.
Both workshops cost the same, so switching involves no extra charge or refund.
If you ordered a printed copy but would now prefer the digital version only, we will refund what you paid for it.
Printed seminar handbook

explanation.takeaway_zh: 跨文件判斷退款金額時，先確認人物實際選了哪個選項（轉換或取消），再到規則文件確認該選項是否退款，最後才到發票找出對應金額。

content.title: Educator Open House: Rescheduled Demonstration and Extended Pre-Order Deadline
content.scenario_summary: Harlow Street Art Supply sends a booking confirmation to Tobias Renner, a middle-school art teacher. He has reserved places for himself and a colleague in Sessions A and D of the store's May 10 Educator Open House. The confirmation describes a 15 percent pre-order offer due May 13, with free delivery to the attendee's school for orders of $250 or more. In a later e-mail to all registered attendees, the events coordinator explains that Corrigan Colorworks' demonstration samples are delayed at a distribution center, so that demonstration moves to May 22 in its original room. Attendees keep their places, and anyone who cannot attend should reply so that the place can go to a waitlisted educator. The pre-order deadline is extended to May 27. Apart from the deadline, the offer's terms, including free delivery, are unchanged, although the e-mail does not restate the delivery threshold. The session schedule lists each session's time, topic, presenter and room, which shows that Session D is Corrigan's demonstration.

blocks.text: Harlow Street Art Supply – Booking Confirmation
Booking reference: EOH-2318
Event: Educator Open House, May 10, 9:30 A.M.–3:00 P.M.
Location: 214 Harlow Street, Westbridge
Booked by: Tobias Renner, Visual Arts Department, Fairholme Middle School
Places reserved: 2 (Tobias Renner, Mina Calloway)
Sessions reserved for both attendees: A and D
Thank you for registering. Please check in at the front counter, where each attendee will receive a name badge and a sample pack. Room assignments for all sessions appear on the event schedule.

Open House Pre-Order Offer: Registered attendees may order classroom supplies at 15 percent off at harlowstreetart.example/preorder. Pre-orders must be submitted by May 13. Orders of $250 or more will be delivered free of charge to the attendee's school.

documents.title: Program change and new pre-order deadline

blocks.text: From: Daniela Osei <d.osei@harlowstreetart.example>
To: Registered Open House attendees
Date: May 2
Subject: Program change and new pre-order deadline
Dear educators,

We are writing with an update about the May 10 Educator Open House. The product samples that Corrigan Colorworks planned to use in its demonstration have been held up at a distribution center and will not reach Westbridge in time. Rather than present without them, Corrigan's presenter will lead the demonstration on May 22 from 4:30 to 5:30 P.M., in the room originally assigned to it. Attendees who reserved this demonstration keep their places, and no new booking is required.

Because many of you would like to try Corrigan's products before ordering them, we have extended the pre-order deadline for all registered attendees from May 13 to May 27. The 15 percent discount applies to every order submitted by the new date. Apart from the deadline, the terms of the offer in your booking confirmation are unchanged, so the free delivery described there is still available.

If you reserved the Corrigan demonstration but cannot attend on May 22, please reply to this e-mail so that we can offer your place to an educator on our waiting list. All other sessions will run on May 10 as scheduled.
Daniela Osei, Events Coordinator, Harlow Street Art Supply
Educator Open House – Session Schedule, May 10
Check-in opens at 9:30 A.M. at the front counter. Every session combines a hands-on demonstration with time for questions.
Sessions and rooms
A light lunch will be served in the café from 12:00 to 12:45. Catalogs from all presenting brands are available at the front counter.

questions.prompt: Why did Ms. Osei send the e-mail?

options.label: A
options.text: To invite educators to register for an additional session

options.label: B
options.text: To ask attendees to submit their pre-orders before the event

options.label: C
options.text: To announce a schedule change and a later ordering deadline

options.label: D
options.text: To explain why a product demonstration has been canceled

explanation.summary_zh: 這封電子郵件宣布兩件事：Corrigan 的示範改到 5 月 22 日舉行，預購期限也由 5 月 13 日延至 5 月 27 日。(C) 最能概括寫信目的。
explanation.reasoning_zh: 主旨行「Program change and new pre-order deadline」已點出兩項重點。內文在問候語之後，先說明 Corrigan 的示範改期，接著宣布延長預購期限，最後說明無法出席改期示範的人該如何處理。目的題應選能涵蓋全文主要內容的選項，不要只抓某個細節，也不要選與內文相反的說法。

option_analysis.label: A
option_analysis.reason_zh: 信中沒有邀請大家報名新場次。已預約的人保留原名額，無須重新預約；候補名單上的教師只是遞補空出的名額。5 月 22 日的示範是原有場次改期，不是新增場次。

option_analysis.label: B
option_analysis.reason_zh: 與內文相反。期限由 5 月 13 日延到 5 月 27 日，比 5 月 10 日的活動還晚，信中並沒有要求大家在活動前下單。

option_analysis.label: C
option_analysis.reason_zh: 正確。「schedule change」對應示範改到 5 月 22 日，「a later ordering deadline」對應預購期限延至 5 月 27 日。

option_analysis.label: D
option_analysis.reason_zh: 示範並未取消，而是改到 5 月 22 日舉行，仍由 Corrigan 的講者在原本分配的教室進行。

evidence.quote: Subject: Program change and new pre-order deadline
Corrigan's presenter will lead the demonstration on May 22 from 4:30 to 5:30 P.M., in the room originally assigned to it
we have extended the pre-order deadline for all registered attendees from May 13 to May 27

explanation.takeaway_zh: 目的題先看主旨行與內文開頭，再確認選項能涵蓋全文的主要訊息。要特別分辨「改期」與「取消」、「延後期限」與「提前下單」這類方向相反的說法。

questions.prompt: According to the e-mail, why should some attendees reply to Ms. Osei?

options.label: A
options.text: To confirm that they still want their reserved places

options.label: B
options.text: To request that sample packs be sent to their schools

options.label: C
options.text: To be added to a waiting list for the May 22 demonstration

options.label: D
options.text: To allow another educator to take a place they cannot use

explanation.summary_zh: 已預約 Corrigan 示範、但 5 月 22 日無法出席的人應該回信，讓店家把名額轉給候補名單上的教師，答案是 (D)。
explanation.reasoning_zh: 關鍵句「so that we can offer your place to an educator on our waiting list」說明回信的目的是讓出自己用不到的名額。選項 (D) 用「allow another educator to take a place they cannot use」換句話說。同一封信也提到已預約者保留名額、無須重新預約，可據此排除「回信確認名額」的選項。

option_analysis.label: A
option_analysis.reason_zh: 信中明說「keep their places, and no new booking is required」，已預約者不必回信就能保留名額；需要回信的是 5 月 22 日無法出席的人。

option_analysis.label: B
option_analysis.reason_zh: 預約確認單寫明樣品包在報到時發放，電子郵件沒有提到把樣品包寄到學校。信中提到的免費配送是針對預購訂單。

option_analysis.label: C
option_analysis.reason_zh: 信中確實提到 waiting list，但回信的人是讓出名額的一方，候補名單上的是其他教師。此選項把候補名單的角色套錯了人。

option_analysis.label: D
option_analysis.reason_zh: 正確。回信是為了讓店家把空出的名額提供給候補的教師。

evidence.quote: please reply to this e-mail so that we can offer your place to an educator on our waiting list
Attendees who reserved this demonstration keep their places, and no new booking is required
each attendee will receive a name badge and a sample pack

explanation.takeaway_zh: 細節題的選項若重複使用原文字詞（如 waiting list），要確認動作的主體與方向（誰讓出名額、誰遞補）是否和原文一致。

questions.prompt: In the e-mail, the word "terms" is closest in meaning to

options.label: A
options.text: periods

options.label: B
options.text: conditions

options.label: C
options.text: relations

options.label: D
options.text: names

explanation.summary_zh: 「Apart from the deadline, the terms of the offer in your booking confirmation are unchanged」中的 terms 指優惠的各項條件（例如免運規定），意思最接近 conditions。
explanation.reasoning_zh: terms 有好幾個常見意思：期間或學期、彼此的關係（on good terms）、術語或名稱，以及合約或優惠的條件。本句說除了期限之外，確認單上的 the terms of the offer 都沒有改變。這裡 terms 後面接 of the offer，談的是這項優惠附帶的規定。後半句接著說「so the free delivery described there is still available」，免運之所以仍然有效，是因為確認單上與免運相關的優惠規定維持不變。由這個搭配和後面的結果子句可知，terms 在此指優惠條件，最接近 conditions。

option_analysis.label: A
option_analysis.reason_zh: term 確實可指一段期間（如學期、任期），收件人又都是教師，容易聯想到學期。但本句的 terms 後面接 of the offer，指的是這項優惠本身的規定。後半句以「所以免運仍然有效」作結，而免運屬於優惠條件，不是一段期間或學期。因此 periods 不符合本句語境。

option_analysis.label: B
option_analysis.reason_zh: 正確。「除了期限以外，確認單上的優惠條件都不變，所以其中提到的免運仍然有效」，語意通順，也保留了名詞複數的用法。

option_analysis.label: C
option_analysis.reason_zh: 在 be on good terms with someone 這類片語中，terms 表示彼此的關係。本句談的是一項優惠，不是人與人之間的關係，放入後語意不通。

option_analysis.label: D
option_analysis.reason_zh: term 可指術語或名稱（如 a technical term），但「優惠的名稱不變」無法推出「所以免運仍然有效」，與後半句的因果關係不符。

evidence.quote: Apart from the deadline, the terms of the offer in your booking confirmation are unchanged, so the free delivery described there is still available.

explanation.takeaway_zh: 遇到多義字時，不要依自己的背景（例如教師聯想到學期）直接選最先想到的常見意思。應回到句子本身，先看字詞的搭配（如 the terms of the offer），再看後面的結果子句（so the free delivery described there is still available）是否說得通，然後選出最符合語境的意思。

questions.prompt: What would happen if Mr. Renner submitted a $400 pre-order on May 20?

options.label: A
options.text: It would be discounted and delivered free of charge to Fairholme Middle School.

options.label: B
options.text: It would be charged the full price, as May 20 is past the pre-order deadline.

options.label: C
options.text: It would be discounted, but a delivery charge would be added to it.

options.label: D
options.text: It would be delivered free of charge, but without the discount.

explanation.summary_zh: 電子郵件把預購期限延至 5 月 27 日，並說除了期限之外，確認單上的優惠條件（包括免運）都不變。確認單規定滿 $250 的訂單會免費送到參加者的學校，也顯示 Mr. Renner 任職於 Fairholme Middle School。因此 5 月 20 日送出的 $400 訂單可享折扣，並免費送到該校，答案是 (A)。
explanation.reasoning_zh: 四個選項分別在「有沒有折扣」和「要不要付運費」兩方面不同，需要結合兩份文件判斷。(1) 只看確認單，5 月 20 日已超過 5 月 13 日的期限，會誤選 (B)。(2) 電子郵件把期限延到 5 月 27 日，並說新期限前送出的訂單都享 15% 折扣，因此可排除 (B) 和 (D)。信中也說免運條件不變，但沒有寫出門檻金額與送達地點，所以只看電子郵件無法確定 $400 的訂單是否符合免運，也無法排除 (C)。(3) 回到確認單：免運門檻是 $250，送達地點是參加者的學校，而 Mr. Renner 任職於 Fairholme Middle School。$400 達到門檻，即使以折扣後的 $340 計算也超過 $250，所以訂單會免費送到該校。

option_analysis.label: A
option_analysis.reason_zh: 正確。5 月 20 日在延長後的期限內，可享折扣；$400 達到確認單的 $250 門檻，會免費送到 Mr. Renner 任職的 Fairholme Middle School。

option_analysis.label: B
option_analysis.reason_zh: 只看確認單才會得出這個結論。電子郵件已把期限由 5 月 13 日延至 5 月 27 日，5 月 20 日仍在期限內，因此不會以原價計算。

option_analysis.label: C
option_analysis.reason_zh: 電子郵件說免運條件不變，確認單的條件是滿 $250 免運；$400（或折扣後的 $340）都已達門檻，所以不會另收運費。

option_analysis.label: D
option_analysis.reason_zh: 電子郵件明說 15% 折扣適用於新期限前送出的所有訂單，5 月 20 日的訂單可享折扣，因此「免運但沒有折扣」不成立。

evidence.quote: Pre-orders must be submitted by May 13.
we have extended the pre-order deadline for all registered attendees from May 13 to May 27
The 15 percent discount applies to every order submitted by the new date.
Apart from the deadline, the terms of the offer in your booking confirmation are unchanged, so the free delivery described there is still available.
Orders of $250 or more will be delivered free of charge to the attendee's school.
Booked by: Tobias Renner, Visual Arts Department, Fairholme Middle School

explanation.takeaway_zh: 遇到期限延長的通知，要同時確認新的日期，以及原文件中維持不變的條件（如金額門檻、送達地點），兩者合起來才能判斷結果。

questions.prompt: What is indicated about the sessions that Mr. Renner and Ms. Calloway reserved?

options.label: A
options.text: Both are scheduled to take place before lunch.

options.label: B
options.text: They are being held in two different rooms.

options.label: C
options.text: One of them will now take place on a later date.

options.label: D
options.text: One of them has been canceled because of low registration.

explanation.summary_zh: 確認單顯示兩人預約了 A、D 兩場，時間表顯示 D 場的講者來自 Corrigan Colorworks，電子郵件則說 Corrigan 的示範改到 5 月 22 日。因此其中一場改到較晚的日期，答案是 (C)。
explanation.reasoning_zh: 本題需要串連三份文件。第一步，預約確認單寫明「Sessions reserved for both attendees: A and D」。第二步，時間表中 D 場的講者是「Martin Achebe, Corrigan Colorworks」。第三步，電子郵件說 Corrigan 的示範改在 May 22 舉行。電子郵件沒有寫出場次代號，確認單也沒有寫講者，所以必須透過時間表，才能確定受影響的正是兩人預約的 D 場。

option_analysis.label: A
option_analysis.reason_zh: A 場 9:45–10:45 A.M. 確實在午餐（12:00–12:45）之前，但 D 場原定 2:00–3:00 P.M.，在午餐之後；改期後是 5 月 22 日下午 4:30，也不在午餐前。

option_analysis.label: B
option_analysis.reason_zh: 時間表上 A 場與 D 場都在 Gallery Room，電子郵件也說改期後的示範在「the room originally assigned to it」舉行，所以兩場仍在同一間教室。

option_analysis.label: C
option_analysis.reason_zh: 正確。兩人預約的 D 場就是 Corrigan 的示範，已由 5 月 10 日改到 5 月 22 日。

option_analysis.label: D
option_analysis.reason_zh: D 場確實受到影響，但它是改期而不是取消；原因是樣品在物流中心被耽擱，信中沒有提到報名人數不足。

evidence.quote: Sessions reserved for both attendees: A and D
Martin Achebe, Corrigan Colorworks
Corrigan's presenter will lead the demonstration on May 22 from 4:30 to 5:30 P.M., in the room originally assigned to it
A light lunch will be served in the café from 12:00 to 12:45.
Gallery Room

explanation.takeaway_zh: 多文件題常靠代號（場次、編號）把資訊串起來：先在一份文件找到代號，再到表格對應講者或名稱，最後回到通知確認是否有變更。
